Ezra says to the Lord, “thou madest the world for our sakes”. The world was made for Israel's sake. Paul says who that is: “Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises”. The adoption, the glory, the covenants and the promises all belong to Israel.

So do not think the agendas of this earth, at their very core, are not about us. In Psalms 83 all the nations put aside their arms against each other when it comes to pointing at us as their enemy: the enemy of my enemy is my friend.

Yet Ezra goes on: “behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.” One of the ways they devour us is with lies, the mouth of the dragon doctrine. They know our teaching and research is strong and they cannot stand toe to toe with it, so they throw money behind the internet to confuse our people. Screenshot it and save it, because there will be a time you search it and it will say something else.

That is why, though we use outside resources, the foundation of what we follow is the scriptures above all things: the one thing that cannot be disputed or corrupted. The promises pertain to Israel, and the world was made for our sakes.

“When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?” That is messing with the scales. It is the same spirit of deceitful balances read in Hosea 12:7, and it was spoken against us because we had mixed among the other nations and learned it from them.

Remember when Nehemiah had to curse out the merchants from the other nations because they came to sell on the sabbath. If we had all been in the spirit, would he have had to curse them out? We would not have bought, and they would not have come. They came because we were breaking the law by buying.

We should not have that spirit, but now you see who really does. One of the grand ways they falsify the balances today is with the oil: they call Venezuela's crude too heavy, while it is more profitable to them than anything else.

It reaches into the mortgage too. Interest is designed to keep you in debt and keep you broke, and the mortgage is loaded front heavy, so the first years go mostly to interest and not principal. On a 300,000 home a 30-year loan costs an extra 250,800, and instead of fixing the economy Trump talks about a 50-year mortgage, where you pay an additional 476,000 just to have a cheaper payment, and leave that debt to your wife and kids. That is the deceit. When we think of scales we think of the little scale at the fruit market, but this shows how broad that evil principle is. Edom does it first, and they excel at it.

It is not wrong to own a home; it is better than renting. But the system is broken and was never supposed to be that way. If our economics were set up by the law, we would lend to each other without usury and own our homes. Even to that extent the Lord had righteous weights, scales and balances, and that is the wisdom and understanding Deuteronomy 4:6 speaks of.

“Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.” If you get blessed, it is to have to give to him that needeth. That is biblical, and that is part of the wisdom of Deuteronomy 4:6: the laws, statutes and commandments, everything written in the scripture, are our wisdom and our understanding, and we are to govern and deal with each other based on what God says.

How is that giving set up? You read it in Acts 2 and Acts 4: you put it at the feet of the leadership, and the leadership distributes as there is need. The leaders in the body initiate everything by the scripture, with the fundraising initiatives and the different offices, so that the body can be self-sustaining.

But many of us were raised in this environment and have not sharpened our senses, so we conduct business like Esau. Israelite businesses pop up, market to the body and make money off the body, and never come back and say, my pockets have gotten filled, my business has become profitable, I want to give back. Some even have cutthroat tactics, with no type of respect, moving the same way the world moves.

Those who say they are businessmen should read how the economics in Israel functioned and how we dealt with each other. Debt was forgiven every seven years so that debt would not pass from generation to generation. There was no usury, meaning no interest. Today what people wind up leaving behind is debt, and their families become responsible for it.

So the righteous way is to labour, prosper, and give back to the needy among our people. That is the foundation for seeing how Babylon, Esau and the rest of the world move in buying and selling, and why a nation that keeps God's statutes would be called “a wise and understanding people.”

“He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.” That spirit was in Israel as well, and this is spoken to us. Hosea deals primarily with the northern kingdom, with Judah mentioned in the mix.

Where did we learn it? Not from our own law. When you read the law and how we handled economics amongst ourselves, there was no such thing. We were mixed among the other nations and took on their customs: not only their lewdness and fornications, but how they would have no compassion on their people and how they dealt with them.

Usury was something we were supposed to do to the other nations: we lent to them and charged them interest. When we dealt with each other it was different. Not that you did not make a profit, but there were ways we dealt with each other, always with the intent that we would have communal wealth, so that generations would not get stuck with bad habits. We looked out for each other, the same way the corners of the field were left to help one another, and we were still able to prosper under that.

Instead we took up the insatiable appetite of the nations, having to get every last drop. Not so with God. That is why these balances of deceit were spoken against us. Keeping the statutes, dealing righteously with our brethren, is the wisdom Deuteronomy 4:6 says the nations will one day see in us.

The prince of Tyrus says, “I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas”. Right now the Israelis are the chief ones that say that, but all Edom puts itself there, because of that white false image: they are literally saying, I am God, God is white, all the angels are white, all the prophets are white. In the midst of the seas means in the midst of all the nations. “yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God”: though you operate in the earth like you control everything, it was only given into your hand for a dispensation of time, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

Ezekiel goes on: “With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches”. They figured out how to manipulate all these laws to get what they want: Trump is going to get that oil and that land in Venezuela. We try to say they are dumb, but we are the ones made dumb, learning from them, because most of us don't have the scriptures.

That traffic goes into slavery, trading the souls of men, as well as all the commerce and merchandise. Ezekiel 27:13 shows that the traffic chiefly deals with people: “Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.” They traded the persons of men: slavery, us. And the vessels of brass are all the other things, the oils, the jewels and the precious metals. Revelation 18 lists the same: all the gold and precious things, and then the souls of men.

So the riches that lifted up the prince's heart were built by trading our people, and the same system still drains Africa and Latin America alike. It is only a failure if you are on the side being oppressed; for that man of sin, Babylon the Great, it is an absolute success. That is why the nations will lament when judgment comes on Babylon: they got rich off the systems America put in place.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. We are reaping what we have sown, especially the northern kingdom. Hosea 9 says we went a whoring from our God: we sought after the other nations and their ideals and made deals with them, and so “Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.” That is servitude, dependence, and our resources consumed by others.

The oil, the land, the assets: everything the nations say we stole from them is really the fruit of our land, eaten up by a nation we knew not. Others eat our labour. That is what the whole documentary The End of Poverty is about.

The other nations are the ministers of evil unto us for the evil that we have done. Just as there is prophecy for Babylon that great city, there is prophecy for us, and this is it: oppressed and crushed alway, in Venezuela, Cuba, and all through Latin America.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” This is for the northern kingdom especially. Our breakdown of it has often been very United States based, but when you go to these other countries you have to give the sense this way, because the people there are fully aware of the robbing of their resources.

Why these things in particular, hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things? Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 39:26 names the chief things of life: “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” When you target those things you dehumanize a people, taking away what is needful for them to live dignified. That is why they will never let the resources in their backyard be controlled by the people who own them, here or in Africa. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented of what Hosea 9 describes, we will not reclaim them until the Redeemer comes; in the meantime we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

Sirach 34:21 shows it is violence: “The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb or a bullet, but “he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” The man in the documentary worked all day and still had nothing to go home to eat.

Lamentations 5 is the same picture: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”, just as Hosea 9 says: we have given the power and sovereignty of our resources to Babylon the Great, the United States, and other nations, and China is working its way into Latin America. “Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” With the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick, the northern kingdom is still paying for the sins of the forefathers. “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.”

Chains do not have to be chains anymore; this is economic slavery, and that is why Deuteronomy 28:48 is so profound. Baruch 3:8: “we are yet this day in our captivity”, “to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.” That is the key. We need this compassion to reach in and touch our people's souls. Babylon is speaking plainly; so must we.

Israel is a people robbed and spoiled, and spoiled means severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value, marred or ruined. Solomon gives the picture of it: “There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.”

Folly is set in great dignity: the foolish things, the vessels of wrath, raised up high. And the rich sit in low place: the real rich, the ones the Lord speaks to in Revelation, knowing their poverty and their sufferings, yet calling them rich. Israel is rich, yet sits low.

“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” Those who were meant to serve us are in positions of authority and high value, and the princes, the sons of God, walk as servants upon the earth. If that's not the visual for spoiled when you read robbed and spoiled, nothing is.

That is the oppression of Jeremiah 50:33: Israel and Judah held fast by those who took them captive. And that is why none can restore it but the Redeemer who will plead their cause and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

“The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” A narrow-minded person thinks only of the fields, but look at the economic and resource oppression on the continents where we reside: both kingdoms, all twelve tribes, suffering the same afflictions. They hold us fast because of the resources in our lands.

Isaiah describes that same people: “But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” Robbed and spoiled is the same as the oppression we read of in Micah.

Robbed goes to our identity, not only our resources. The thesaurus lays it out: cut off, deprived, destitute, dispossessed; and because we are not living as the sons of God, we accept what they call us, Gentiles, and become impoverished, without hope, without a redeemer, without access to our own resources, stripped. Spoiled, in the sense meant here, is being severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value: marred or ruined. We are the sons of God, the greatest people the Lord ever created, for whom he made the whole earth, and that is not what we reap now.

“none delivereth”, “none saith, Restore”: that is why our Redeemer must come and do it. “Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name”, and that Redeemer is Christ. Notice all the re- words with Israel: redeemed, restored, redemption. They show the covenant never passed on to some strangers or foreign nation. Our people have got to wake up.

Jeremiah says the sword upon Babylon ends in this: “it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation. As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there”. Once the smoke and smoulder of the nuclear destruction is there, only wild beasts will be able to dwell there.

Isaiah says the same thing and tells you who it is: “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation”. The glory of kingdoms tells you who this is.

That is the key point. Did Sodom and Gomorrah exist after that? No. That did not happen to the physical Babylon at that time. It got some of these judgments as other empires came up over it, but it was never wiped out like Sodom. So either the Bible is lying and the prophecy did not come true, or it is talking about something else, for a different time.

It is speaking of Babylon the great today, the glory of kingdoms, the one full of mingled people and mad upon its idols: the United States. Her ultimate destruction will be as Sodom and Gomorrah.

“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” He comes as a whirlwind, with chariots, and his rebuke is with fire. Read on: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”.

Now go back to Jeremiah 50:35 and you can visualize the sword: “A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.” The Chaldeans are the elite of the Babylonians, but it is not just the upper echelon. It is all the inhabitants of Babylon, including the Israelites that do not repent.

The sword is “upon their horses, and upon their chariots”: their tanks and planes. It is “upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her”. Is this not the great melting pot, full of thick clay heaped upon itself with all types of nations? “a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.” What they did to us will happen to them.

It is “the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols”: crazy for their idols, from the money to the structure in DC to Christianity to Americanism and the flag they wave everywhere. The fire and the sword of the Lord in Isaiah 66 is the judgment coming upon that Babylon.

Lamentations cries, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Baruch shows that the reproach is still upon us: “Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.”

Lamentations goes on: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You are seeing this now, in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. This isn't just for that time; don't tell us that was then, get over it. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”: we have given power, authority and sovereignty over our resources to Egypt and Assyria, to Babylon the Great, the United States, and to other nations. China is working its way into Latin America, and that is why Trump is getting more aggressive going over there now.

“Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” The whole dynamic of the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick applies to the Northern Kingdom through that verse. We are still paying for the sins of our forefathers, bearing the brunt of it to this very day under all this oppression and economic violence. Chains don't have to be chains no more. Being here in America, we can't always fathom it, but it is not talking about any one person; it is the curse upon our people and our tribes.

“Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” The captivity now is economic. That is why Baruch says we are yet this day in our captivity, subject to payments. In the base form we say we have to pay taxes, and there is truth to that, but it is so much broader than that. And the key is at the end: “which departed from the Lord our God.”

This is the compassion we have to have to push this out to our people and speak to it properly: reach in, touch their soul, make it alive. Babylon speaks plainly; why aren't we? We have to rise up and fight that.

It is given into his hand to do these things. Job says it: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” It goes with Micah 2 and with Luke 4:6.

He covers the faces of the judges: the real judges, which are the Israelites. And “if not, where, and who is he?” If it is not given to him, then who is he? If it is not this man, who is it?

Look at their conferences: the United Nations, the G8, the economic forums, diverse nations in a room together and Israel not represented. When these prophecies were revealed to our forefathers, they were seeing visuals of things like this: the halls and conference centers of all the nations taking crafty counsel together about world domination.

It reinforces even more that only Christ can save us from this. There is no way to play in their sandbox, in their politics. No leader will rise up and combat what they have done, because the earth has been given into the hand of the wicked.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” Upon their beds means they are insulated from consequence; they know nobody can touch them, like Trump saying in his first term he could shoot somebody on Fifth Avenue and nobody would do anything. When the morning is light, they do it through institutions, laws and bills stacked higher than a ream of paper, with billions in them for Israel and Ukraine. They are vessels of wrath fitted for destruction, and that is our hope: all that wrath will be paid back to them double.

Why is it in the power of their hand? Luke shows who gave it. After showing Christ all the kingdoms, “the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.”

To whomsoever I will, I give it. So who gave them their power? Satan. And who are the ministers of Satan? Babylon the great, Esau: what the world ignorantly calls the white man.

That is why they covet fields, oil fields, iron ore fields, rare earth fields, agricultural fields, and take them by violence, as with Venezuela. The power in their hand was delivered to them by the devil.

When the morning is light they practise it, and they do it through law. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?”

That is how the whole system was designed. The Constitution was not framed for us; we were three-fifths of a man. It was based on Roman and Greek democracy, which you read of in the Maccabees, and even then we were not part of it. It was framed to keep them in power. The Supreme Court interprets Esau's constitution, and it is all set up with words that frame mischief to benefit them. Our salvation is not in that.

Look at it now: the Supreme Court, 6 to 3, on its shadow docket, behind closed doors, gave ICE the green light to stop and detain people based on appearance, language, accent or workplace. That is racial profiling blessed by law, and it targets the northern kingdom. So if you are a citizen and you fit the profile, carry your passport or a passport card.

Sanctions, asset seizures, blockades: all of that is violence too, economic violence. When you oppress a man and his house and his heritage, whether you take him by the neck or frame a law, it is still violence. If what they want is not legal, they find a way to weaponize the legal system. That is the throne of iniquity.

“Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils”. This is once Christ comes to redeem us; we read something similar in Isaiah, and the Bible is repetitive and supports itself. “For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: that is Bretton Woods. If America collapses, all of them collapse; that is the way they wound it. It wasn't only us that made a covenant with death. The kings of the earth married themselves to America's success through the IMF and the banks, and that money is the real weapon of mass destruction. So all the posturing when they talk against each other is BS. America can't fail until God makes it fail.

Then “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Because of her sins we are in these situations, as we read in Hosea and Lamentations, so we have to come out of her. “For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.”

“Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.” That is assured reciprocity; that is the recompense. “How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her”, for she says “I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow. Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”.

The merchants weep because they are all tied to her: what are we going to do now? The gold, silver, precious stones and the rest come from Africa, Latin America, wherever our people are, and “slaves, and souls of men”: the trafficking. The horses and chariots are the weapons they sell to other countries in US dollars. They have complete authority because they run the money. But the Lord will judge her double, and from that point on it is our time. Our power is to repent: not attack any government, but obey the powers that be and build back our community and economy with each other.

The curse says we would serve our enemies in hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things. Why does it target those things specifically? Sirach names the chief things in life: “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.”

When you target those things, you dehumanize people. You take away the principal things needful for life, for them to be dignified, and those things are robbed from them. That is why they will never let the resources in their so-called backyard be in the control of the people that own them. They must maintain that dominance, the same here and the same in Africa. We see it with Venezuela and Cuba. Our understanding of this scripture is often United States-based, but when you go to these other countries to give the sense, the people are fully aware of the robbing of their resources, and it must be brought to light.

“All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented, those things are turned over to the ungodly, and we will not reclaim them until the redeemer comes. In the meantime we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

That is why “The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb or a bullet. Defraud people of those principal things and you are a man of blood. Economic violence is still violence. “He that taketh away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” Like the brother in the documentary who works all day and still has no money to eat: their only profit is labour.

Lamentations says the same: “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. Chains don’t have to be chains anymore.

Paul warns of him that “preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”. That other Jesus is the white Jesus, the head of Christ, the image made during the Italian Renaissance, when Rome, wounded by a sword, was revived. The Jesus the apostles preached was a black man according to the Bible. The “another spirit” is Christianity, and the “another gospel” is the teaching that all nations can be saved, become spiritual Israel and get glorified bodies. That is rainbow coalition and democracy. That ain't the Bible, and it was not taught or accepted back then.

Christ warned of the same thing: “Take heed that no man deceive you.” Take heed that no man deceive you into Christianity. “For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” Coming in his name goes back to blaspheming his name, which Revelation said the exact same way. Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo painted Christ in a white image and said, this is Christ, from now on, and it has deceived many throughout the world.

Then verse 24: “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. The head of Christ is the false Christ. The false prophets are the missionaries, the Jesuits, the Christian pastors and ministers, the Catholic priests and popes.

They “shall shew great signs and wonders”: the technology. Christian America created great wonders, nuclear war, fire falling down from heaven, the same wonders John mentioned in Revelation. “insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” It is not possible, but his technological advancements, turning a man to a woman and a woman to a man, his science, cars, televisions and phones, make him a god to our people, as if no one is better than him.

That is why God says “Learn not the way of the heathen”. Our people follow his traditions to the death, but his Jesus is another Jesus, and his gospel is another gospel.

“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world.” To spoil is to despoil and corrupt. It is a vain deceit because there is covetousness behind it, reward behind it, gifts. The rudiments are the elements of the world, of man. David shows who is behind those traditions: “They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?”

Who are they? Go up to verse 2: “Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity.” The secret counsel of the wicked are the elite that sit back and research and study ancient pagan cultures and ancient Eastern cultures and incorporate them into our society today. Some call them Illuminati, some call them the Luciferians. It is all of them: Bilderbergs, Duponts, Rothschilds, whatever. An elite group that runs this world behind the scenes and builds the customs and societal norms we grew up in, that we believed were righteous and are not. And we reference the customs of these elite demons as if they were God himself.

They “commune of laying snares”: they communicate, have conversations, think tanks. The snares are doctrines, religions, philosophies, politics, laid privily for our people, who they know are the real people of God. “Who shall see them?” You do not know a Luciferian if you meet one; he has to tell you he is part of a secret society. They are known, but they are not known.

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search.” They search out iniquities from the ancient mystic civilisations: Babylon, Assyria, Rome, Greece, Canaan, the Sidonians, the Germanic cultures, Norse folklore. Their archaeologists do diligent searches and excavations, dig these things up, revamp them, commercialise them and make them appealing and alluring to the foolish and ignorant. And “both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.”

They have all kinds of slick ways: television, radio, propaganda, advertisement. That is their signs and wonders, and it is all witchcraft. They will get you one way or the other, through influence, music and fashion. Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer, Jingle Bells: you have to check yourself because it is catchy. That is the tradition of men Paul warned about, spoiling our people through the holidays.

Our commandment from our God was to destroy their altars, break their images and cut down their groves. A grove is trees, and they were cut down because they were sacred trees. Moses gives the same command in Deuteronomy: “Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods”. Destroy the places where the nations served their gods, wherever they are.

Watch where those places were: “upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree”. Not some trees. Under every green tree: evergreen, oak, cedar, palm, pine. Any place they served gods on a high mountain or a high hill, destroy it, and every place under a green tree, destroy it.

Read verse 3 and the command goes further: “And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire”. Burn the groves with fire. The Bohemian Grove, where most of the presidents, if not all of them, have gone, has an idol of Molech, the owl, standing under trees so tall all you see is the stalk. Don't focus on the owl; look at what surrounds it. The idol is under the tree. If we were in power today, that owl would be destroyed and those trees burned all around it. Burn it all.

That is why the tree matters for Exodus 34:13. The groves Israel was told to cut down are the trees the heathen worship under, and the tree set up in the house at Christmas is the same thing.

Ezekiel names the same places: “upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols”. Under every green tree and under every thick oak, that is where they offered to their idols. Where did they sacrifice? Under the tree.

And God's judgment falls right there: “Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars”. The slain lie among the idols and around the altars under the trees.

No, the Greeks did this too, and other nations helped them.

2 Maccabees 5 shows it: Jason, an Israelite, a treasonous negro, “slew his own citizens without mercy”, treating his countrymen like enemies to please the Greeks, and he died cast out, with none to mourn him. “But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done” (Colossians 3:25). Then the king took the city: “fourscore thousand, whereof forty thousand were slain in the conflict; and no fewer sold than slain.” Apollonius was sent “to slay all those that were in their best age, and to sell the women and the younger sort”. The best age, the movers and shakers who make a nation thrive; take them and leave the old and feeble, and you destroy the nation, the same complaint made about the colonialists.

So the sons and daughters we begat went into captivity, sold by the Greeks, and after them by Rome, whose foothold came when Pompey captured Jerusalem in 65 BC, and the slave markets were full of black Jewish slaves. That is where breaking the year of release led.

After the law for a poor brother comes the distinction: “Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.” Your bondmen and bondmaids shall be of the heathen, the other nations. A bondservant is like chattel slavery, and that is what Israel was never to make of a brother.

Keep reading: “Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.” Now the word stranger is talking about the heathen, as the verse above explained. “And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever”. For how long? For ever. They got passed down from generation to generation, to your son and your daughter. The other nations were not released in the Jubilee; they remained slaves. That is what God said.

Then the stress on but: “but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.” There is the distinction. Your brother who waxes poor and is sold to you serves “as an hired servant, and as a sojourner”, what we call a job today; back then they called you a servant. He serves until the Jubilee, and then “shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family”. “For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.” “Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.” Rigour is hardship: busting him in the head, whooping him. Don't do that.

The word stranger in this chapter does not always mean another race. The stranger of verse 35, “though he be a stranger, or a sojourner”, is a brother of another tribe, like Judah living in the land of Simeon, a stranger there. Numbers 16:40 shows it: “no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord”. Anyone not of the seed of Aaron, Judah, Benjamin, Manasseh, Ephraim, Gad, Reuben, was called a stranger. But in verses 44 and 45 the stranger is the heathen round about.

So the Jubilee's liberty was for Israel. The poor brother went free; the bondmen of the heathen did not. “For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt”. Verse 55 tells you plain: the Israelites are God's servants. Everybody on the planet is not God's servants.

When a brother waxed poor and sold himself to a sojourner or stranger, it was not the end of him: “After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him”. This is not saying we sold ourselves to the other nations. It is another tribe. A man of Judah whose land is jacked up goes among the tribe of Gad and says, I'm poor, I need to work for you, help me. Esau will use this chapter and try to cause confusion with that word stranger, saying see, the other nations. No. That is about Israel.

“Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.” A kinsman could buy him back, and if he came into some money while he was working, he could say, I don't need this anymore, and redeem himself.

The price was reckoned the same way as the land: “from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.” The price is according to the years left from now to the Jubilee. “If there be yet many years behind”, the price of his redemption is higher; “if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile”, it is lower. It is the same concept as the land.

“And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.” That goes back to verse 43. “And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.” That goes back to verse 41.

Why? “For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.” A poor brother of Israel is never a bondservant for ever. He is the Lord's servant, he can always be redeemed, and in the Jubilee he goes free with his children.

The whole Jubilee rests on this: “The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.” Israel could sell the use of a field, but never the field itself, because the land belongs to the Most High. He is the owner, and he decides its proper use. That is why nobody in Israel was to heap up land for himself: it never really belonged to them.

That is also why the price of land was worked by the harvests left until the Jubilee. “According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.” More years means more crops, so a higher price; one year left means one harvest, so the price has to be less. What was bought was the crops, not the land. And in the middle of it: “Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God”.

Look at how black people chip each other and undercut each other today. That is why we have to come back to the Bible and apply these basic principles. When our own try to oppress one another in business, our people go to the Chinese man instead. God says don't oppress one another.

The Most High even provided for the year they could not farm. “What shall we eat the seventh year?” “Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.” That answers everyone who says they have to break the Sabbath to make their money. It is connected to the seventh-day Sabbath, where what was needed was baked beforehand and laid up for the seventh; here it is the sixth year he increases. It is all spiritual.

Read on: “And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.” If a brother waxed poor and sold some of his possession, a kinsman could come and redeem what he had to sell away. If none could, and he later had the means himself, he counted the years and restored the overplus, the extra. And if he could not, the land stayed in the hand of the buyer only “until the year of jubile”, and then he returned to his possession, money or no money. Every fifty years it all goes back.

There is a spirit in the land. The woman who came to Esdras was Jerusalem, and the Most High wanted us to see that there is a connection between the people and the land. So when the trumpet sounds on the Day of Atonement in the fiftieth year and liberty is proclaimed, every man returns to his possession and his family, because the land was never anybody's to keep but the Lord's.

Numbers 36 is the law for the brother who had no sons. The chief fathers of Gilead, of the tribe of Manasseh, came before Moses because the inheritance of Zelophehad was given to his daughters, and “if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers”. The inheritance goes to her husband. Not even the jubile would bring it back: “so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.” You are Manasseh, you marry into Judah, and Judah owns that land forever.

So the Lord commanded, “only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry”, “that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.” That is the law right there: if you have all daughters and you have land and property, they marry within the tribe so another tribe of Israel does not take possession of it forever.

That is what Tobit was making reference to. Brothers often ask, because Judah married outside the tribe of Judah and Ephraim married outside the tribe of Ephraim. But there was a special clause when it came to property and land, and the woman was not allowed to do that.

Tobit tells his son, “chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”. See that: not of thy father’s tribe. “for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob”, and “our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.” Shall inherit the land: that is the point. Marrying your own kindred is how the inheritance of the fathers stays with their seed.

Tobit keeps going, and it is for anybody here looking at a Chinese lady: “love thy brethren, and despise not in thy heart thy brethren, the sons and daughters of thy people, in not taking a wife of them: for in pride is destruction and much trouble”. It is pride when you do not want to marry a woman of your own race, your own tribe. When people say love is love, that has nothing to do with it; God never said hate your people.

“and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine.” You will lose everything, and you see it all in the news. Halle Berry married outside and now pays child support to both of her exes, thousands every month, while the white husband she paid called her a nigger every time she paid. He fought to straighten and lighten their daughter’s natural hair, because he wanted his children to look white. She knew what she was up against.

Serena and Venus Williams married outside the race after all the hell their father went through for those two girls. He saw the power of white supremacy get into his daughter’s head, and he did not show up at the wedding. Janet Jackson married an Arab and ran out of there with the baby, under an agreement not to speak on what she saw. Shannon Sharpe lost millions and millions of dollars over a twenty-year-old white girl from the gym.

That is lewdness being the mother of famine, decay and great want. The Bible is a true book. The law of Numbers 36 kept the inheritance in the tribe of the fathers, and Tobit shows the curse on those who despise their own people and take a strange woman.

Jeremiah 50:19 says Israel “shall feed on Carmel and Bashan”. Carmel was Judah's; now Bashan. Joshua 13 shows it: “And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.” “And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair”. Bashan belonged to Manasseh.

Read Jeremiah 50:19 again so you get the thought: “And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.” God is bringing Israel back to the very lands the tribes were given at the beginning.

Now see how it gets switched around in Obadiah. “And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.” Benjamin shall possess Gilead. The tribes come back to the land, but the land is shared out anew.

Verse 20 goes on: “the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath”. The land of the Canaanites is the land of Israel, and Zarephath is Lebanon. “and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.” Sepharad is the Asia Minor region and Spain. Our people scattered there come home and take the cities of the south.

Before Obadiah, the class read Jeremiah 50:19: “And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.” To know whose land Carmel and Bashan were, go back to the first dividing of the land in Joshua. Write it down: Carmel was Judah's.

Joshua 15 gives the cities of Judah: “And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,” “And Kinah, and Dimonah”. Then jump to verse 55: “Maon, Carmel, and Ziph”. Those belonged to Judah. Judah's lot ran to the south, right up against the coast of Edom.

Jeremiah 50 goes on to say what God will do when he brings us back: “the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.” He wipes away our iniquity and brings us again to our own habitation.

Then watch how things get switched around. Obadiah says “they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau.” The mount of Esau is where Edom used to dwell originally, and we are going to take that whole area. “and they of the plain the Philistines”: we are going to take Palestine. We shall possess the fields of Ephraim and the fields of Samaria. The land is ours by inheritance from the first dividing, and when God brings Israel back it will be possessed even further than it was then.

Obadiah said “Benjamin shall possess Gilead”, and Zechariah shows God bringing us there: “I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead”. He is going to take us out of captivity and bring us into the land of Gilead. That is Obadiah 19 that was just read.

Then “and Lebanon”. Who belongs in Lebanon? Go back to Obadiah verse 20: “the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath”, and Zarephath is Lebanon. “and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.” Then verse 21: “And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau”, the mount of Edom.

Then “and place shall not be found for them.” There is not going to be enough room for us. Isaiah 49 says the same: “For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants”. There will be too many of us. “and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away”: the nations that swallowed us up shall be far away.

Then: “The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.” This place is too narrow; make room for me. That is why Christ said that in his Father's house are many mansions. Israel will come back in such numbers that the land cannot hold us.

Isaiah 49:20 speaks of “The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other”. The ones we lost are the two thirds, here in America. In case somebody asks what that means, Zechariah shows it: “And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.”

Notice it says in all the land. The land it is talking about is Babylon, and that is America. So two out of every three Israelites shall die here in America. The ones we lost are them wicked Israelites.

Then the third: “And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.”

That remnant is who goes back to possess the land in Obadiah. And even after the two thirds are gone, the children that are left shall say, “The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.” The land will still be too narrow for the ones God brings back.
