Isaiah shows how we will rule it: “Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.” The kingdom the saints take will be ruled in righteousness and judgment, not like the nations that rule us now, weakening nations and taking fields by violence.

That is the whole point of it: when the saints possess the kingdom, the king reigns in righteousness and his princes, the saints with him, rule in judgment, for ever.

The saints will “possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” Whose kingdom is it? Isaiah says: “For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder.” That is Christ. His name is called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

Read on: “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” It is Christ's government, and there shall be no end to it. That is why the saints take the kingdom for ever.

It is “upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.” Christ orders the kingdom and establishes it with judgment and justice, and the saints possess it with him.

That is the answer to the city that became an harlot. Isaiah says it was once “full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.” There was a time we were righteous; now we kill each other like it is nothing, and every one loveth gifts. But the Lord will purge away our dross and restore us, and under Christ's government the saints will rule for ever.

“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom.” Who are the kings that will rule it? David speaks to them: “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.”

We are the kings, and we are to be wise. We are the judges of the earth, brothers. Believe it or not, we are the judges. Right now we look like a bunch of nobodies, but the scripture says the earth was created for us, so we are the judges of the earth.

Read on: “Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.” That is how the kings and judges prepare to take the kingdom: by being wise and instructed now, serving the Lord with fear and rejoicing with trembling.

Isaiah shows the Lord restoring those judges little by little: “And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.” We have been whittled down, but we are waking up. Those are the judges, and the Most High is restoring us back again.

“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you”. Even when we took the land, there was a remnant of the nations left in the midst of us, and Joshua warned us not to cleave to them.

The warning goes on: “Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you”. Our forefather Joshua told us: marry these nations, and know for sure God will not get rid of them for you. We were warned to stay the hell away from these people, because their God is not our God. And we did exactly what we were warned not to do.

That is the reason behind Deuteronomy 7:3. “Neither shalt thou make marriages with them”, “For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods”. Look at it this week: Venus Williams married in Italy, and Italians are among the most racist people on the planet; do your history. Richard Williams put his life on the line for his black daughters to enter a space no one wanted them in; he protected them, provided for them, fought for them. The greatest thing a daughter can do for her father is bring home a man who honors him, and both of them spit in his face and married the same enemy their father fought against. This is the same man who was raping them, killing and whipping their fathers and mothers in front of them, abusing their children, and today they marry him voluntarily. And he would never have married her if the money were not there; remember what that white man did to Halle Berry. That is today's black woman society, and it is why God said do not make marriages with them.

“Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.” By marrying the other nations, Judah profaned the holiness of the Lord. And it is not only Judah; the whole twelve tribes did it.

This is spiritual. Those married to that nation all look bugged the hell out, because they have a different spirit in them, the beast spirit. Look at Serena Williams today, all bleached; she looks crazy because of that beast. You are not supposed to mingle the warrior seed with this beast, or mix the royal seed with pig seed.

So Deuteronomy 7:3 is not about skin alone: “For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods”. Marrying the daughter of a strange god is marrying the other god and taking on another spirit. It is called lust, and in the end the lust fades away.

“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.” “For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew.” To cut them off means he is going to kill all of them. When Esau falls, Esau will never rise back again.

Some think Esau will never fall. You forgot what happened to the Babylonians, the Persians and Medes, the Greeks, Rome and Egypt, all superpowers in their time. America has bombs, lasers, all types of weapons, the most powerful military on the planet. But the Most High is more powerful than America.

Isaiah shows how he does it: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” The smith today is what you call the scientist who makes weapons. Back then they were called smiths; they bring forth the instrument for the work. And the waster is nuclear power. God let them create the waster, and it is made to destroy.

Job shows it striking the wicked: “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” The iron weapon is the missile.

So the slaughter prepared for Esau’s children is by the very weapons God allowed their own smiths to make. Nobody is innocent, and whatever evil was done to the Israelites, no one is getting away with it.

Here is more about Esau: “Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth, That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?” Triumphing means victory: the victory of the wicked is short. America is the biggest hypocrite on planet earth, and its joy is but for a moment. This is temporary; there is going to be an end to it. All we have to do is be patient and wait.

And how does it end? “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” The iron weapon is the missile.

It goes with what was read in Isaiah 54: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” The smith of old is what is called a scientist today, who makes weapons, and the waster is nuclear power. God let him create the waster to destroy, and the same weapons he made will strike him through.

So do not be joined to him. Isaiah says, “every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.” Everyone found married to these demons and having kids by them shall be thrust through, and many of our people will fall into that. Do not feel sorry for them. The triumphing of the wicked is short.

Lamentations says, “in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Isaiah says the same of Israel leaning on a nation: “They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

Our people watch for a nation, America, to save them. It is 2025 and we are still thinking this place is for us. What we don't understand is that the system was never built for us; it was always written against us. Think about it: when the system was built, where were we? We were in slavery. So what makes you think that same system is now going to benefit you? That was never the purpose behind it.

Donald Trump is showing you that. That is why I love Donald Trump: he is forcing the negro to see the system for exactly what it is. The system was never built for the slaves; it was always against the slaves.

So the nation Israel watched for could not profit them. It could be no help and no profit, only a shame and a reproach. Our eyes fail for a vain help as long as we look to America to save us.

How did Esau get all this power? “And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.” He showed Christ all the great kingdoms: America, Russia, China, France, Germany, Europe. “All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” All these kingdoms were delivered to Satan, and he can give them to whoever he wants. But Christ answered, “Get thee behind me, Satan”, and worshipped God only. Satan tried to give Christ what already belonged to Christ.

Job shows who the power was given to: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. We are the judges of the earth, and the wicked covered our faces. The scripture says the earth was created for the Israelites, so the earth belongs to us. Esau covered the faces of the judges, and now Esau tries to give us what actually belongs to us, and some of us fall for it.

“if not, where, and who is he?” If this man is not the devil, show me who is. When you look, the most evil things on planet earth were caused by the white man. Somebody said, you want peace on earth, get rid of the white man. Picture the peace this land had before the white man came here, the peace the so-called American Indians had among themselves, the peace the continent of Africa had before the white man docked his boat there. They brought disease, rape, murder and stealing. That is what Malachi 1 is talking about: everywhere you see evil, move the curtain, and the white man is right there.

But the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment. The kingdoms the devil gave him will be broken, and the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed.

The Lord hated Esau and calls his people “The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Isaiah shows what that people does in the earth: “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” Esau weakens the nations.

How? Economic, political and military power. Look at what Donald Trump is doing in Venezuela and in Africa right now. They bombed Nigeria on Christmas Day and claimed it was to protect Christians from persecution. They bombed Venezuela and claimed it was to stop drug trafficking, while Mexico, on America's own border, has more drug cartels than any place in the world. They want the oil. Later Trump said it plainly, return the oil to our land, as if Venezuela ever stole oil or land from America. The rich think the poor are stupid and will believe anything, and our people believe it.

And America always puts a black face on it. Before they attacked Iraq it was Colin Powell, lying about weapons of mass destruction. Before they bombed a black nation for its oil, they did not pick a lawyer, a doctor or an engineer. They picked a hoe, the same black woman who was shaking her behind, reading what they told her to read about defending Christians in Nigeria. That is the ultimate disrespect to black people.

The hypocrisy is plain. In Jerusalem the so-called Jews say they spit on the ground when they see a crucifix, call for killing Christians, and spit in a Christian woman's face in the street, and nobody bombs them to defend Christians. There is no truth in the white man. If he says look up, you better look down.

Micah shows the same people: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand. And they covet fields, and take them by violence.” The oil in Nigeria and Venezuela, the diamonds and the copper in Africa. America was built by violence on stolen land. That is Lucifer weakening the nations, and why God says, “Never trust thine enemy.”

“And I hated Esau.” God said he hates Esau, and Esau is the white man. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” That is the rebirth, the Renaissance: we will build. “They shall build, but I will throw down”, which they call the dark ages, “and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

Keep in mind it says the people. A lot of us think they are not the same. Oh, they are the same, from the little baby all the way to the oldest. Some of them are more iced than others and show it more, but make no mistake: every single one of them hates your guts. They are all Edomites, the same people.

David shows what God says to that wicked people: “But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” Esau is the wicked. Esau has no business opening the Bible at all.

That is why it makes no sense for an Israelite to go into a debate with Esau over the Bible. We teach that the scripture says Esau is not going to get the kingdom. Why would I debate him over John 3:16 to prove to him he is going to get the kingdom? Do not be concerned with Esau. He is not even supposed to open the Bible.

Micah says, “And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” They covet the oil in Nigeria and Venezuela, the diamonds and copper in all the African countries, and take them by violence. America was built by violence: this is stolen land, and millions of indigenous people died for it. After they killed, murdered and raped, they built churches and said, God so loved the world.

Job describes the same man: “Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”. Esau has oppressed, and we are the poor.

He violently took away houses he did not build. In the South, in Georgia, they drove whole black communities out of places like Lake Lanier and Forsyth and took the houses and businesses they never worked for, and they are still finding ways to take land that has been in black families for a century. When Esau came into Africa, King Leopold killed millions of our people, and the beauty of Europe was paid for with that. It is still happening: the wars in Sudan and the Congo, the minerals in the iPhone in your hand. He throws the rock and hides his hand, then says, black people killing black people. But black people don't make the weapons.

The dumb Christian says it was a long time ago. But every September 11 they want a moment of silence. It is not a long time ago; he is still violently taking away houses he builded not.

They tell you plainly they are the evil seed, and you can believe them if you want to, but they ain't fooling us. God said: “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Never trust our enemies.

Then Micah shows the enemy at work: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds!” That is Esau. In his sleep he is thinking, when I wake up, what type of evil am I going to do? “when the morning is light, they practise it”: he gets up and practises the same evil he was thinking of the night before, “because it is in the power of their hand.”

Picture it: we are going to steal the oil in Nigeria; let's say we are going in to defend the Christians. Nigeria is a black country, and if white men go in, they will be called racist. So find me a dumb black woman, the biggest hoe, one with millions of followers that dumb black people will believe, like Nicki Minaj, and put her up front. That is devising iniquity on the bed and practising it in the morning.

His wickedness rusts through everything like iron rusts. So never trust him when he says he is defending you, and never trust the peace he talks about.

“And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations.” Some do not understand what that power is going to give us, so Isaiah shows it. Read verse 16 first: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” That is talking about the nuclear weapon.

Then: “No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper.” Think about it: Esau shoots a nuclear weapon and you walk right through it. That is what you call power. When he says power, some of you have no idea what that means. That is power.

Can their weapons prosper against us today? Yes. That is why we must wait for that power. And it goes on: “and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” In that day, let me hear somebody rise against us with his tongue. I double dare you. Every tongue will be condemned.

“This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.” This is our heritage. We are the servants, and our righteousness is of the Most High.

So overcome whatever you are fighting: drug addiction, alcohol addiction, woman addiction, men addiction. Keep his works, his laws, unto the end, which is either you die in this or Christ comes back. Now is not the time to pick up knives and guns; a gun or a little knife cannot do anything but get you killed. We wait in faith for that spiritual power, and then we rule the nations with a rod of iron and break them to shivers like the vessels of a potter.

He that overcomes and keeps Christ's works unto the end gets “power over the nations”, to “rule them with a rod of iron.” No weapon formed against us will prosper, and Psalm 91 goes with that: “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.”

The arrow that flieth by day is the missile. Read on: “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side.” What weapon do you think can do that? A gun cannot do that. That is nuclear destruction, and it is not going to touch you.

A thousand at thy side, “and ten thousand at thy right hand.” Think about it: you stand there, ten thousand people drop dead, and nothing can affect you. That is the type of power the Lord will give to him that overcometh.

That is why we must overcome and wait. I want that power to rule the nations, to break them just like they break us. But it is not talking about right now. We must have faith and wait for that spiritual power, and in that day nothing the nations send against us will come nigh us.

“Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel.” It is not saying a woman can’t have the outward adorning. Some think a woman has to look bummy and can’t get dressed up. Sisters can plait their heads and get fixed up; just don’t let your glory be in that, because a woman can be all hooked up and her spirit rotten. “But let it be the hidden man of the heart”, meaning Christ is in her spirit, “even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.”

What that hidden adorning sounds like, Sirach tells: “If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men.” A man who has a woman like this is not like most men, who don’t have it. That shows how rare this spirit is. Some brothers hear that verse and melt, because they don’t have it: do women like this even exist? Ask a sister and she can name twenty things she doesn’t like about her husband, but has to rack her brain for one or two good things.

Meek means obedience. Not always screaming, arguing and fighting, when the man just got through dealing with all that in the street and is the one making sure you have a house over your head and heat; you are biting the hand that feeds you. “For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord.” She adorned herself with subjection to her husband, and that is of great price, far above rubies. Not my lord on the phone with the sisters and cursing him as soon as the phone hangs up.

Beauty is corruptible, the clothes are corruptible; those things fade. A righteous spirit stays with you, and that is how you grow old in righteousness together watching the grandkids. Your inner spirit makes your outside look good. When you find a woman with kindness, meekness and comfort in her tongue, you will have paradise in your marriage and not a prison marriage, because husband and wife is the beginning, the nucleus of everything.

“For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband”. The espousal was made when the Most High sent his son Christ, because Christ died for us, his woman. We are the woman of the Most High. We are men physically, but we are his bride, and that is why Paul uses that term.

He cleaned us up. Sanctified them through thy truth; thy word is truth. Once he cleaned us up, we became virgins with him: “that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.” That is crystal clear. It is what 2 Corinthians 5:17 means: “if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away”.

There is such a thing as history, but your history only comes up if you keep doing what you used to do. Then it becomes a blot on your record today. None of us was born in this truth, so whatever you sisters went through, and the same with you brothers, clean yourselves up while you are here. All of us have a chance to get ourselves correct.

Once the slate is cleaned, we do not dirty it up. We do not defile it or mess it up. That is how we stay a chaste virgin espoused to Christ.

“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins.” That does not necessarily mean they are virgins physically. They are virgins in this truth. They put off the weak nature, the sins and the cares of the world. They are the ones that came in and repented, the new creature of 2 Corinthians 5:17, where old things are passed away and all things are become new.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men”: redeemed from among the filth. To be redeemed means you were in the filth, in the vomit, at a serious deficit, and you had to be brought up out of it. We were redeemed from that, “being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.” We have been cleaned up for the Lord, men and women, so we have a chance and an opportunity to get it right.

“And in their mouth was found no guile”: no lies, “for they are without fault before the throne of God.” How can that be? Only when you are keeping the commandments of God and the faith of Christ.

So watch how you move. Replay your own actions in your mind, see how you are operating, and catch yourself, because there is an effort to take us off our path. The virgins who follow the Lamb keep the slate clean.

God shall bring every secret thing into judgment, and the Lord even calls a bird to bring it out: “Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.” We have sat in judgments where they asked, how did he find out? It's that damn bird. Somebody might think it's a literal bird flying around; I took every precaution. But the Most High is going to bring it out anyway. That's why it says every secret thing.

No, not in thy thought. Some people speak against the council and the leadership, or have evil thoughts against the leaders, and think they will get away with it. The Most High put leadership to watch over you, and that is not an easy job. Leaders must give an account, good or bad. The goal is to give a good account: the brother came in one way and now he is a man of valor, married, moving in the right direction; the sister listened to counsel and got herself together. When they will not take counsel, the leader still has to give an account, with grief.

This is how we should have grown up. We grew up in a lawless society; in slavery the fathers were stripped from the homes and the men forced to give their seed but not allowed to raise it. The matter will be told on you in your evil, so fear God, keep his commandments, and honor the ones set over you.

Verse 13 gives the whole duty of man; verse 14 gives the reason: “For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.” For means because. Keep his commandments, because this is the whole reason God put man on the earth, and because God shall bring every work into judgment.

So if we are not dealing with our marriages properly, there is going to be a judgment for that, and we are looking at it. People try to figure out the problem in the black community: the marriages are messed up. Whoring, adultery, fornication. A little leaven will destroy the whole congregation, and it has to be rooted out like a cancer.

“with every secret thing”: the nasty stuff people do behind closed doors, thinking nobody sees. In nearly 35 years in this truth, we have seen the Most High bring out what people thought they could hide, and he brings it out at the worst time for you. Like applying for a job years later, thinking you got away with it, and they pull records you didn't know existed: get out of my office. That's how the Lord is.

So keep your slate clean. Be a disciplined man: you may not always be motivated, but you must always be disciplined. When sin comes before you, it stops right there. Because every work, good or evil, is going to come out, we have to be men of holiness, integrity, righteousness, dignity, honor and valor. That is the whole duty of man.

“Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” Man was put on this earth to rule it with God's commandments, and because we are not doing that, the earth is suffering; we are not in power. The earth was made to receive your direction, men.

Paul shows it: “For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.” Expectation means I am expecting something, and earnestly means with a begging type of attitude. The creation is earnestly waiting for the manifestation, and manifestation means the growth: time for us to stop being kids and manifest into men, to get ourselves together. The earth is waiting for the sons of God to manifest into gods, that is, to rule this planet properly.

And righteous women are waiting for that too. The woman is called woman because she is of man, and she is like the earth: you plant your seed in her and she brings forth fruit, but she needs your guidance. She is supposed to revolve around you, and when you are not in rulership she is out of orbit, like a satellite floating in space with no direction. That is why women cry, where are our black men? The father figure in the house got destroyed.

All of it fell apart when we broke the laws of the Most High from the very beginning, when the woman was out of order with her husband. So it is up to us men to fulfil the duty of manhood to fix it: to marry, build a nation, and rule rightly. That is what the whole creation is waiting on.

“And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?” Where are you, Adam? I put you down here to rule this earth, and now I'm looking for you. “And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked”. He was afraid because he knew he had messed up. Naked means exposed to sin. They were not running around without clothes; they were never supposed to have the knowledge of sin, and now sin was in them. And Satan showed it to Eve first.

To show what Satan did, the class read how he tempted Christ, from Luke 4. Christ was “led by the Spirit into the wilderness, Being forty days tempted of the devil.” That is what brothers are going to go through: you will be tempted, and a man is supposed to be able to resist temptation. Women are not as strong as men, which is why she is supposed to look up to you. Christ resisted.

First the bread: “If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.” You have the power, so why sit here hungry? It was an attempt to make Christ forget why he was fasting, the way a cupboard full of food tempts you to forget your purpose. “It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.” Women will forget the course they are on, and that is why men have to protect her. She is in serious trouble without a husband.

Then Satan raised the stakes: “And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” That is what Satan did to Eve. He likely hit her several times while she resisted, and then showed her something greater: you do not have to be under your husband; a time will come when you will be over him. He showed her America, with the man serving her, selling drugs for her, committing crimes for her, worshipping her. She spiritually fornicated with Satan, and brought it back to Adam with her beauty, without telling him about the death, and he took the bait.

When the reckoning came, Adam blamed her: “The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.” It was not her fault; God put him over her, and Adam did not have to listen. Then she blamed the serpent: “The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.” The family unit was attacked. The family is the backbone of the nation, and once husband and wife violate each other's roles they work against each other instead of for each other, and the children come out confused and troubled. That destruction came down through the generations to husbands and wives today. Men must restore the order and bring back our civility.

“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things”. The Lord gave us the abundance of all things, and we did not want to serve him for it. So he caused us to serve our enemies, and that is why we ended up falling underneath these people. That is not where our position is supposed to be.

Before we went into captivity we were celebrating the gods of the nations, and the Lord had a problem with that. Psalms 96:5 is his message and warning to us: “For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.” Our God made everything; that is the God we are connected with. So-called Christmas, Thanksgiving and so-called New Year's are pagan, evil hella days, not holy days. How can you talk about Thanksgiving on stolen land?

We are not the nations. “He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.” “He hath not dealt so with any nation”. Our customs are his statutes and judgments; we have the Bible, not idols. And Jeremiah 10 says, “Hear ye the word which the Lord speaketh unto you, O house of Israel”, “Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.” Astrology, witchcraft and voodoo are the nations' problem, not ours. The Israelites are a special people, set above the nations, the jewels of God, and you have to see yourselves that way.

“For the customs of the people are vain”, void of anything credible: “one cutteth a tree out of the forest”, and “They deck it with silver and with gold”. That was the custom in the Babylonian empire, four empires before Christ was born in the time of Rome. What do lights, tin and silver on a tree have to do with Christ? Nothing. It is Sol Invictus, the unconquered sun, sun worship commemorating Nimrod, Tammuz, whom the women wept for in Ezekiel 8, celebrated on December 25th. Our people know Christ has nothing to do with it, the same way the Bible gives no white Jesus, but they will not stand up for truth.

Serving the gods of the nations instead of serving the Lord with gladness is what put us under our enemies. Anybody who continues to celebrate that madness now knows better and will be judged by the Most High.

Abib, or Aviv, means spring: the season when the young, tender barley ears first appear, marking the start of the religious new year around March or April in the Gregorian calendar, the time of the Passover and the firstfruits offering, signifying renewal and freedom from Egypt. “That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name”. Possess means own. We are going to own the remnant of Edom and all the nations. There may be some rebellious heathen out there: “And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.”

That is judgment. No rain means famine, no rain means dearth, no rain means death. Read on: “And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.”

So when Acts 15 says “That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called”, it is not an open door where everyone is equal. “and think to change times and laws”. They changed the time with daylight saving time. They moved the beginning of the year from spring to January. Where did the washing come from? Exodus 30:19: “For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat”. The priests washed at the laver. This is where John the Baptist got it from.

They will always be there. But we are not going to need that light, because we are going to be on another level: a spiritual level, a god level.

Revelation shows the same thing: “And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.” That is what we just read in Isaiah 60:19.

The city is “the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.” That is what Christ meant when he said, Thy kingdom come. It “had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.”

“Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.” Everything goes back to the way it was. Israel in the kingdom lives in the light of the Lamb, and the days of our mourning are ended.

“And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.” People use this to say all the nations will be saved. But saved does not mean salvation here; it is in the context of rulership. Saved from what?

The precept is Zechariah: “And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.” Saved means left: they were left from being destroyed. Christ did not destroy them, and they are going to obey. Walking in the light of it means they serve the King and keep the feast of tabernacles.

“and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it”, as Isaiah says: “Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.”

“And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.” Those nations do not walk in. They bring it to us at the front gate, and then they go back. Those written in the Lamb’s book of life are the twelve tribes of Israel.

“God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.” See that little g: that is us. Asaph, with the Holy Spirit on him, records what we did wrong as the gods of the earth: “How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?” So we walk on in gross darkness, and “all the foundations of the earth are out of course.” Everything is wrong. What is out of course because of our sins? Go to Genesis: “And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night.”

Now Isaiah shows the kingdom: “Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days.” Does the sun have phases of transition? No. So in the kingdom the moon, which is a sign of the world, will not go back into darkness again. It is going to stay right. And the sun we say is so bright is not bright at all next to what it will be: sevenfold.

It is “in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.” Binding up the breach means gathering the twelve tribes of Israel back again. Acts 15 quotes the prophets: “After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down.” And Amos says, “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof.” Right now it is still fallen; we are trying to gather ourselves together. He will build us as in the days of old, that we may possess, own, the remnant of Edom and all the heathen.

The moon's phases started when Adam fell: the quarters, then the black moon, then it comes back. Before the fall it did not phase. That is why Israel is told, “Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day”: when that brightness returns, we celebrate the Most High, because this is how it was in the beginning. When the Lord binds up the breach, the lights will be set back in course, and the moon will shine as the sun.

“And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another”. Esau rejoiced over our downfall and made merry, as in Merry Christmas. We always thought, we were the gifts, and the history shows it: when Count Frederick von Hanau acquired a large part of what is now Suriname from the Dutch West India Company, he also received as a gift an Angolan man. They sent us around as gifts. Our sons, our daughters, our mothers and fathers were the gifts, because the two prophets, the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, tormented them; we didn't play with Esau.

The Ecclesiastes called for at this moment is Solomon's word: “I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” See that right there. The young Black Israelites in those European paintings were supposed to be the princes over Spain and Portugal, and they became servants to the white man: children snatched from their mothers, baptized and made slaves, holding the umbrella, the mirror, tending the horses and cattle.

So when you go into museums in America, France and England and see a picture of a little Black boy holding an umbrella, don't say, oh, look at that cute little Black boy. Now you know the history as it was: those were their slaves, the Moors, the Black Jews of Spain and Portugal, separated from their parents and given a limited education so they could be dumbed down. Princes walking as servants, and nations making merry and sending them one to another as gifts.

John “saw a beast rise up out of the sea”. When the Bible talks about a beast, it is talking about a race of men. Solomon says so: “I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” Men are beasts.

So the beast of Revelation 13 is not a monster; it is a nation of men rising up out of the peoples of the world. It has seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, with America the eighth. Its ten horns are European nations: Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland. Upon its heads is “the name of blasphemy”, and blasphemy means wicked lies against God.

And this beast carries the attributes of the beasts of Daniel 7: like a leopard, which is Greece; with the feet of a bear, the Persian and Median empire; and the mouth of a lion, ancient Babylon. The dragon, Satan, gives it its power, its seat and great authority. That is why things in the history of the Greeks, Persia and Babylon are being fulfilled again in these last days.

The beast rises “up out of the sea”. What is the sea? Revelation explains it: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.”

So when John says, “I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea”, he is witnessing the rise of a nation of men out of the peoples of the world. The beast is a race of men, as Ecclesiastes 3:18 shows, and the sea it comes out of is the peoples, multitudes, nations and tongues.

That nation has seven heads and ten horns, the European powers: the heads Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, with America the eighth, and the ten horns the nations of Europe. One of its heads was wounded to death: Rome, in 193 AD, when Septimius Severus, Rome's first African emperor, took the throne and the Dark Ages were ushered in. The sea is the nations, and out of them rose this European beast.

Psalms 2 goes on after the Father gives Christ the heathen for his inheritance: “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings”. Who are these kings? Revelation shows you: Christ “hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father”.

That is a message to us, advice and a command: be wise, O ye kings. “Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.” Christ is calling us judges of the earth. We might look like knuckles right now, but just give us time.

Paul says the same thing: “Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world?” And the saints are not everybody who believes on Jesus: “the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel”. The saints are the Israelites, and the Israelites will judge this planet. Christ said the twelve that followed him “shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

So being heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ means being made kings and priests, the rulers and judges of the earth with him. If that is our future, Paul asks, why can we not judge the smallest matters among ourselves now? Be wise, be instructed, and endure.

In Psalms 2 the Father says to Christ, “Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession. Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.” Christ is going to inherit all these nations and rule the planet.

All that Christ was given, we share, because we are “joint-heirs with Christ”. That is what a joint heir is: what Christ gets, he is going to give to us. Here is the proof: “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron”.

This is what we read in Psalms 2 that Christ is going to get, but because we are joint heirs, we are going to get it too. “As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.” The same honor and glory the Father gave to Christ, Christ says, I am going to give you that same power.

All we have to do, brothers, is endure to the end. “If so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together”: he that overcometh and keepeth his works unto the end is the one who receives power over the nations.

What is “a sign of the world”? One answer given from 2 Esdras 6:9, that Esau is the end of the world and Jacob the beginning of the world that follows, is that the sign of the world goes into our rulership and their destruction. That is not 100% wrong, and it should not be discounted.

The fuller understanding is this. The moon at its full is when we were in our full power and full understanding, in the kingdom. As it wanes and gets dark, it is us going into captivity, into full darkness. And once it gets back to fullness, it is us going back into our glory, back into the kingdom. That is the passing from Esau's world to Jacob's.

The moon's phases represent the stages the world is in: “a light that decreaseth in her perfection”, “increasing wonderfully in her changing”. And in the kingdom it will not wane again: “the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun”, and the sun has no phases. When Jacob's world follows Esau's, there is no going back into darkness.

Moses blesses Joseph: “Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,” “And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon”. Joseph's sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, dwell on islands: the Puerto Ricans and the Cubans, among others.

The precious things of heaven are the rain; the deep that coucheth beneath is the oceans that give riches beneath the waters. There are certain fruits brought forth by the sun, and certain things that come forth only by moonlight on those islands, like the coquí frog, which is nocturnal and comes out especially under the moonlight, making its noise.

That blessing points to the moon at its peak, what they call the full moon today, which is actually the new moon. That is what leads into Ecclesiasticus 43:6: “He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.”

“Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.” Arise means wake up; shine means teach; and the light that is come is Christ, who said, I am the light. “For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”. We are in the grossest of darkness; we have lost our heritage and lost everything. When you see the moon dark, that is what it represents: darkness has covered the whole world.

Psalms 82 shows the same darkness. “God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.” The little g is us. Asaph, with the Holy Spirit upon him, records what we did wrong as the gods of the earth: “How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?” We were to defend the poor and fatherless and deliver the needy, but “they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.” “I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” “But ye shall die like men”: our godhood was taken from us. “Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.”

Something in the heavens is out of course because of our sins. God made “two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night”. But in the kingdom, Isaiah 30:26: “Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.” The sun has no phases; in the kingdom the moon, the sign of the world, will not go dark again. And the sun we call so bright is not bright at all next to that.

Binding up the breach is Amos 9:11: “In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof”, gathering the twelve tribes of Israel back again. That is when Isaiah 60:1 is fulfilled: our light is come, the moon is back at its fullness, and Israel is back in the kingdom.

The moon serves “in her season for a declaration of times”. Leviticus 23 shows what those times are: “Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.” Convocations means gatherings.

The first holy day God tells Moses to list is the Sabbath: “Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest”, instituted from Genesis 2. Then: “These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.” He did not say seasons for the Sabbath, because the Sabbath is all year round. The ones that follow are seasonal holy days.

“In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord’s passover”, in the spring. Then the feast of unleavened bread on the fifteenth day; Pentecost, counting fifty days; “In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets”, which is the seventh new moon celebration; the day of atonement on the tenth day of the seventh month; and “The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles”.

So the “declaration of times” is the high holy days. “From the moon is the sign of feasts”: every feast is counted from the new moon, when it is in its brightness, because that is how it was in the kingdom.

“Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” Our children were snatched up, taken from us, and sold off to the highest bidder. Then verse 45: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed”. Why pursue? Because we tried to run from the curses: to Spain, to Italy, to Britain. Wherever we ran, the same curses followed: slavery, colonization, children sold off, enslaved and killed. They followed us and overtook us, down to the lowest state.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” These are generational curses. For you stupid, asinine apologetics asking what curses: these are not one-time curses, you imbeciles, you big dummy. They are constant. Upon thy seed means they repeat: when you are dead and gone, the same curse that fell upon you falls on your kids and your kids' kids. For ever means until the Lord says enough. To us it is 500 years; to the Lord it is a few seconds.

The record shows the sign on our seed. The ship captains carried a route map to the slave coast and insurance papers, so if we died or were thrown overboard as cargo, the owner was reimbursed; we were property. The owners told the captains which African ethnic group was preferred; they knew exactly whom they were taking, with the help of the Arabs and the Hamites. It was war, as Revelation 13 says he made war with the saints and overcame them, and we lost the war and became the slaves; if they had left us there, we would still be teaching that we are the children of Israel.

Children as young as two and three worked up to twenty hours a day; at the African Burial Ground in New York there are skeletons of three-year-olds with bones worn down to nothing. Solomon Northup told how the hands worked from light until too dark to see, and under the full moon until the middle of the night, with ten or fifteen minutes to swallow cold bacon. A slaveholder gave Christmas off so we would reverence it. The black child learned early that the world favored white and despised black, and the black mother learned that black men were powerless to protect her, which still affects our women today in the feminist mentality: we were both powerless.

The cry of a black mother as another child was separated from her and sold is Deuteronomy 28:41 before your eyes, as in the auction of Eliza, whose boy was sold away and whose little girl was kept back. That curse was upon us for a sign and a wonder, and it is still upon our seed until the Lord says enough.

When Paul was led into the castle, the chief captain asked, “Canst thou speak Greek? Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?” He took Paul for a specific Egyptian. “But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus”. Paul passed for an Egyptian. Moses passed for an Egyptian. Joseph passed for an Egyptian. Christ passed too: his family ran into Africa from white folks. What more do you possibly need at this point?

Jeremiah shows what Judah looked like: “Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.” Jeremiah is speaking of the same situation he wrote of in Lamentations, when Babylon came, overthrew us and starved us. We became blacker to the ground: dark, swelled bellies, ribs showing, ribs touching. That is how we looked when Babylon besieged us for those years.

Some try to say it is only symbolic. No: it is the same thing, and Jeremiah, who wrote Lamentations, is saying the same thing in both places. Calling it symbolic is simple and unfaithful and weak.

So the chief captain looking at a Jew and seeing an Egyptian makes sense. Judah was black, and a Jew of Tarsus could pass for an Egyptian because our people looked like the people of Africa. Israel sits in Western Asia bordering North Africa, one land mass, and all the native inhabitants of that region were nonwhite.

“They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.” They raped our women; they raped the Judahite sisters. This is not new. Whatever color the oppressor was, the nations all had the same habits, because judgment is like a ring: it recurs over and over again. Same game, different characters.

It is the curse of Deuteronomy 28:30: “Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her”. In The Butler, the master takes the boy's mother from the cotton field; she cannot say no; she screams, and the father and everyone in the field stand there powerless, unable to do a thing. In The Birth of a Nation, a guest demands Hark's new wife Esther for the night, and the master allows it; she comes out in tears, and he cries, Where is God now? That racial anger is what drove Nat Turner to take the axe to the master. We were powerless to protect our wives and our children. And “thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein”: we built the house and never dwelt in it.

That trauma is the madness of verse 28: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart”. Coming off those ships we were smitten with madness. In 12 Years a Slave, Patsey, beaten until her back was ripped open for a piece of soap because she could not stand her own smell, begs Solomon Northup to hold her under the water until she is without life, and to bury her in a lonely place; she has no comfort in this life. You cannot expect reparations to fix that. Blindness is spiritual: some watching right now say Jesus and the Jews are white; they are gone. “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways”, as a nation.

You millennials grew up thinking the white man is peaceful and loving and your friend. Malcolm X, Martin Luther King and our people of the 50s, 60s and 70s knew who the enemy was; after that we forgot and started saying the enemy is only a spiritual demon. They gave us Section 8, food stamps and Christianity, and we went back to sleep. So God is letting Trump and the administration behind him do evil, reverting the white man to his true nature, and JD Vance says they will no longer apologize for being white, so that we develop that racial anger again. That is why they want to remove this history from the museums and the schools. Let your children watch Roots, 12 Years a Slave, The Birth of a Nation, Amistad; the Holy Ghost brings all things to remembrance, and the scripture says what they did to our women in Zion.

Oppression makes a wise man mad. That is racial anger, and it is in the scriptures. Deuteronomy 28:33 gives the oppression: “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. That is what was told of the man brought to this side of the world. Then verse 34: “So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.”

You are going to be mad. Your eyes are going to be mad for what you see: the oppression, all the evil taking place against your people. You see your wife being raped and you cannot do anything. You see your people being lynched and you cannot do anything. You are just angry. The curse prophesied that anger.

So if you see your people oppressed and going through these things, and you are not mad, not angry, something is not right. You have shut down. There must be racial anger. Being mad at the sight of the oppression of our people is not a sin to be ashamed of; it is what the scripture said the oppression would do to us, and it is the wise response to what our eyes have seen.

The Greeks did it too. Under Antiochus, 1 Maccabees 1:60-61: “they put to death certain women, that had caused their children to be circumcised.” “And they hanged the infants about their necks, and rifled their houses, and slew them that had circumcised them.” After they killed the mothers, they hung the circumcised babies from their dead mothers' necks and put them on display for the people to see. They lynched our babies on their mothers' necks. It is the same persecution recorded of the mothers who circumcised their children and were led about the city with the babes at their breasts.

Esau was so demonic and wicked that he ran around checking who was circumcised, running through our houses and killing anyone who circumcised a child. Who does that? Demons.

That is Deuteronomy 28:66: “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life”. Keeping the law of God, circumcising your child as the covenant commands, could cost a mother her life and her baby's. It is the same spirit that hanged our princes, burned our mothers and crushed our babies here in America. Same game, different characters: judgment is like a ring, recurring over and over.

Peter and the apostles answered, “We ought to obey God rather than men”, and the mothers of the Maccabees did so to the death. Christ was hanged on a tree too; the King and his children have all hung under the same curse, until the Lord says enough.

“Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.” Princes hanged up means lynched. Young or old, it did not matter; you were hanged all the same.

That is what “thy life shall hang in doubt before thee” comes to. Hanging in doubt does mean you will wonder whether you live or die, worried day and night, in the hood, the ghetto and the slums, and further back in slavery and colonization: “In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning!” But it also means hanging. Lamentations 5 is the whole picture of the curse: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens”, the European, the East Indian and the Chinese man in Africa and Trinidad reaping our resources; “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us”, which is colonization; “Servants have ruled over us”, those who were once our slaves.

The Spaniards hanged the Americans thirteen at a time and set them on fire. Without Sanctuary, a book of lynching photographs, shows it: 1935, which was yesterday; postcards of our fore mothers and fathers hanging from trees; a man burned to pieces, his hands and legs cut off and kept as souvenirs; a mother and son hanged from a bridge in 1901. White people today say, I didn't do that, that was my ancestors. But look at the postcards: children, fathers, mothers, women right in the middle, the whole family supporting it, children who grew up to be your lawyers, teachers, mayors and police officers.

Mary Turner, in 1918, grieving her husband Hayes Turner, lynched without a trial, threatened to have his killers punished. The next day she was hanged from a tree, burned, her womb cut open; the baby, a month shy of being born, cried on the ground, and a member of the white mob crushed its head with his foot; then they shot her full of holes. Now they say they are not apologizing anymore. In Queens in 1976 white children chased little black girls out of their neighborhood with rocks and dogs, calling them niggers, and those children are judges, lawyers and police officers now. This is war.

Hanging is nothing new; the Persians did it (1 Esdras 6:32), “out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he thereon be hanged”. Christ himself was lynched: “whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.” Peter called the cross a tree, wood, where he hung for hours. “Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree”: Christ went under the curse along with us. The King and his children were hanged. Princes are hanged up by their hand.

“For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.” “How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?” We read it right there in the history of the slave ships.

Deuteronomy 28:68 says “the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. What does Egypt represent? “I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.” Egypt is bondage. The Lord would bring us into bondage again, this time by way of ships; literal Egypt we would see no more again as a nation, and there we would be sold to our enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, slave men and slave women.

The Middle Passage, the Maafa, a massive disaster: for fifty days or more our people were packed in spaces as tight as coffins, a second platform barely twenty inches above the heads of those below, chained to the floor, lying in their own waste, amid rats that gnawed through wood and flesh, on floors covered with blood and excrement, where pregnant women gave birth and the living awoke chained to the dead. Tight packers crammed in as many as possible, reckoning the sales would offset the dead. The meal was horse beans pounded to a pulp with slabber sauce, once or twice a day, and a pint of water. Dumb negroes say it never happened and ask where the ships are: cargo ships carried spices and corn before us, carried us as cargo, and after slavery carried cargo again. Why get rid of them?

Then came the dancing of the slaves: the crew played the bagpipe or forced our ancestors to beat out a rhythm while they jumped about, ankles rubbed raw by the leg irons, to keep the human cargo in salable condition. That is Psalms 137:3: those who carried us away captive required of us mirth. At night the cries rose; an enslaved woman explained the howling came from having dreamt they were in their own country and waking in the hold of a slave ship. A strange land indeed.

Millions were carried from Africa to the West Indies, North and South America and Europe, from Luanda, from the Congo, from Loango, where the old maps mark the Jews; the buyers and sellers both knew they were selling outsiders, not the same people. Deuteronomy 28:68 and Psalms 137:3 were fulfilled on those ships.

Exodus 21 shows what Israel was doing. Of a maidservant: “to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her”. Why is that written? Because we would sell our own people off to the heathen for money, being rebellious, evil and stupid. Then verse 16: “And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death”. We were doing it, and you got death for it.

Paul brings the same law forward: “Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient”, and he lists them: “For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind”, the homosexuals, “for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine”.

Menstealers goes straight back to Exodus 21:16, stealing people for slavery. In Christ, a man who was a trafficker back then could repent. But if you are involved in child trafficking today, get out of that nonsense.

And that is our history. Loango Bay, where the Portuguese traders came, was on the old maps called the Jews' Bay, because the Jews were there. From that West Central African coast, Loango and Angola, nearly half of all the captives in the Atlantic slave trade were shipped to the Americas and the Caribbean. Menstealing is what was done to us, and the law says the man who did it should surely be put to death.

“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph”. This new king set taskmasters over Israel to afflict them with burdens, and then went further: “And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive”.

That is gator bait. They sacrificed our baby boys in the river to Sobek, the gator god. The white man did the exact same thing to us in the Florida Everglades: put our babies in a net, wait for the alligator to bite, pull the gator out and make shoes and bags out of him. Egypt did it to us first. They killed the males and kept the women alive, because the women do not produce the nation; the man does.

That decree is why Moses was hidden three months and laid in an ark of bulrushes by the river's brink, and why everything that follows was done in secret. When Pharaoh's daughter came down to the river in Exodus 2:5 and found the ark, she found one of the very sons her father had ordered cast into the river.

When Pharaoh's daughter opened the ark, “she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children”. How did she know? He was circumcised. You never read about Moses getting circumcised; he was already cut, because some of our forefathers retained that custom from our fathers. Outside of that, she would not have known the difference, because Egyptians and Hebrews were both black.

The kingdom of heaven is the nation of Israel. That is why the apostles asked in Acts whether Christ would at that time restore the kingdom to Israel, and why the Pharisees asked when it would come. “The kingdom of God cometh not with observation”. We look for it to come from somewhere outside. We externalize everything instead of taking up what is already in us. The Lord put a mind and a spirit in us to build and to organize.

You were made after the image of your Father, and Genesis shows how he created. “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. And the earth was without form and void”. The earth did not yet exist physically, but it existed in God's mind. If he calls it earth, it existed; it existed in his mind. “and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.” Israel is in North America and all through this hemisphere, and 2 Esdras speaks of the ten tribes coming to this side of the world.

So get your mind right and get your mind together, so you can prepare for the second coming of Christ. No matter what happens in this place, do not get caught up in foolishness. Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel”. God is talking to us. Don't be afraid; he is going to help us.

Read on: “Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff”. Don't get caught up in the foolishness of this place, the marches and the stupidity, even with your own family. Stay in the scripture, cast down every evil imagination in the minds of our people, and bring every thought “to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah. The man of war fights for us.

“Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors. Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else.” Only God is “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” Where do you find God’s counsel? The Bible. Whatever the scripture says, the prophecy is going to happen. Forget the dumb pastors and dumb Christians who do not know anything.

Amos shows who is behind what is happening: “Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The trumpet is the Bible. And yes, there is evil in America, and the Lord has done it.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” We are the prophets. Our job, brothers, is to prepare our people for what is coming. Our job is not to pick up guns and knives thinking you can do something to the white man; this man will wipe you out just like that. Our job is to bring the people back to Messiah and prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah, revealing the Bible plainly so they may repent. Wait on the Lord.

“come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion, and our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: what is coming, and how to fix your spirit and build yourself up. To our brothers and sisters in Venezuela: repent. You cannot stop the white man; let him do what he was supposed to do. The evil in the city is the Lord’s counsel standing, and it is revealed to his prophets.

“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” That is Esau: no more throne, no more power. She calls herself a virgin, and Nahum shows what she really is.

“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery.” This is the bloody city right here. America is full of lies and robbery: they rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” America is that harlot. She destroys families and destroys nations and calls it democracy, bringing freedom, yet does not follow it herself. She sanctions the International Court of Justice when it brings charges against Netanyahu; that court was made to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face.” God is against this place. He is going to discover America’s skirts and reveal her wickedness: America is not a virgin, she is a hoe who has been sleeping with everybody. “and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” He is going to show the whole world how evil this place is.

For centuries they murdered, killed and robbed with no cameras, and said, “None seeth me.” Now social media records it and people see the evil in Venezuela, and still they look at the camera and say that is not what happened. The virgin daughter of Babylon who says none seeth me will have her nakedness uncovered before the nations, and through that, our deliverance and our salvation are coming.

“The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion. Our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: to bring the people back to the Most High, to reveal the Bible plainly to our people that they may repent, and to prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah. Fix your spirit, build yourself up, and wait on the Lord.

Christ said, “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” We are seeing that today. Do not be troubled by it. If you want salvation, if you want to see the return of Christ, those things must come to pass.

So our job is not to pick up a gun or a knife against this man. He will wipe you out just like that. The brothers and sisters in Venezuela must repent; they cannot stop the white man, so let them do what they are going to do, come out of the churches and stop being fooled by the pastors.

“but the end is not yet.” Right now the northern kingdom is on the front line, but do not think they will not come after the southern kingdom too. A time is coming when they come after us, and some will be put to death, some set up by the man smiling next to them saying shalom, paid to take them down. Read on: “For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.” We see nation rising against nation now. That is why we declare in Zion what is coming and how to prepare for it.

“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” To supplant is to betray, to plot. Job knew what it is to be betrayed by those closest to him: “All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.”

That is how Maduro was taken in Venezuela. It was betrayal from within. His own elite bodyguards, handpicked for their loyalty and trained to take a bullet for him, took American money instead. The outer guards were told to stand down, the cameras and alarms were disabled, and the last two bodyguards surrendered without firing a single shot. The same thing happened to Jovenel in Haiti. Those were our people, the northern kingdom, and they handed him over. And Esau planned it for more than a year, studying who could be turned: one with a sick daughter, one bitter that others were promoted over him, one disillusioned.

The same spirit is among us. Other Israelite camps want to destroy IUIC by slandering the members and the leadership, because black people will believe anything without proof. They slander the Bishop, the deacons and the captains every chance they get, and then come to the door asking to fellowship. We are good. We don't believe the same thing, and we will never come together with them.

And inside: the brother who says, why is he a captain, I know more scripture than him, why do the young men always travel with the Bishop? Maybe the young men are thirstier for the word than you. They know they don't know everything; you think you know it all. Fix that spirit, or you will be the next traitor, the inward friend turned against those who loved him. God hates a traitor.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” The last part is the point: the kisses of an enemy are deceitful. And Luke shows the kiss: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Judas betrayed Christ with a kiss. The man betrayed him with the very sign of love.

Today we do not greet each other with a kiss like that, but we have our own greeting: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That is the betrayal. The embrace, the salute, the Shalom, and then the knife. That is the kiss of an enemy.

We saw it in 2018. A man who had been in another man’s house, greeting him with Shalom, barbecuing together, traveling together, came to that same man’s house, took all his furniture and put his children on the cold floor to sleep. He did not care. Not only did he betray the man, he betrayed all his children.

There is nothing worse than a traitor. And some of you think once you betray your brother or your sister, that is the end of it. It is not. The one who betrays with a kiss will be dealt with too. That is why the kisses of an enemy are called deceitful: Judas is the pattern of the familiar hand that destroys.

“For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it.” It was not the enemy that set David up, or he would have been ready, because he knows who the enemy is. “But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance. We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.” It was the man he trusted, the man he went fishing with, and that took him by surprise. Later in the same psalm David describes that man: “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.”

A man mine equal: an officer of ten, of twenty, of fifty, just like me. We took sweet counsel together: Deacon, I need counsel; Captain, what do you think about this? But while he was taking counsel, he was plotting. Some are plotting to take your wife: she is too beautiful for him. Some are plotting to take your position at the job you brought them into, telling the white man, give me his position. I picked him up every Sabbath and every Wednesday, and when he came to betray me he had no problem doing it.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” Christ was betrayed that way: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Today we do not kiss, but we dap: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That smooth greeting can be the betrayal. In 2018 a man who sat in another man's house, barbecued and travelled with him, came and took all his furniture and put his children to sleep on the cold floor.

Jeremiah warns: “Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” Supplant means betray, plot. Other camps slander our members and leadership, because they know our people believe anything without proof; they are Esau in black skin, who “have taught their tongue to speak lies.” They come asking to fellowship, but we are not stupid.

It was not the enemy that killed Thomas Sankara; it was his best friend, who grew up with him. It was Maduro's own handpicked bodyguards who stood down and handed him over, taking American money instead of a bullet for him. That is war in the heart behind smooth words.
