Deuteronomy 7:6 says the Lord chose Israel “to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” Deuteronomy 28:1 says it as well, with the condition attached: “if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth.”

If God says we are above all people and above all nations, then why can we not do the things we have a concrete visual example of other nations doing, and doing for decades? When one of the Amish gets married, the community comes together and builds a house for that couple, and there is no mortgage attached to it. They do not even have power cars. We have enough knowledge, enough builders, plumbers and concrete men; we can do this too, at a higher level.

It is going to take work to build this kingdom: work, and faith that we can do the work, shown by our actions. We need to fix our credit scores, fix our health, learn group economics, and work together in the trades, so that when the tough times come, losing your job because of your last name or because you are tracked, we have things set up to help each other.

This is the highway of the upright, the Israelite's strait journey. Ezra saw that “A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things”, but “The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall”, with fire on the right hand and deep water on the left, and one path “so small that there could but one man go there at once.” That city is the kingdom of heaven, and we must pass through all these things in this captivity to inherit it.

At the end of it, “the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.” We were ransomed out to the nations, but we are returning and gathering together. Being set on high above all nations is the promise to the people who hearken and do the work.

Looking on the things of others means building something together, and economics must be part of our mindset as we walk to build a nation. Solomon says: “For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.”

Wisdom is a defence: generational wisdom passed down from father to son, grandfather to son. Esau has law in his house, and the grandfather passes the torch and teaches hard lessons that save heartache; that is why they had the head start, and why they are so relaxed at their jobs. We are behind in everything. Half of black folks have a credit score below 620, locked out of access to capital; before we wake up in the morning, half of us are in bondage.

Money is a defence. Walking the commandments, evil is going to come upon you: what happens when they take your job? So build businesses we can self-employ in, food distribution, brothers helping each other. Teach your children about secured loans and secured credit cards and the three credit bureaus, Experian, TransUnion and Equifax. And a single, divorced brother paying out his money has less of a defence than a man married in proper order.

“wisdom giveth life to them that have it”, and to have it you have to be taught it. That is why they try to stop us from teaching that we are the twelve tribes of Israel: scattered, we lost our nationality, heritage and commandments. The father in the house, with Christ at his head, is the one to break that cycle.

“Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.” If I esteem you better than myself, then within my power I have to help you come up with a solution, or help provide it. “Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.” That does not mean just looking: yeah, he's struggling like hell. No. Look means action. “Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.” And Christ was no weak, effeminate man; he was a strong, powerful, upright man.

Paul says it plainly: “Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.” That is how we are going to rise. If twelve of you have cars that run fine and a brother in the body can't even fix his car, and you shut your mouth and do nothing, you are weak. That is not how our black men are supposed to stand. Israelites are commanded to help each other.

So every school should have its mechanics, carpenters, plumbers and electricians helping the people in the body, making videos so the next brother can do it too. Instead of paying $1,900 you pay $300 for the parts, and brothers with the spirit fix the car. That's alms deeds; that's helping your nation.

We used to have that. Black people used to speak to each other in the street because we had a commonality, a common struggle. Now we have fallen apart. Bearing one another's burdens is how the nation is gathered together and becomes an economic force: that is the mind of Christ and the law of Christ.

Paul says those who depart from the faith give “heed to seducing spirits.” Mark shows where that seducing spirit comes from: “For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.”

The false Christs and false prophets rise on TikTok and Instagram. These Christians under Israel's banner, the fake Israel's banner, get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. They rise “to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.” That lets us know there will be a seducing spirit in the last days to get us back into Christianity, back into colonialism, back into that damnable slave religion called Christianity. The seducing spirit that Mark, Matthew and Paul to Timothy all address is in these days.

Revelation names the three unclean spirits like frogs: out of the mouth of the dragon, politics; out of the mouth of the beast, the United States and its financial system; “and out of the mouth of the false prophet”, religion, which is Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles”, gathering the kings of the earth to the battle of that great day. So do not tell us the Bible is not true. If you want to play games and go back into Christianity, go; there are no bars on the door.

In the latter times “some shall depart from the faith.” Christ said the same in Matthew 24: “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.”

Many of you shall be offended. What are you going to do? You are going to betray the believing brothers and sisters, and you shall hate us. That is the departing from the faith Paul prophesied.

Read on: “And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” That is this Christianity. On TikTok everybody is a pastor: every man, every woman, every boy, every girl, out of nowhere. Those who depart from the faith are the ones who give heed to them, and they end up offended at the truth and betraying and hating the people who taught it to them.

“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.” This is a prophecy about the world's last religion, the one they will force on us, and some of you, men and women, will give yourselves to it. We are living in the latter times.

What are the doctrines of devils? “Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; Forbidding to marry.” Here is the clue: what religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity; they forbid their priests to marry. Then “commanding to abstain from meats”: Lent, forty days with no meat. Meats “which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.”

What is the truth? David answers: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” The truth is God's laws. Those who know the law receive what God created with thanksgiving; those seduced by doctrines of devils forbid to marry and abstain from meats.

Why do people get seduced into all this crap? Because they were idle, I-D-L-E, and they were given Christianity, an idol, I-D-O-L. Christianity is an idolatrous religion. The one who holds the law, the truth, will not depart from the faith.

“For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you”. Who is this great multitude that is over us? It is law enforcement, their military, set over the believing Israelites. Isaiah proves it.

“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof”. This Egypt is a spiritual Egypt: America. An altar is used for sacrifice, so there is going to be a lot of death. “And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors”.

Why would we cry unto the Lord? Because of the oppressors, with an s on it: more than one. That is the great multitude whose burning wrath is kindled over us. That is Jacob's trouble, and we have not gotten to that part yet.

So the great multitude of 2 Esdras 16 is the oppressors of Isaiah 19, the power of spiritual Egypt that will be over our people in this land, and it is because of them that Israel will cry unto the Lord.

Joel shows the same cry. “Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly”, and “Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

Why will we cry, Spare thy people? We just read it in Isaiah 19: because of the oppressors. They will say, we killed you, where is your God? We cut your throat, we ended your bank account, where is your God?

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.” He pities his people because we are not in the land. But he promises not to leave us alone: “Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil”, “and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen”.

“But I will remove far off from you the northern army”. That is the name the Bible gives to the power that is going to be on us: the oppressors of Isaiah 19, the great multitude of 2 Esdras 16, is the northern army. He will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, the Dead Sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, the Mediterranean, “and his stink shall come up”. The white man shall meet death when he goes to that land, because he has done evil things.

The great multitude “shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols.” Spell that word: i-d-l-e. “Send him to labour, that he be not idle; for idleness teacheth much evil.”

Idle means a person avoiding work: lazy, indolent, slothful, shiftless, inactive, sluggish, lethargic; without purpose or effect. Those words fit some of you in here, men and women. Not the new people who just came, but those who have been with us two years or more. What are you doing? Do you have an office? Is there something you are doing here in Israel? If not, you are idle, and idleness teaches much evil.

And what will the idle be fed? Things offered unto idols, i-d-o-l: an image or representation of a god used as an object of worship. Look at the images of the Roman Catholic Church; those are idols. One word: Christianity.

So the ones the multitude takes away and feeds with idolatry are the ones with no purpose in here. Because you were idle, you will be seduced and given Christianity, that idolatrous religion. Stay busy in the work of the Most High.

Being hated of all nations is not only for those who teach the Bible; Ezra shows who it will affect. “For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.” The elder world was paradise in the time of Adam. “If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.”

You have to enter those hard things to enter paradise. The angel is telling Ezra that if we don't go through the hardships of Jacob's trouble, we can never get paradise. If you decide to kill yourself before it happens, you cannot get paradise. If you say, I'm going to join another religion to escape punishment from these other nations, you will never receive it.

Read on: “Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide”. The righteous shall suffer hard things, that is Jacob's trouble, and hope for paradise. “for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.” The wicked Israelites are going through Jacob's trouble too, but they are not going to see the kingdom.

So when Christ said you shall be hated of all nations, it covers all Israel. Whether you teach or not, the strait things are coming; the only question is whether you come out of them into what is laid up for you. That is why you cannot run from the persecution when they command us not to teach in his name.

“And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad”. We saw persecution against our brothers in France; it hasn't gotten here yet, and they say America is the major hub. When it happens, can you stand the rain? That's why we say don't take the convocations lightly.

People read these things and say, oh, that's old time. But Solomon says: “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.” That's you and me. We read Maccabees and Acts 8:1 and say that could never happen again? You're simple as hell. What happened in 1 Maccabees 1 and Daniel 3 is what Revelation 13 speaks of, no buying and selling, and it leads to death.

Paul said the same thing: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Those old-time things were written for us to learn from, because they are going to happen again. We need patience and the comfort of the scriptures because we are going to go through what our ancestors went through: how did they deal with it, how did they survive?

Herod killed James and, because it pleased them, took Peter also. And Trump joked about bringing back public executions. The Christians don't understand what is about to come; in here we understand, because what has been is what shall be.

The rulers “commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus”, and again: “Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name?” We read that and say it could never happen in America. Don't fool yourself. It will happen here.

Christ warned it: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.” Imagine they shut your bank account down. Now you can't pay your rent, your mortgage, your car note; you lose your car, your home, and maybe your wife: that's what you get for teaching that Bible, don't block Jesus. Everybody says, I'm strong, I can go through it. Wait till that day, with a newborn baby and you can't get infant formula. Some will say, I'm going back to being a Christian so I can get access to my money.

That hatred starts with the followers of Christ, but it applies to all twelve tribes of Israel. Look at the news: black and brown people killed, and they cry, what did we do to these white people? Why did they kill Sandra Bland? Why did they kill Tamir Rice? Christ said you would be hated of all nations. Christ is our king whether you accept it or not, and the white man looks at you and says, these are the people of Christ. You are the children of God, and they are the children of the devil. You might not like it, but it's true.

Moses settles who Mount Seir is: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So when the Lord tells Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,” the prophecy is against Esau, Edom. “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee” means God is against Esau-Edom.

Mount Seir itself is the place called Petra today, and nobody lives there. It is a rock with the same Roman-style structures you see on courthouses in America. God is not prophesying against a rock. He is prophesying against the people who once lived there, wherever they have gone. “I will lay thy cities waste” speaks of the other cities Esau-Edom built, which God still calls Mount Seir. “I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys” means wherever Edom is, his great governments and his smaller ones.

Then God gives the reason: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”. Perpetual means everlasting. Our people ask why white folks hate us so, when we never did anything to them. God answers: they have always hated us, because that is how he made them. We thought our iniquity had an end at the so-called emancipation, and Edom made a new thing, the KKK, whose hoods, crosses and cross-burning came out of Spain and the Spanish Inquisition, when they were murdering black people, the Jews. Look at the capirotes of Spain and the KKK: the same damn thing, the same damn group. The whites from Spain brought that dress code to America and terrorized Negroes, and Negroes ain't put one and one together yet. That is why calling Christianity white supremacy is literal.

So God has prepared him: “I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”, a violent life and a coming destruction. “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. And the boast that condemns him: “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. Those two nations are Judah and Israel, and the two countries are Israel and America: Edom took America as Christians and took the land of Israel as the Jews.

Ezekiel 36:5 makes it plain: God has spoken “against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say Japheth took the land; it says Idumea. So you're either going to go with what God said or what some negro on YouTube says. The Bible says Edom and their own scholars say Edom, so why are negroes going, no, it's Japheth? Esau put these things in his own books because he only expected his own people to read them. Their scholars agree: medieval chroniclers said Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, and Benjamin of Tudela called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, which is Christianity. This whole chapter reveals which race took the land of Israel and the land called America: Esau-Edom.

Ezekiel 35:12 says God has heard all Edom’s blasphemies: “I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” Christ names that same blasphemy in Revelation: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.”

That is the blasphemy: Edom took over the land and said, it is given to us, we are the Jews. They are not the Jews, and the land is not theirs. Revelation 3:9 says it again: “I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie”. They are the devil the Bible speaks of, and it is the Son of God who said it.

The verse also speaks to our people: “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. That is our poverty, but we are rich, because we are the children of God.

“Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” By calling themselves Jews and claiming the land as Jews, Edom has boasted against God, and God heard every word. So “When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate”: when all creation is singing, Edom is destroyed. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”.

Our people share in the blasphemy too. Ezekiel 36:20 says that when Israel was scattered among the heathen “they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” Every black and Latino Christian who points at the people in the land and says, those are the Jews, profanes God’s name. It was prophesied that the Messiah would come through Edom’s religion, Christianity, as a lord bent on doing away with all moral restraints: keep no commandments, keep no laws. That is the religion of Edom, and Christ is its enemy.

Ezekiel 36:5 says Idumea “appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” They were happy to steal that land. With despiteful minds means they took it knowing, despite the fact, that it was not theirs and that they are not the Jews; they took it as the Jews and said God gave them that land. To cast it out for a prey means they called their fellow Europeans from Poland, from Czechoslovakia, from Germany, from Russia, from Uzbekistan: come and get some land. That is why you have all those funny-looking people over there. Their own scholars write that Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, Rome the Edomite capital, the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, and that religion is Christianity.

Then verse 19 shows how that could happen: “And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.” We were scattered amongst the heathen, dispersed through the countries, and God judged our people for our ways.

Read on: “And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” Wherever we went, we profaned God's holy name. How? When we said to the heathen, these are the people of the Lord: those are the Jews. All Black Christians say that. All Latino Christians say that, pointing at Amalek in the land and calling them the Jews. That is how we profane God's name.

So Idumea sits in our land with despiteful minds, and our own people, scattered and judged, stand beside them and call them God's people. The land was taken by Edom, and the lie was confirmed by Israel in its Christianity.

Paul marvels that they were “so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel”. In Paul's day the Pharisees were deceiving the people to go back to animal sacrifice and give their fealty, their loyalty, to Rome. It is “not another”, because they were using the same scriptures, but “there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ”: the scribes, Sadducees, Pharisees and Rome. What is Christianity today? A perversion of the truth of Christ: a white Jesus loved by Negroes and Latinos worshipping their oppressor. You are mad at white folks when they shoot you, then you go to church on Sunday and pray to white folks, and at Christmas and Easter you worship a white man again. It makes no sense.

Isaiah saw it: “Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me”. Praise God, praise Jesus, I love the Lord, yes I does. “but have removed their heart far from me”: you won't do a damn thing, not one law, not one commandment.

“and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men”. The white man taught us the Bible. The white man said you don't have to worship God on the Sabbath day, you can do it on Sunday; in fact God is a white man, and anything the white man says is absolute, and Negroes and Latinos bow to that.

So the Lord says “I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.” How? God is raising up the prophets. Christianity will not perish on its own; it perishes through you brothers out there teaching on the streets, doing the videos and the classes seven days a week. The white man they call the wise and prudent man will realize he does not know what he thinks he knows, because the Holy Spirit is in the Israelites, and it is through our teaching that our people are repenting.

“The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence.” The commentaries say this is about ancient times, but verse 1 lets you know it is future: the Lord coming into Egypt has not happened yet. So how do we know who this Egypt is?

Revelation tells us: “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.” The dead bodies are the Israelites, not literally dead but spiritually dead. The great city is Babylon the great, the United States of America. “which spiritually”: that is the key.

It is called Sodom because of the same-sex marriages, the transgenderism and all that filth in this country. It is not the real Sodom but a spiritual Sodom. And it is called Egypt: America knows its foundation is ancient Egypt. Look at the dollar bill: the pyramid, the all-seeing eye of Horus, 1776 at the bottom, Novus Ordo Seclorum, the New World Order, and the obelisk in Washington DC. America is aware that this is a spiritual Egypt; only the black and Latin Christians have not figured it out, and so they read the scriptures desperately confused.

“where also our Lord was crucified.” Christ was crucified in Jerusalem, but this is a spiritual crucifixion: they have crucified Christ’s image here and crucified his teachings here.

So Isaiah 19 is spiritual Egypt: “And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” Americans against Americans, a house divided: Democrats against Republicans, red cities against blue cities, white man against white man. There will be a civil war in this country.

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is saying, Stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee”: their generals, admirals and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome and create this missile and that missile. “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”: burnt up, destroyed, by nuclear fire, by God’s fire. “there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: no comfort for Babylon.

Peter shows that fire: “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire, and the perdition of ungodly men is Christianity and whatever other little religions are here.

The scoffers say, “Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” They purposely ignore the flood of Genesis 6, when God killed everybody on the planet except eight people: “For this they willingly are ignorant of.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain and his seed.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” The beloved is Israel: he “hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” It has been over three thousand years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. But “the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” That is the destiny of America and all nations.

“what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: our conversation must change. We see the signs, rivers dried up, presidents being stolen. We look for new heavens and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness, the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ, and we must be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless.

Isaiah tells the daughter of Babylon, “Take the millstones, and grind meal”. What does that mean? When you take millstones and grind meal, you are working. But what kind of work? Look at what happened to Samson.

Samson listened to that woman called Delilah, who got paid to take his strength and destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite, and she gave it to him so good that he told her his secrets and went to sleep on her knees. The Philistines came in, cut his hair, bound him up and took his eyes out: “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

When it says they made him grind, they made him work. That is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: look up the 13th Amendment.

So this is what God is saying to America, to these Europeans, these Caucasians: take the millstones and grind meal. Get ready for slavery. Then “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” As a tender and delicate virgin her head was covered; God says uncover it, lift the dress to the calf, then to the thigh. The rivers she passes over are the word of God, “the washing of water by the word”. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show she is not, revealing her wickedness.

That is why Jeremiah 47 goes on, “O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet?” The sword cannot be quiet, “seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” Gaza is the seashore. The judgment on the Philistines clears the coast for the remnant of Judah.

“O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.” A scabbard is the leather sheath you put a sword in. How long will judgment be quiet? “How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” The seashore is Gaza. The Lord gave the sword a charge, so judgment has to go forth, and missiles are coming there too.

Who is that sword? David tells us: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” The wicked is the sword of the Lord. That is why this class is called Donald Trump: the Sword of God. The Lord uses the wicked to bring judgment on the nations.

And it is judgment on all the nations, not just Esau. “Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.” Concerning the Ammonites, Ammon, the Japanese: “Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” Gad is mixed among them. So “I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap”, and “then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs.”

Then Babylon, which is America, and the land of the Chaldeans, Amalek, the so-called Israel: “Put yourselves in array against Babylon”, “spare no arrows”, “for it is the vengeance of the Lord.” Joel says, “Prepare war, wake up the mighty men”: China, America, Russia, Iran, all must go to war and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, where the Lord will sit to judge all the heathen round about.

When the sword has done its work, the land comes back to us: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah”, and “the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.” The house of Judah will live in Gaza. And when Babylon falls in one hour, we are told, “Rejoice over her”, “for God hath avenged you on her.”

Jeremiah's word is “against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America; the Chaldeans are Amalek, so-called Israel. And it is not just Esau: it is judgment on all the nations. “Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.” “for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.”

Joel shows who is called up to do it: “Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up”. The Gentiles are the other nations, and the Lord wants them to prepare war. China, America, Russia, Syria, France, Great Britain, Iran, Saudi Arabia: they all have to go to war. All you military men, wake up. It is time to go to Armageddon.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.” Make weapons; you finished boot camp, now go to war. “Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.” Wake up, Esau; wake up, Ishmael. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the valley of decision, and they have to go there and die.

“Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe”; “for their wickedness is great. Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.” The nations arrayed against Babylon are the sword of the Lord bringing his vengeance on her.

“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness”. The crafty are the nations, in particular Esau, that counsel against us and keep exploiting, oppressing and colonizing with imperialism. It is the same as Psalms 21: “they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” Their counsel is carried headlong; they are going to fall headlong and bust their forehead. “They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.”

“But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.” From Esau's sword, the nations' sword. Who is the poor? Isaiah answers: “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

Write it down, brothers: when the scripture talks about the poor, it is talking about Israel, the poor of his people who trust in Zion. That was an easy one, and every soldier should know it.

And before the Lord saves the poor from the sword, the wicked has to be identified. The man of sin must be revealed, so that the whole earth knows who he is: the nation that bombed country after country, removed leader after leader, and made the earth to tremble.

“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” Are we free today? Hell no. Do we know the truth today? Not as a nation. So what is the truth that makes free?

Christ prayed, “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” Sanctify the Israelites through thy truth, mainly the elect, the apostles he was speaking of. And the truth is the word: “thy word is truth.”

So to know the truth is to know what the word says, and the word that is truth says a day is coming that shall burn as an oven. Knowing that truth is what frees our people from the lies, and it is the first step before the Lord saves the poor of his people from the sword of the nations.

This is the word that is the truth: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”. The day is coming that is going to burn like an oven. Nuclear fire is coming to America. What are you going to do about that, and how are you going to survive it?

“and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: burnt up like stubble in that day, unless ye repent. “and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch”. Your children will be cut off too.

Psalm 21 sounds just like it: “Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them. Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.” Neither root nor branch left. And Isaiah 14: “Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”. The forefathers committed the crime, took the wealth and everything from us, and now the children are left holding the bag: Esau, and not just Esau, Elam, Ishmael and the Hamites, all got wealthy off the backs of the Israelites and had us in slavery one way or the other. The Lord will “cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”, the same son and nephew, root and branch.

“For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” The nations counsel against us, but the Lord takes the crafty in their own craftiness and saves the poor, Israel, from the sword.

“The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” The king in this nation right now, in 2026, is Donald Trump. His heart is in the hand of the Lord, and whatever way the Lord wants him to go, he is going to go, and he is going to fulfill what the Lord has in store.

Daniel shows why: “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” God rules in the kingdoms of men. God is the ultimate ruler.

And what does he do? He “giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.” He gives the kingdom over to whomever he chooses, and he sets over it the basest of men: the least of men, the bottom feeders. The bottom feeders are ruling us right now. Biden, Trump, Putin, all of them: they are the bottom.

So the king’s heart turning like rivers of water and the Most High setting up the basest of men are the same truth. Trump is not ruling by his own power. He is set up by the Most High and turned whithersoever he will, a sword in the hand of God to bring judgment on the nations.

Psalms 124 goes on: “Then they had swallowed us up quick”, the nations would have swallowed us up, “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:” “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.” The waters are not the water of affliction. Write it down, brothers: the waters in Psalms 124 are the nations.

Isaiah proves it: “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” Keep reading: “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”. He is comparing the nations to waters.

“but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.” That is the Lord being on our side: the proud waters, the nations, rush against Israel, and God rebukes them.

King David says, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: the Lord was on Israel’s side, “when men rose up against us”, when the nations rose up against us. Think about that. The only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord.

Lamentations says it plainly: “It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” That we, brothers and sisters, are still here is only because of the Lord. With the weapons Esau has and the weapons the nations have, if the Lord put the spirit on them to do what they do and gave them free reign with us, we would all have been wiped out.

Read on: “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” “The Lord is my portion, saith my soul”. His compassion does not fail, and that is why Psalms 124 can say the nations did not swallow us up.

“The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression”. Being longsuffering is one of the characteristics we must take on with our brothers and our sisters. A lot of times we are carnal and have no patience with each other. A brother offends you, or does what you think is an offence that he may not even see as one, and you get all in your feelings; sisters get in their feelings about something somebody said or the way somebody moves toward them. We are all different spirits joining together for one common goal. We are not all going to get along, but we all have to be longsuffering with each other and endure it.

Then: “and by no means clearing the guilty”. Why is he of great mercy but will by no means clear the guilty? Just because you sin and are not judged immediately does not mean you will not be judged; you are still guilty of that sin. And to get that great mercy, you have to repent and forsake your sins. The ones he will not clear are those that do not repent, and he visits “the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

So back to Psalms 124: it is of the Lord’s mercy, longsuffering with Israel, that the men who rose up against us did not swallow us up.

One more precept on the waters: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The waters are peoples and nations again, and the one sitting on them is America. Look at where America sits: bases and fleets all over the earth.

So what could Russia do with this? America does not have to send its entire fleet to Russia or to China; it is already there, it does not have to go anywhere. If I was Trump, I might boast too. Look at the weaponry he has.

That is the power of the nations the Psalm is talking about. “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul”, but “Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.” Because of the Lord’s mercies, “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.” And “Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth”: that name is God’s commandments with faith in his Son.

“Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.” That sounds just like Malachi 4: “the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”, and “it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” Nuclear fire is coming to America. And David goes on: “Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.” Neither root nor branch: their children will be cut off too.

Isaiah shows why the children are cut off: “Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers.” For the sins of their forefathers. The forefathers committed the crime, got the bag from us, took the wealth, took everything from us, and now the children are left holding the bag. Esau, and not just Esau: Elam, Ishmael, the Hamites. All of them got wealthy off the backs of the Israelites; all of them had us in slavery one way or another.

It is done “that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew.” Son and nephew goes right back to Psalm 21 and the end of Malachi 4: their seed destroyed from among the children of men.

Why? “For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” They imagine evil devices and evil counsels against us, but “He disappointeth the devices of the crafty”, and “he saveth the poor from the sword.” The poor are Israel: “the poor of his people shall trust in it.” So the fiery oven is for the nations that enslaved us, down to their children, and the Lord saves his poor from their sword.

“Come out of her, my people.” Come out of America’s ways, come out of their filth, and do not partake in the sins of Babylon, “that ye receive not of her plagues.” Babylon is America, and “God hath remembered her iniquities.” For all the bombs she dropped on the nations of the earth, the Lord says “double unto her double according to her works.” She “lived deliciously” on the resources, the minerals and the strength of the dark nations, particularly Africa; and among her merchandise are “slaves, and souls of men”, the Israelites. Our people’s soul is knit to America; they want her to last forever.

Then: “in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” Where are the prophets? Right here. You are the prophets, you are the saints, in Babylon which is America.

Luke 11:49 proves it: “Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.” God sends his prophets and apostles, and some of them are slain and persecuted. That is the blood found in Babylon.

So come out of her, because her judgment is coming: “in one hour is thy judgment come.” And when Babylon is destroyed, what do you do? “Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.”

Ezra sees “a roaring lion chased out of the wood”, and he “sent out a man's voice unto the eagle”. The eagle is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of it. The roaring lion is Christ, but first it is us, the prophets: a man's voice speaking to the eagle. That is the witnesses on the earth today condemning the so-called white man, Edom, for all the evil he has done through the centuries. God has not forgotten slavery, Jim Crow, the destruction of Jerusalem by Rome. He does not forget anything.

How will we overcome that beast? “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.” We overcome the beast, Edom, by the blood of Christ, and by the word of our testimony.

What is our testimony? The words of the prophets. We are teaching the laws and the words of the prophets, revealing that he has ruled with deceit, set himself up as the Jews and the people of God, and dwelt on this earth “with much wicked oppression”. In a court of law the witnesses must bring their testimony before judgment comes, and the whole earth is our courtroom. When we speak, the Lord is speaking through us, the spirit of his mouth.

And by the blood of the Lamb, meaning Christ having mercy on us. If you make a mistake, fix it. If you are struggling with things inside, fix it. If you fall, get back up; Christ will have mercy on you. But you also have to have his testimony. That is how we overcome this wicked society, and then the eagle, its horrible wings, wicked feathers, malicious heads and hurtful claws, will appear no more.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”: that is Rome, already working in the apostles’ time, “until he be taken out of the way.” “And then shall that Wicked be revealed.” Why does the wicked need to be revealed? Because he does not present himself as the wicked. He has transformed into an angel of light, into Lucifer, and people think he is the righteous. But God’s witnesses, the Israelites, the prophets that are waking up, will testify who the wicked is and reveal him: the so-called white man, the nation of Edom, the people God hates. For years we have said it and many did not believe; now he is showing you who he is.

Then: “whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.” Two things: consuming him with the spirit of his mouth, and destroying him with the brightness of his coming. What is the spirit of his mouth?

“For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.” That mouth and wisdom is Christ speaking through us, the Holy Spirit dwelling in us, so that nobody can gainsay us. That is the kind of power the Lord has given us.

So as we teach the word of God, the wicked are being consumed with the spirit of the Lord’s mouth, because we are bringing forth judgment. The Lord speaks through His witnesses, and their testimony condemns the wicked before his destruction at the brightness of Christ’s coming.

“And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.” We are going to be brought before governors and kings as a testimony against them. The testimony is us teaching the Bible, the laws and the testimonies, letting them know: God is coming back to destroy you. You are wicked. You have been stealing land, you have been murdering, you are the wicked of the earth.

When you testify on this earth, you are condemning people. Everybody who hears the word of God and turns their back on it is condemned. Every white person hearing about the Israelites and hearing these teachings, many of them online, is hearing that the Lord is going to judge Edom and judge Amalek, and those who call themselves Jews and are not. We are bringing forth judgment on the earth.

“But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak. For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.” Do not worry what to say before kings. It will not be you speaking; the spirit that dwells in us takes over, and it is the Lord judging them with your voice.

That is how the Lord consumes the wicked “with the spirit of his mouth.” 2 Esdras 11 shows it too: the roaring lion that sends out a man’s voice unto the eagle, which is Rome, with Europe and America as its extension. That voice is the prophets, the witnesses on the earth today, condemning Edom for all the evil he has done through the centuries.

“Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses.” Who can show the things from the past? The next verse answers: “Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen.” God’s witnesses on this earth are the children of Israel, and the two sticks, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, the southern and northern kingdoms, are two witnesses also.

What does a witness have? A testimony. A witness testifies, like a witness to a crime in a court of law. And we do not play a small role. Isaiah shows what God’s witnesses testify: “To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.”

As witnesses, what we are supposed to be testifying is the law and the testimony. If they do not speak according to this word, the law and the testimony, there is no light in them.

The testimony is what John bore record of: “the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.” Part of that testimony is to identify “them which say they are Jews, and are not”, the synagogue of Satan. And Malachi’s testimony: “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” The they who call them that are the witnesses, the prophets. So when the nations are gathered and asked for witnesses, Israel stands to the law and to the testimony.

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” A witness has a testimony. What is the testimony Israel carries? Sirach shows where it came from: “Fill Sion with thine unspeakable oracles, and thy people with thy glory: Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

The testimonies are what God gave to Moses, to Jeremiah, to Nahum, to Micah, to Isaiah, to Peter, Paul and the apostles. All the things these men wrote are the testimony: testimonies of things that are going to happen in the future, of what is going to happen to the children of Israel.

So when the scripture says the witnesses have to testify, the testimony is what is written, what the prophets said is going to happen. That is why Isaiah 43:9 asks “who among them can declare this, and shew us former things?” No other nation can. Israel, the people God possessed from the beginning, was given the unspeakable oracles, and we testify them.

And as we testify, we bring forth judgment. Brought before governors and kings “for a testimony against them and the Gentiles”, it is not we who speak but the Spirit of our Father speaking in us. The wicked who hides as an angel of light is revealed and condemned, because the witnesses must testify first before God brings forth judgment, as in a court of law.

“He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.” When our people are oppressed, God opens their ears. All the things Trump is doing, and ICE is doing in the streets and in the black community, are God opening your ears. For the last 60 years our people have been lost and confused, following the American dream and thinking America is about equal rights and opportunity. God said, no, this place is not your rest. So he turns up the oppression, because that is the only time we as a people turn to God: when bad things start happening to us.

Hosea says it: “I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” Until we acknowledge our offence and seek God's face.

In our affliction we will seek him early: before it is too late, before we die, before judgment comes. So God is allowing Trump to do these things in the black community with these ICE agents so that you will seek him. Our people are realizing that the American dream is exactly what it is, a dream, and that there is no such thing here as justice and equal rights. That is why judgment starts first with the house of God.

Psalm 78 shows the same pattern: “Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.” The trouble is affliction. “When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.”

When God slew us. What do you see taking place all over the streets right now? Our people being oppressed, locked up, put in prison by ICE officers. Then we seek God. That is when we return and enquire early after the Lord: when bad things start happening to us.

That is why judgment must begin first at the house of the Lord. Number one, for us to turn back to our God. Number two, to prove us: as you turn to him, bad things will happen to see whether you believe and trust in him. “And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.” He is the one who will redeem us from the condition we are in.

And Isaiah 30 gives the teachers their job: though the Lord gives the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, the teachers will not be removed into a corner any more. As our people cry under the affliction, we go to them and tell them why it is happening: this is the way, walk ye in it. Not guns, as some are calling for; the word of God is what will change our people and bring destruction on this place.

Christ said “Take heed that no man deceive you”, and then: “ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” Nation against nation, kingdom against kingdom, famines, pestilences and earthquakes: “All these are the beginning of sorrows.” That is the time we are living in right now: the beginning.

Ezra shows it is only the beginning: “For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.” Greater evils. The things you see taking place on the earth are only the beginning. It is not going to get better, and it is not going to go away. The Democrats are not going to come into office and change anything and make it better. God says it is the beginning of sorrows.

“For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.” The older the world gets, the weaker it becomes, and we are at the end of it right now. The evil is war, death and destruction, and it is going to increase.

So when you see these things, do not be troubled and worried about what is taking place. The world has changed and it is not going to be the same. Work on getting yourself right, and prepare for what is coming.

“Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off”: God will cut you off, cut off from the book of the living. Proverbs shows what is really behind slander: “He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.”

When somebody lies on you or slanders you, what that really says is that there is hatred there. The lying lips are hiding hatred.

“and he that uttereth a slander”: you had Tyre Gas, you had Lightfoot, you had these guys uttering slanders, and their followers talk that way because their leaders are the same way. They run with slander. As a leader you are supposed to hear an outrageous lie and say, I do not believe that. One woman said we came to Canada on a magic school bus, and some leaders believed it.

God says you are a fool to listen to lies, run with them and put them out there. Slander is defamation: running with an accusation without two or three witnesses, and God cuts that man off.

“A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.” If you lie on somebody and run with slander, it says that you hate the one who is afflicted by it.

You heard it plainly from one of them: I am here to down IUIC. That is the hatred behind the lying tongue that Psalms 101 says God will cut off.

Every matter is to be established by two or three witnesses. What was put out about Captain Obadiah was one witness, and that witness was a lie. The charges were dropped; the footage and the witnesses showed he was defending himself. It is sad that the white man had to come and say he was defending himself, when those who talk about righteous judgment could not understand something that simple. In London, when our sister died, people said IUIC killed her and hid evidence, and the investigators showed that the man who did it was evil and we had nothing to do with it.

A false witness is called slander, or defamation, and false witness can get you killed. By the law, what was to be done to the brother you slandered is to be done unto you. We do not have power to institute that, but Esau’s court system has defamation, and that is how it is going to be done now: whatever you put out against the truth, you had better be able to prove it, or you will have to come up out of the pockets. That is to protect the ministry of Christ, because the lies are put out to blame the ministry.

“Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.” That is why so many brothers get caught up in suits: striving in things that do not concern them, things they know nothing about. You just hear something and you are running your mouth.

To sit in judgment with sinners is sitting in counsel with brothers that are not right, brothers who were put out of the school, like Judah Mack and Titus.

Read on: “My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent.” This is for those who keep running their mouths talking about us. You meddle in matters that do not concern you, and you are not going to be innocent. That is why legal measures are being taken: to teach men to control their mouths, and to make sure that when you say something, it is true.

So the privy slanderer of Psalms 101 is the man who strives in what does not concern him and sits with sinners, and God will cut him off.

“For thy help will I send my servants”: God says he is going to send Isaiah and Jeremiah. And that is what happened. Isaiah and Jeremiah came and prophesied before Babylon came and destroyed Jerusalem.

That is the pattern behind “I will give power unto my two witnesses.” God always sends forth witnesses before he brings forth judgment, and he sends them in twos. Isaiah and Jeremiah before Babylon; Joshua and Zerubbabel in Zechariah’s day; Moses and Elijah in Revelation 11. Christ sent the apostles and the seventy out in twos for the same reason: you need two witnesses to bring forth judgment.

So the two witnesses of Revelation 11 are the two major prophets that come before the end, and they also speak of Israel as a whole, the people God calls his witnesses on this earth. Judgment does not fall until the witnesses have prophesied.

“What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?” Zechariah asks again about “these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves.” The oil is understanding. The answer: “These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

The two anointed ones are the two witnesses. In Zechariah’s time they were Joshua the priest and Zerubbabel. Before Babylon it was Isaiah and Jeremiah; in Revelation 11 it is Moses and Elijah. Different names, different people, but the same pattern: God always sends his prophets forth in twos before he brings forth judgment.

That is why Christ sent the twelve and the seventy elders out two by two. You cannot make judgment without two witnesses. And when the witnesses come they bind and loose things on earth, they forgive and they condemn, because it is the Lord speaking through them.

The two witnesses also speak of Israel as a whole. God says his people are his witnesses; and there are the two sticks, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, the northern and southern kingdom. A witness has a testimony, and Israel is sent to testify on this earth before the judgment comes.

What is the fire that proceeds out of the witnesses’ mouth? “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?” God’s word is like fire. That goes back to the same thing in Thessalonians: the wicked is consumed with the spirit of the Lord’s mouth.

So when “fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies”, it is the word of God coming out of the witnesses as they testify. He makes war with those of us that keep the commandments and are teaching the word of God, the laws and the testimonies.

Before Babylon is destroyed most of them will be dead; the only one that might not be is John the Revelator. “And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” Her is Babylon, America, and they kill the prophets here because the prophets testify against them.

“The temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened”: everything the prophets wrote, the testimony, is opened, meaning we are understanding it and teaching it. Then “the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues”, and received “seven golden vials full of the wrath of God”, and a great voice said, “Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” The testimonies speak of the judgment and death that has to take place on the earth.

“The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?” The lion roaring is Christ speaking to us, and we prophesy. “Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt”: Ashdod is modern-day Tel Aviv in the land of Israel, and the land of Egypt is America. When the Lord comes back he is going to destroy all the cities Esau built. This is the testimony God gave Malachi, the same kind of record John bare.

“And they shall call them”: the “they” are the witnesses, the prophets. We are the ones that call them “The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

So the testimony is to let the Caucasian race know that God hates them forever. That is you testifying; that is the law and the testimony. The prophets wrote it, John bare record of it, and God’s witnesses on this earth today speak it.

John “bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.” He saw things and he wrote them down. The testimony is what God gave the prophets: to Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Micah, Nahum, to Peter, Paul and the apostles. All the things these men wrote, the things that are going to happen to the children of Israel, is the testimony we as God’s witnesses are supposed to be speaking.

Here is one of those testimonies: “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. The real Jews are in a low state today. Then: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.”

That is what you are supposed to testify about. You have to identify the people that say they are Jews and are not, and say plainly: these people are not the people of God. Revelation 3:9 says it again: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet.”

When you read Revelation 2:9 and 3:9 on this earth, that is you testifying. We as God’s witnesses have to testify these things on the earth today.

Christ is “the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature,” because we have not seen the Most High’s face nor His shape nor heard His voice. Zillah bare “Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: Tubal-cain designed weaponry. So when Edom builds Space Command in Huntsville and calls it Rocket City, when his weaponry is twenty years ahead of anything we know, remember Christ said he created the smith and the waster. “Babylon, the glory of kingdoms” draws every nation that wants a piece of the American dream, and the dragon gives power to the beast: the devil himself gives power to the beast, the white man. “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Even that power was given him.

But the Lord reminds us that they are men and not God, and their pride is the thing that brings them down.

Venezuela’s defenses, its bases and its president were taken in thirty minutes. That is why his pride is lifted up, and why the ignorant say he must be God.

So the glory of kingdoms falls from heaven like Lucifer, and then “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When these devils fall, the whole earth will finally be at rest.

“Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit.” That is the war of gods. On one side is the god still sitting in our minds, the image of white supremacy that was forced into our spirits; on the other side is the God of this Bible. The Egyptians set themselves up as gods, but they are only men, and all their weaponry is flesh.

Their weapons are not only for warring with other people. They are there to force a thought into our minds, to force white supremacy into our spirits. So the war is first in the mind, and the ignorance of our people is the battlefield.

They will run back to the news outlets that lied for years, to Christianity, to every version of white supremacy. But men are not God, and none of it will hold them up.

Somebody called out the perverse spirit, and even when they are shown their errors, they flip you the bird and make sure you lose your job.

When the Iron Dome in Israel failed and the rockets came through, that was no technical glitch; the Lord ripped it open. He makes the prideful instruments of man fail, because he decides where war happens and when it ceases.

The spiritual side of the war is obedience.

“All the world wondered after the beast”, and “they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”. The devil himself gives power to the beast, the white man. And they say, “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” Who is like the beast, created for the perfection of warfare? That is Space Command moving to Huntsville, Alabama, to be called Rocket City; that is DARPA, the most powerful portion of Esau’s military, always twenty years ahead of anything you or I know; that is the Department of Defense renamed the Department of War. “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Then: “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.”

Their weaponry is not only to war with other people; it is to force white supremacy into our minds and spirits. There is a war of gods, the god you still have in your mind and the God of this Bible, and the battlefield is your mind in ignorance.

The thing made and its maker are both cursed.

Now go to Christ, who is also a maker: he made everything seen and unseen, in earth and in heaven. Paul asks, “Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?” It is a rhetorical question, because everything he made is in its perfect form and perfect order. The hummingbirds still go to the nectar, lions still chase the beasts, mothers still give suck to their young, the whales do not get out of the water to walk on land, and the water does not pass the bounds of the sand unless the Lord sends his angels in the storm. Everything is in perfect order except the twelve tribes of Israel. Keep my commandments that you may live, and we said no.

“Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?” Christ created both. Jacob and Esau came from the same mother and father, the same lump: one a vessel of honour, which we descend from, and the other a vessel of dishonour.

Then: “What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction”. While Esau fulfils his role as God’s sword, the Lord lets him do what he was created for, and what he was created for is destruction. They are here to serve a purpose, and then the Lord is going to destroy them. Wipe your tears: the nations got to go.

So the war of the gods is this: the true Maker whose works stay in order, against the gods men make with hands, which are cursed with the men who made them.

“But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord”. They “receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the Lord’s hand”: the Lord himself is going to place that crown upon you. “With his arm shall he protect them. He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.” Second Esdras shows when that revenge comes.

“Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth. And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.” Before it, “one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.” There will be wars one against another, city against city, the same as was read earlier in the class.

“And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before, and then shall my Son be declared”: then Christ shall be declared. He is not coming back as a regular man that anyone can do harm to; he is coming back with his army. An innumerable multitude gathers “willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting. But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.”

“And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest”. He lays before them “their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame”, and he destroys them without labour. That is the end of the war of the gods, and the reward of the righteous who live for evermore.
