Christ said it would come to this: “And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.” Because sin shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold: emotionless, no empathy, no feelings for your people, not even for your parents. That is what we are seeing in the ungodly persons who hate their own people and go to the king to betray them.

If they are doing that now, imagine when we are making noise. They are already passing laws and putting a media blackout on us. It is going to get to such a level that they will want to put us to death, thinking they are doing good and saving the people.

But it is only betrayal, and their salvation in Esau's kingdom is only for a moment. There is a judgment for betraying your people. Look at Judas, the main betrayer: he betrayed Christ for thirty pieces of silver, and he killed himself, because he knew what he did was evil. The red MAGA hat gives you no superpowers. It does not hide your brown skin or your black skin; it just makes you look more and more like a clown, like a traitor.

“Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower”. You have to hate your own people to betray them. That is the young man in the red MAGA hat who said he would deport his own parents for not having Esau's paperwork. That paperwork means nothing; the earth belongs to us, and our paperwork is the Bible.

How can one of our own do that? Paul answers: “Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel”. The word of God is not going to fail; it has not failed. But they are not all Israel which are of Israel.

Just because somebody looks like you, speaks the same language as you and eats the same foods as you does not mean they are of your people. We have to be aware of this.

Esau in his witchcraft tells our young men, join the military, you will explore and experience the world, your family will be good, we will give you college tuition. What he does not tell you is that you have to go to the countries of your people and oppress them and kill them. Poor whites and mainly poor blacks and Latinos go out in Esau's military and kill people who look just like them: in Panama, Venezuela, the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua, Libya, Iraq. They are going to rat us out; our own people who hate us will betray us, as they did Jonathan.

The son of perdition sits “in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” Revelation shows who worships him: “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.”

Him is Esau. Those of our people who do not repent and keep God’s commandments, whose names are not written in the book of life, are the ones worshipping this damn bastard demon as Christ.

That is the strong delusion of 2 Thessalonians 2:11. Because they received not the love of the truth, God sends them strong delusion, so they think they can be saved by Esau and hide under his skirt: the traitors in MAGA hats who would sell their own people out for a house on a quarter acre, and the grandmother crying for Caesar Borgia, a false god, an idol that cannot save.

But the curses have an end, and we are waking up. It is a fixed fight. All we have to do is keep the commandments in the faith of Christ, pray for more labourers to take the word to the four corners of the earth, and not fear, and the Most High will fight for us.

“And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition; Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” He is sitting in Jerusalem posing as God’s people, and showing himself as God with his images of Caesar Borgia as Christ.

Christ had to let us know who that man is: “them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie.” The ones who call themselves Jews and sit in Jerusalem are the synagogue of Satan, the son of perdition, the son of hell.

That man of sin is being revealed so much through social media, through TikTok and Instagram, where our people see the genocide in Gaza with their own eyes, that Esau, America and Israel now run a propaganda campaign, throwing hundreds of millions at Christian groups and celebrities to cover up their evil. No amount of money can cover it. He cannot hide his wicked, evil self.

So we have to come behind that and show the people through the scriptures who this man really is and why he does such wicked acts on this earth. He is revealed through the words of the prophets and the teaching of God’s laws, laws that are like fire to these people.

“the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.” It does not matter who you vote for; he puts whoever he wants. Donald Trump is one of the basest of men, a caricature and TV personality from The Apprentice, just as Ronald Reagan was an actor. His orange skin is telling you what he is about: he is Esau, the red man. The Most High puts these men over us so we can see: you wanted the other nations to rule over you besides me, and this is what happens.

Deuteronomy 17:14 shows that desire in our people: “When thou art come unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me”. We are not satisfied with the King of kings and Lord of lords, Christ, being over us. We always want to be like the other nations. That is why we dye our hair blonde, put in the contacts, put on the suit and tie, go to their universities and get their education, and assimilate to their way of life.

But the law says “Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.” We have to have a king of our own people, who is for our people, not a base man out for the interest of corporations that rob and steal our resources. We are not supposed to vote for other nations to be over us. Thus saith the Lord.

The same goes for our people in Latin America. In Mexico and in Argentina, where an Italian was set up, what are they doing for you? Nothing, not a damn thing. You cannot set up people of other nations over you. That is why the Most High sets the basest of men over Israel: to show us what it means to choose a stranger over the king he chose.

Deuteronomy 28:37 says Israel would become “an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations”: called by names outside of our God-given name. God gave us a name. Israel means prince of the power with God, and there is no mightier name on the face of the earth. Why would you want to call yourself a Latinized negro, a Latino? That is a racist term. You have to do the history and get the knowledge; you have to find yourself so you don't lose yourself.

Isaiah 65:15 says the same: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” We left the name Israel for a curse, for racist terms like Latino, Hispanic, and names like Cuban, Colombian, Venezuelan, Dominican. Yet it is “unto my chosen”: we are God's chosen people. You have to see the greatness in who you are. We have fallen so far that we think we can't come out of it, but we are coming out, because there is a God.

“for the Lord God shall slay thee”. For wanting a king of another nation over us, for wanting to assimilate, the Most High slew us and caused the basest of men to rule over us. “and call his servants by another name”: now we are called Latino, blacks, spics, wetbacks, illegal aliens. That is why we do not know who we are, a confusion of faces. We are searching, but we are not searching the scriptures.

So-called Latinos, you are the Israelites. Latino is not your given name; your name is Israel, the twelve tribes of Israel. You think this is a black movement, a negro movement, but the twelve tribes of Israel are mainly so-called Latinos. We have to get back to our history and our true nationality.

Moses blessed the tribes “before his death”, and of Asher he said “Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.” Asher is Venezuela, Colombia, Peru, Brazil, from Colombia down to Uruguay. When the conquistadors came to conquer, rob and pillage, many fled into the jungles of the Amazon and grew up without fathers, so they must be made acceptable to their brethren, and we have to go there and save our people in the jungles. And the oil: a brother in Venezuela, asked how Venezuelans and Colombians can benefit from their precious resource, stood right on the oil. The oil is the precious commodity the red man covets so earnestly.

Then verse 25: “Thy shoes shall be iron and brass.” Look up the name Brazil: it is associated with the Hebrew word barzel, meaning iron. It is not a coincidence that the name Brazil means iron in Hebrew; these people know where our people are. Brazil is full of iron, Colombia is full of iron, Venezuela is full of iron, Ecuador is full of iron. Mexico has iron too, but not the same abundance as South America.

“and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.” That is the inheritance of our people in these lands. It is not a coincidence, the names these countries get, for those who do not believe that the northern kingdom is the northern kingdom.

The elders in the 60s and 70s deciphered this without Google or the internet; all they had were the scriptures and history books. Now, in the information age, it is so much plainer. Asher's blessing, children, oil, iron and brass, sits right where the Bible said it would.

Esau has to be revealed. The devil has to be revealed, and the scriptures reveal him by his attributes. “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” Red is a warning: when you see the red man coming, destruction and death are coming, so flee. He is red and hairy, so much that they shave nearly the whole body to normalize their appearance. Jacob is not even described, because he looked like his parents. “Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people”: we are not the same, and no matter how hard we try we cannot be like them. “Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field”, a predator who loves to kill and prey; “Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents”, simple, living off the land and doing our sacrifices to God.

Then Esau begged, “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father.” His blessing: “thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live”. How would he get the fatness of the earth? By the sword: by armies, killing, destroying and preying on other nations. That is what we see on the news.

Then, “and shalt serve thy brother”: he was meant to serve Israel, Jacob’s sons. But “and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”. He broke the yoke and is over us now, because we wanted to be like the other nations and wanted a king; God is a jealous God, and he cursed us with the basest of men over us.

His dominion is the pale horse: “his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” Hell follows him to Libya, Iraq, Iran, Venezuela, Cuba and Panama. The fourth part of the world is America, as their own book on the birth of America calls it, which is why they call this hemisphere theirs, the Monroe Doctrine become the Donroe Doctrine. With hunger: Cuba starved out by cut-off oil and sanctions. With the beasts of the earth: zoonosis, mixing animal DNA. He is the Chaldeans’ daughter, “that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs”, with some 850 military bases in other people’s lands. If Esau is not the devil, if they're not the wicked, then who is? The Arabs don't have military bases on every land.

Daniel says, “through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: economic warfare and the witchcraft of a dollar with no gold behind it, which is why he went after Gaddafi’s African gold and Venezuela trading outside the dollar. And “by peace shall destroy many”, with peace summits led by the biggest warmongers on earth. Yet Daniel says, “but he shall be broken without hand”. Christ “shall destroy them without labour by the law”, which is why keeping and teaching God’s laws matters: the foolishness of preaching is destroying this kingdom from within. And no amount of money can hide the man of sin; he is being revealed, “that he might be revealed in his time.” The devil must be revealed in his time, through the words of the prophets and through us teaching his laws.

“in their affliction they will seek me early.” Why do we have to get deported? So that we seek God early. A lot of our people think this is the American dream, this is what life is about: get a house, get a car, barbecue on the weekend, watch sports, send your kids to college. No, that is Esau's way of life. This is death, this is oppression, and the Most High has to afflict us to remind us that this is not our rest.

Micah says it: “Arise ye, and depart”. Separate yourself from these heathen nations, these strangers, the real aliens. “for this is not your rest”. You were not brought here on slave ships to be comfortable, to assimilate, or to be friends with these heathen nations. You see the betrayal time and time again when you make a league with the strangers. “Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest”: we work and we have to watch our backs for ICE agents who come to our places of business and our homes, arrest us and kidnap our children.

“because it is polluted”: wicked, evil, deceptive. Witchcraft is in this place, so bad that it has you bleaching your skin, blonding your hair, putting in contacts, starving yourself. “it shall destroy you”: it destroyed Sammy Sosa, Serena Williams, Lil' Kim. Those are the celebrities Esau upholds so our people look up to them and want to be like them. It is witchcraft to make a black man hate himself so much that he destroys his own face.

“even with a sore destruction.” Destruction is coming to this place; this kingdom is not going to last forever. We are in the last days, so we have to get our minds right and our spirits right. There is much work to be done, especially for you so-called Latinos: Judah has shown us the way, and now it is our turn. When you see a head of state like Nicolás Maduro kidnapped and his country's resources stolen, that is for you to wake up. Seek his face, and see in the scriptures that he looks just like us.

“Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach”: see the curses that fell upon us for our sins. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Chicago mayor was offended by the term alien, but the term is in the scriptures. The aliens are the strangers, the other nations. We are not the aliens; we are the natives of these lands. Esau has taken our lands, our resources, our inheritance.

“We are orphans and fatherless.” Why are we orphans? Deuteronomy 28:32: “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.” We see it all throughout history, and even now our northern kingdom children are separated from their parents. They killed our fathers, our leaders, the caciques and kings like Atahualpa, and burned them at the stake for not accepting the Christian religion. That is why the Asher in the Amazon grew up orphans and fatherless.

“and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”. You will look to the white Jesus, but he can't save you. Donald Trump is not going to save you. The US government is not going to save you. No matter how much you perfect your English, the accent is going to slip out and they are going to catch you.

“and there shall be no might in thine hand” to save our children. We saw ICE agents, grown men with weapons and body armor, surrounding a five-year-old autistic girl and holding her hostage: a nation of fierce countenance. How much plainer can it be?

So-called Latinos, you have to see yourselves in the scriptures. You are no different from your black brothers, from Haitians, Jamaicans and African Americans; we are the same people, oppressed together. All these curses have to afflict you so that you can see this is your book, and what is happening to you for turning your back on the black Messiah, Jesus Christ. We have to return to our true nationality.

We gave the hand to the Egyptians “to be satisfied with bread”: if I work hard, if I send my children to their school, if I learn English, I can assimilate; if I work hard for the white man, I've made it. No. Lamentations 4:17: “As for us”, as for Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help”. Our lying help. Esau is not here to help us; they have deceived us.

“in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” They don't want no parts of us, and they can't save us, no matter how hard we try. Look at the Latinos who stand with Trump: look how Donald Trump looks at him like he is a dumbass, and the other one is not even looking at him, because he is a clown. They despise you. They just use you to deceive your people and to betray your people.

Just because they let one get through, one Diddy, one Jay-Z, and give him millions, that is chump change compared to the destruction caused when our people are led astray into thinking this is the way of life, that this is our kingdom, that we can assimilate.

There is none that doth deliver us out of their hand. Hugo Chavez couldn't do it, Fidel Castro couldn't do it, Maduro couldn't do it, even with Russian helicopters and Chinese spyware; his Cuban guards went back to Cuba in little boxes. No man can save us. Our job, brothers and sisters, is to keep God's commandments and the faith of Christ. That is our power. When we do that, the Most High and his angels will fight for us, and we must see ourselves in these scriptures, no longer as blacks or Latinos but as one people, one nation.

“We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians”: the Egyptians and the Assyrians represent the oppressor. Who is our oppressor today? Our main oppressor is Esau. How do we know? “Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz”. Edom is the so-called white man; that is his biblical name.

“the cup also shall pass through unto thee”: that cup of affliction, that cup of oppression, is going to pass unto them. “thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.” His evil is being revealed. This is the beginning of that; we have not seen nothing yet.

Read on: “The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity”. Our punishment is coming to an end. We are not going into slavery anymore; this one here in America is our last and final captivity. Now it is time for us to wake up and rise up like God's army that we are.

“he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” God is going to judge Esau for the evil they have done to his people. Everything this devil does is going to be revealed, and his judgment for it. So the hand we have given to the oppressor for bread is the hand of Edom, and the cup he made us drink is passing to him.

“Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand”. Who is ruling over us? Servants. The Most High made Esau to serve us, but we are serving them now.

Look at the statue they took down: Theodore Roosevelt on horseback, with a Native man and an African man walking beside him. They took it down, but it is too late; they know who they are and they know who we are. Roosevelt represents Esau, the servant. Now watch the scripture come to life: “I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth”. The horse represents authority, power and rulership. The princes walking on foot are Israel, the northern kingdom on the left and the southern kingdom on the right, walking as servants.

Esau knows who he is, and he knows this is his time to rule. But it is coming to an end. There is none that can deliver us out of their hand, not Hugo Chavez, not Fidel Castro, not Maduro with Russian helicopters and Chinese spyware. No man can save us. Our power is to keep God's commandments in the faith of Christ; when we do that, the Most High and his angels will fight for us. We have to see ourselves in these scriptures, no longer as blacks or as Latinos, but as one people, one nation.

“Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities”. Their sins are our sins. Why? It goes back to Exodus 20:5: “Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them”. We cannot serve idols: Christianity, white Jesus. “for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”.

Our fathers “are not”: they are dead and gone. But the Most High visits their sins to the third and fourth generation, so we take on those sins. Basically, we are our fathers.

That is why Lamentations goes straight on to “Servants have ruled over us”. We bowed to other gods, and a jealous God gave us over to be ruled by the nations. The ones in our own communities who lead our people into thinking we can assimilate, that this is our kingdom, are leading us deeper into it. Our fathers watched for a nation that could not save us, and we are still doing it. The way out is not to serve their idols but to come back to the God who visits the iniquity.

“Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” Esau knows who he is and knows this is his time to rule, but it is coming to an end: servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth. None can deliver us. Hugo Chavez could not do it. Fidel Castro could not do it. Maduro could not do it, even with Russian helicopters and Chinese spyware. The 32 Cuban bodyguards around Maduro went back to Cuba in little boxes, mini coffins draped with the Cuban flag. A head of state snatched out of his fortress in three hours or less, with no casualties on the American side.

So we cannot expect a man to save us from this wicked, demonic people. The small groups picking up arms against them are agitation, agents provocateurs setting us up for failure. Where do you get your bullets? You have no factories. You would have to go to your enemy for the weapons to use against him. Our power is keeping God's commandments and the faith of Christ; then the Most High and his angels fight for us.

The Lord speaks to Esau: “These things hast thou done, and I kept silence.” These things: destroying my people, putting yokes of iron on their necks, having them hate themselves and their people. He says, “thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself.” Because God did not bring swift judgment, since he was punishing us for our iniquities, Esau thought God was with him, thought God looked like him. No, Esau. God is a black God. Jesus Christ is a black God.

Then: “but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.” The Most High will reprove Esau for the evil he has done to our people, and set Israel in order before his eyes. They call us whatever they want: Power Rangers, LA Lakers, spics in purple and gold. We may seem harmless, but we are God's army, his chosen people rising up.

While Esau is busy stealing land and resources, the Most High is setting us in order, giving us time to get our minds, spirits, families and children right: coming out of drugs, drug dealing, gangs, alcoholism, prostitution and selling our people out. No longer blacks and Latinos as separate nations, but one people, one nation.

The pale horse represents Esau. “His name that sat on him was Death”: everywhere he goes is death. “And Hell followed with him”: Libya, Iraq, Iran, Venezuela, Cuba, Panama, destruction everywhere. “And power was given unto them”: that is the dominion Isaac spoke of, “when thou shalt have the dominion”. Power over “the fourth part of the earth”, and the book the Bishop always brings out is called The Fourth Part of the World: the birth of America. The fourth part of the world is South America, Central America and North America, the western hemisphere. That is why he calls it our hemisphere.

“To kill with sword”: by the sword shalt thou live, with armies, weapons and nuclear capabilities. “And with hunger”: famine; he is starving Cuba out by cutting off its trade. “And with death”: a people with no conscience, no remorse, no empathy. “And with the beasts of the earth”: zoonosis, mixing animal DNA in their science to poison us and conquer us.

Habakkuk shows the same nation: “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation”. Esau is the daughter of the Chaldeans, the daughter of Babylon. Habakkuk was a prophet in Babylon, so it is twofold: it speaks of America. They “march through the breadth of the land”, the western hemisphere and beyond: Haiti, Venezuela, Iraq twice, Sudan, Nigeria, Afghanistan, Syria, conquered with death and famine.

“To possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.” They have some 850 military bases in almost every country. There are no Arab military bases here in America, but Esau has his bases in their lands. If Esau is not the devil, if they are not the wicked, then who is?
“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves”. Every brother and sister must examine themselves, and nobody can prove you but you. Ask yourself what you are doing that keeps you from growing in the spirit of Christ, and what you need help with. Do not wait until you hit rock bottom. The faith is the scriptures, and you must constantly examine yourself to see that you are still in it, because Satan can bind us while we still think we are in the truth, hardly reading, hardly studying, hardly watching class.

Knowing yourself means knowing your triggers and your weak point. If you are covetous, you should not have a job dealing with money. If you are lustful, you should not be watching certain videos or listening to R&B heavy. Music, movies and social media will lead you to porn. My lust and your lust might be different, but if I know myself, I know mine. So when the thought comes you say, self, we ain't going to do that today, turn it off and meditate on the scriptures. If you do not examine yourself, you are reprobate, and you let Satan use your body to do whatever he wants.

Why does it matter so much? “Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed”. Satan wants us to shame the ministry, and he makes us believe it is just a little thing. But people want to prove us wrong. They are ready to pick at any little thing: see what leadership is doing, see what the brothers and sisters are doing. Satan sets people inside the congregations for this, ready to say, I'm offended, I'm leaving.

Yet offences are everywhere. Solomon offended, and the whole of Israel was not destroyed; Israel still went on. One man's sin does not destroy everything, which is why we pray and fast for our leadership to stay on course. So take every little thing as a big thing, keep examining yourself, and do not go back to sin, so that the ministry is not blamed.

“Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people”. Your body is a house; that is the house you live in. Set your life in order, brother, with God's laws, statutes and commandments, and then you can reprove and teach your people. And the Most High has set men over us to do that very work.

“And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.” Our leadership is wise, brothers and sisters; the Lord set them over us for a reason. They teach the people knowledge: how to overcome, how to lead ourselves in the way of righteousness.

Set in order many proverbs: that is what we do when we go over precepts. There are a lot of proverbs we read and don't understand, and leadership puts the puzzle together and sets them in order so you can understand the things of old. “The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright”. They search out what the people need and what they are going through. Sometimes they step on toes, just to wake you up or break the chain you have been fighting with.

So God did not leave us without help. When we go off, he set up brothers and sisters to guide us back home. You can never say God did not send help; the one who ignores it is caught up in stupidity.

The Lord told Ezra to “comfort such of them as be in trouble”, and that comfort comes out of the scriptures: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” That which was written was upright, and we have to understand it and follow it. That's the pattern.

That is where our hope comes from. When we look at the history of our forefathers, whatever they went through, brothers and sisters, is what we are going to go through, so we are not shocked at what is going on. And it is the same in the body: the Captain went through it, I can go through it; the Deacon went through it, I can go through it; the sister went through it, I can go through it. That is the comfort that keeps us from giving up.

So don't give up. No matter what, stand up. This profession, made before many witnesses, is all we have; some of us have twenty years and more in this truth. Where can we go? This is our life. Don't let Satan take it away from you, and don't give it up for Babylon's money; Babylon will destroy your soul. Set your house in order, revive your own soul first, and then revive your people.

The Lord God says, “let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.” And: “Woe be unto them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes.” Brothers give up their position because of the affliction, the little tribulation, or because of their bills, two hundred-some thousand dollars of debt. How could you be that stupid, that ignorant? We all have bills. That is all you have. Their sin is wearing them down so much, and they are so covered with it that they cannot see the brotherhood right in front of them.

David asks the question every one of us has to answer: “Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” You have to stand up.

The evildoers are where we are today. Taking a man out of his country and bringing him back to America: the same America that pushes democracy, when democracy put him there, kidnaps him and charges him with unjust judgment. Is that just, or wicked? If it is hard for you to see that America is evil, it is because you are evil yourself. Everything here is a work of iniquity; they push sin everywhere, even in a little karate flick.

Christ said, “I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world.” Have the word of God and the world will hate you, and your family will hate you. “I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.” He left us in the world because we have a path to go through: from Adam until now it has been good against evil, and our job is to stand for what is right. “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.”

The stony ground “immediately receive it with gladness”, but has no root, and when affliction arises “immediately they are offended.” What have you given for this truth? Many would wish to sit in a class learning they are the children of Israel, and many will die today without that chance. While you are alive, you still have it. So who will rise up and stand? Do not let your sins weigh you down.

Christ sent Paul “To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins”. These are the people we are fighting for. Our job is to open the eyes of our people and bring them back to the light, to the commandments, and to the knowledge of who God is: Christ is a black man, he died only for the nation of Israel, and he will return for Israel alone.

Our people are in a state of darkness, and Paul says what that state is: “And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins; Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world”. Our people are dead because they destroyed themselves by breaking God's commandments. They are in a state of death, without conscience, bound by Satan. Whatever the world offers, that is what they follow after.

So when you look at your mother, your uncle, your auntie inside these religions, they are bound by Satan. That is why a sister who separates from her husband and goes to her mother's house, her aunt's house or a friend's house in the world is making Satan's move. What is your mom going to teach you? She is not awake out of this dark place. Leaving a sister in the truth to live with an aunt in the world is a good chess move by Satan, and if you're not wise you won't catch it. Go to the believers who can guide you, teach you and build you up.

Will Smith reached the end of money and fame and found it could not make him happy: a man in pain, crying for help, whose soul is damaged. That is the course of this world. The dead must be quickened, and the pattern to follow is the fruit of the Spirit, meditating in the word, fasting and praying, and examining yourselves whether ye be in the faith.

Babylon's destruction comes “in a moment in one day”, and the Lord gives the reason: “for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” There was sorcery used upon our people in America, and then America used that same thing on all the nations.

That is why your uncle and your auntie won't repent after you accepted Christianity. That is witchcraft, used to keep you in the state of mind you are in. It is the pattern of every captivity: from the Assyrian captivity to the Babylonian, from the Medes and the Persians to the Greeks and to Rome, and now we are in America. All the nations have always used enchantments and witchcraft against us to keep us in darkness, and Satan is dealing with them.

The word enchantment means magic, witchcraft, sorcery, wizardry, necromancy, conjuration, hypnotism, mesmerism, voodoo, charms, spells, incantations, mojo. Remember coming out of Egypt, when the magicians were doing their things? Those magicians are who call themselves scientists today, with different titles under that name. They are the witches of this earth. Hypnotism is like the movie Get Out: our people have been sinking, and it is time to help them come out. America did not use only words against us. It used every witchcraft and every voodoo it could find, and the Catholic church is part of that foolishness.

Then the Lord dares them: “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” America has been dealing with the devil from its youth up. “If so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.” The Lord is saying: since you have practiced these things from your youth, let me see if you will prevail against me. Let me see if that little nuke, that robot that is half a man, all that witchcraft and all the media you have through the earth, can stop what I am bringing into this earth.

We saw it when America was trying to attack and the Lord raised up a storm that destroyed helicopters and airplanes. They don't understand the prophecy. These things are already written, and no man can change them. The nuclear weapons every nation holds are not going to sit on a shelf like extra paint; an ICBM can reach Washington in under half an hour, and what Isaiah and Jeremiah spoke of exists in our time.

That is why we are out here teaching and telling our people to repent. We see what is coming. The same way God destroyed the first world with a flood, he is going to destroy this world with fire, and no sorcery or weapon can stop what God has written.

“But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.” Lust has nothing to do with love, and love has nothing to do with lust; a lot of us get those two confused. What is a man’s own lust? Christ shows it: “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders.”

Read on: “Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” Adultery and fornication are sins we battle every day. The spirit of murder you see in this world, and our people fight that demon every day. Covetousness we fight every day, because we lust and covet after these things. Deceit is a demon we fight every day.

These come from within. So the battle is not really from the outside; the thing we lust after is within us, and the battlefield is the mind. A brother can be quiet here but fighting major demons; a sister can be quiet but fighting demons. Quiet does not mean humble. Some are bound with their sin.

And this world feeds it. Everything here is a work of sin. They sell sex everywhere; you think you are watching a movie or a karate flick, and they put that nasty thing in there, and down the line you see how people turn to watching porn. The devil is always there, pushing sin. That is why we have to understand this walk and overcome it: every man is drawn away of his own lust, the evil that comes from within his heart.

Why do we have to keep the book of the law in our mouth and meditate on it day and night? Because of the work of Satan. Peter shows it: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”.

Your adversary doesn't sleep. You think Satan sleeps for a minute? He does not sleep, brothers. When you know the enemy and know his job, you understand the scripture more. The book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth because Satan is like a devouring lion waiting to get your soul, waiting for you to come off the commandments.

James 1:14 already showed where the fight is: “But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.” When you are drawn away of your own lust, you are not in control; the lust is in control of you. So take every little thing as a big thing, because Satan is well alive here.

That is why the one who looks into the perfect law of liberty must continue therein, not a forgetful hearer but a doer. It is easy for us to go left, so we have to constantly put ourselves in the works. Either you are about it or you are not, and you cannot just be cool to everything while the lion is walking about.

James says the blessed man is the one who looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues therein, “not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work”. Joshua says the same thing another way: “This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night”.

Ask yourself, brothers and sisters: are you meditating in this book they call the Bible? Don't lie to yourself. If you have to ask, it means you need to do it more, because it is supposed to be a natural thing.

Why meditate on it day and night? Because we want to keep the ministry blameless, and because we know the job of Satan: he is like a roaring lion, waiting to get your soul, waiting for you to come off the commandments. When you meditate on something day and night, you have no time for foolishness. It is like the scriptures warning not to be idle, because when you are idle you fall back into sin. When you are constantly in the scriptures, your mind is focused on keeping the commandments. That is the pattern: stay focused.

The enemy is at work every day. Turn off the TV and the phone and you might have a two or three percent upper hand, but as long as these devices and human beings exist on this earth, our battle is serious and we are battling every day.

Joshua goes on: “that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous”. That is James 1:25 again. The perfect law of liberty is what we look into: the commandments, the mercy of God, the grace of God. Christ died on the cross and gave us that grace as the platform to build upon, so we can no longer go backwards; now we have to go forward. The one who is not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work “shall be blessed in his deed”, blessed in his teaching and his business, whatever he does.

The enemy does not sleep, and Revelation shows what he is doing: “And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.”

Satan isn't sleeping day and night. He is accusing us day and night as we study, trying to accuse us before the Lord. So we don't have time to be idle. We have to keep our minds focused, brothers. Y'all sleep on the devil if you want.

He is at work through this world too. They are trying to change times and laws and make people think that what is immoral is moral. The mind of the sinner says don't judge me and don't snitch, but the one living in sin influences others and destroys others. That is why the laws of God are important.

This is why James 1:25 calls us to look into the perfect law of liberty and continue therein. The accuser works against us before God day and night, so we must meditate in the law day and night and be doers of the work, so that we are blessed in our deed and the ministry stays blameless.

Solomon was knocked down, and David, the man after the Lord's own heart, was knocked down. Did they stay down? No. We are not in the business of staying down; we get knocked down and keep going. Satan tells us to stay down, and some brothers and sisters want you to stay down, but that is not what God said. “The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.” That is what God is looking for.

So what do we pray when Satan knocks us down? David prayed it: “Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.” We pray that the Lord does not remove his Holy Spirit from us, because that is what keeps us standing.

“Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.” You have to look at the truth with a joyful and glad heart, because you cannot live without it; it is part of your system, your life. Where else can you go? We do not give up our position; we pray that the Lord keeps strengthening us.

“Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.” When we get back up, our job is to teach, because we have been through the trial and tribulation and understand what it takes. We go right back to the business we left off, teaching our people their transgressions so they do not fall into what we fell into. Do we give that up to go sit on the couch, or sit in the back and puff up on evil?

Nobody sees the prayer, the crying at night, the tears when you are home alone thinking, I could have done better. That is the broken and contrite heart God will not despise. Tell Satan to bring it on. With a position or without it, be the same: a trooper. And when a brother is knocked down, do not applaud it; fast and pray for him, because he is still fighting the same battle you are, and your sin may just not be revealed as quickly as his.

“To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame”. That is the business we are in: we have to overcome. With rank or without rank, a brother has to stay the same trooper. Don’t bail out now; it is time to stand up and face what we have to face.

What we have to overcome, Paul lays out: “Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?” Your mother, your father, your aunt, if they are living an unrighteous life, will not inherit the kingdom. “Be not deceived”: not by Christianity, not by religion, not by the white man, not by the uncle or auntie telling you that you are in a cult. Satan can deceive you into leaving this life while you think you are still in the faith.

“Neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind”. A lot of us are fighting the fornication spirit, the covetous spirit, the lustful demons. “Nor thieves”: some cannot stop stealing even in this truth, like the brother who borrowed the book and never brought it back. “Nor drunkards”: know your limit, because the drink spirit brings out whatever defilement is in your mind.

“And such were some of you.” That is the life we came from, so don’t think Satan won’t tempt you with these things now. And Galatians 6 warns: “if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself. But let every man prove his own work”. It is by the grace of God that you stand. When a brother or sister gets knocked out in this truth, your job is to fast and pray, never to applaud. Be your brother’s keeper; your sin may just not be revealed as quickly as his. That is how we overcome.
