Then we put Christ to the back and just keep sacrificing animals. “But if it be of works, then is it no more grace”: then you put Christ out of the way, no more Messiah. “otherwise work is no more work”: the sacrifice is done away with, because Christ died on the cross.

Romans 11:11 says the leaders' fall brought salvation to the Gentiles “for to provoke them to jealousy”, as Moses said: “I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people”. The ones provoked are the southern kingdom, and the ones who are no people are the northern kingdom, who received Christ. But the southern kingdom still comes first.

“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.” He will raise the tents of Judah first.

Paul says it too: the gospel of Christ “is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.” The Jew is Judah, first; the Greek is the northern kingdom. And judgment runs in the same order: “Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile”.

That is why Romans 11 says God has not cast away his people. Judah stumbled, but Judah is saved first, and the northern kingdom that received Christ provokes them to jealousy until they come in.

“For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy”. Who is the firstfruit? Paul answers it in Corinthians: “But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.”

Christ is the firstfruits. It starts with Christ, because he is our creator, the rock that begat us, and then it goes to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob as well. “Afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming” means the elect.

And the lump is Israel. If the firstfruit is holy, the lump is also holy: because Christ is holy, the people that come after him in his order are holy too.

So Romans 11 opens by tying Israel to Christ. The same holy firstfruit stands at the head of the whole lump, and that is why God has not cast away his people. Both kingdoms, the branches that fell and the branches grafted back in, belong to that holy lump that follows Christ.

“And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them”. The branches broken off are the southern kingdom, because they stumbled and fell. Who is the “thou”, the wild olive tree? The northern kingdom.

Hosea shows why Ephraim is called wild: “For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.” Ephraim is a wild ass alone by himself; a wild ass or a wild olive tree, it is the northern kingdom gone off into idolatry.

That is why Paul, speaking as the apostle of the Gentiles, writes to the southern kingdom while also addressing the northern kingdom: you that I am writing to were also a wild olive tree. And that is why the grafting is “contrary to nature”: the northern kingdom was uncircumcised, in uncleanness, scattered abroad afar off, not a people, and hated by the southern kingdom.

Grafting in goes into reconciling: bringing the two back together again. You can only graft an olive tree into an olive tree; you cannot graft a mango tree into an olive tree. The wild branches are the same kind as the natural ones: Israel.

Who is the olive tree? Jeremiah shows it: “The Lord called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.” The branches of it are broken, just as Paul referenced.

Then watch who that olive tree is: “For the Lord of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.” The house of Israel first, the house of Judah second: both houses.

So the olive tree refers to both the house of Israel and the house of Judah. The wild olive tree is not the other nations; the nations are never called olive trees.

That is how Romans 11 ends: “God is able to graff them in again.” Again, because they were always there. “And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.” Their sins, Jacob’s sins, all twelve tribes. The white man did many sins on this earth, and the Lord is not taking his sins away; he is going to pay for them. “God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all”: all Israel.

“And if the root be holy, so are the branches.” Who is the root? Christ says it himself: “I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David”.

And who are the branches? Christ said in John 15, “I am the vine, ye are the branches.” The branches go into the offspring, the children: us. If the root is holy, so are the branches that grow out of him.

That is what “the root and fatness of the olive tree” is in verse 17. Both kingdoms partake of Christ; he rules over them both. And it is why Paul warns, “Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.” If you boast against your brothers, you are not following Christ; it is Christ, the root, that bears you.

So the root being holy is the reason the natural branches can be grafted in again and the wild branches can be grafted in at all. Everything grows out of Christ, the root and offspring of David.
blog/2026/2026-02-02-2026-02-02-a-tree-b:
Ezra says the husbandman's seed perishes “if it come not up, and receive not thy rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it”. The husbandman is the Most High, the seed is the word he sows in us, and the rain is wisdom. Anyone who has planted knows that if too much rain falls on a seed, it does not grow. How can too much rain corrupt a man? Paul shows it: “Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.”

A novice is somebody new in this truth, a beginner. Some brothers come in and catch on real quick. Why would a novice get lifted up with pride? Because he got too much rain, too much wisdom, and he cannot handle it. He starts getting high-minded, and then he falls into the condemnation of the devil: Satan destroys the seed that is in him. That is what it means when the scripture says too much rain can corrupt the seed. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

That is why the heavy teaching is eased off at times. You may love it when the class goes deep, but too much of that wisdom too fast can corrupt you. The deacons have been learning in this truth for over twenty years. When you see them go into certain things, it comes from years of being watered; nobody woke up one day able to break down the scriptures.

So the Most High gives the rain in its season, moderately, as Joel says, “the former rain moderately”, raising the waters little by little, from the ankles to the knees, so that we can handle it. The seed that receives its rain in due season takes root and bears fruit; the novice who is lifted up with pride perishes like the corrupted seed.

Paul says, “we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation.” Which of you gives thanks to God every day for the brother or sister sitting next to you? That is the spirit we have to war with from now on: no evil thought of a brother or a sister, but praying and fasting for them, so we may be found faithful in the eyes of God. And it is not a coincidence you are in here. The salvation you are receiving was given to you from the beginning.

How do we know? “They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us.” Some brothers and sisters will come among us who are not of us. If they had been, then no matter what we went through, they would still be with us.

In this body we are going to go through things. This is a hospital; we all need medicine, and the word of God is what heals us. A sister said she left because another sister offended her. How many times have we offended the Lord? We have to build our spirit up so we do not move over every little stupidity.

“But they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.” They were not the chosen. The same goes for a spouse: if the unbelieving spouse is pleased to dwell with you, they stay because they love you. When a wife or husband gets up and leaves because you came to the truth, that person never really loved you. So you who are still here, it is no coincidence: you were chosen from the beginning.

“Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.” Reading that, we might think only of agriculture or farming, but it is talking about much more than that, and Sirach 26 shows what.

“My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” The strangers are the heathen, the other nations. Then it explains how you give your strength to them: “When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed.” A fruitful possession means you have a position, you have money, you are rich. Sow it with your own seed means sow it with your own people. You got money? Don't be going and marrying no damn white woman. What a lot of brothers do today, the first thing when they get money, is go marry a heathen. When you marry the heathen when you are rich, you are giving your strength unto strangers.

Instead, deal with your own people: start a family with the woman God created for you, “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” Your stock is your nationality, your race, your people. You are a son of God; why would you want to go deal with other nations?

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” When you marry your sisters and bring forth children among your people, your children and your race are magnified. Good descent means your children are not confused about what their nationality is, because you did not sow your seed among all different kinds of heathen women, as our forefathers did in the book of Nehemiah.

That is the law of Deuteronomy 22:9. When we go and deal with other nations, the fruit of the vineyard is defiled: the children brought forth, the descendants, are defiled and confused.

“But the fruit of the Spirit is love”: keeping the commandments. Joy: do you have joy in keeping God's commandments, or are you always sad and depressed? Peace with your wife and with the brothers and sisters, not always arguing and fighting. Longsuffering is patience. Gentleness means being right with your brother; it does not mean you have to be soft and act like a sodomite. Faith is believing what the Bible says. Temperance is self-control, not easily provoked. “against such there is no law”, because you are keeping the law. These fruits develop once the word of God dwells in you.

Peter shows the same fruits: “And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge”. Knowledge means learning the scriptures and learning how to break them down, because we are not going to be on social media all the time. Brothers who will not come around the deacons, bishops and officers to learn the knowledge of God are not going to last in this truth. “And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness; And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity”: loving God with all your heart and your brother as yourself. All of these are the fruits your tree must bring forth.

“For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Abound means they stay in you. These things can be in you and then leave you. A brother or sister can be among us six or seven years, growing, the leaves green, and then somebody offends them and all of a sudden they stop bearing fruit.

“But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.” So examine yourself: am I bearing good fruit? The Lord does not tell you how long he will be patient. A fig tree that bears no fruit is cut down, and a branch that does not abide in Christ withers and is cast into the fire.
blog/2026/2026-02-07-2026-02-07-a-soul-w:
Colossians says, “Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom.” Malachi shows how deep that warning really is: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven.” That is why every man and every woman in this truth is warned, and why nobody is played with. Fire is coming for this place. Last time it was water, but the Lord promised that this time it is going to be fire, a fire able to burn the soul, and you feel it while you are in it.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble.” It is their pride and their wickedness that bring the fire on them, so you cannot be prideful. Christ died for your sin; he could have taken you out in that moment, but he gave you grace and mercy. Instead of sitting on your behind, build on the platform of Christ: go out and gather the souls Satan is oppressing, the fatherless and the widow. Brothers who want to give their rank up do not understand the work.

“And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” Whatever you are into, it is time to let it go before the fire comes. We fight demons every day, and sometimes it is not that you cannot do a thing; you have to command yourself to do it. Sabbath sickness is a whole slogan for brothers that are lazy bums.

So the life you used to live, the wicked life, died with Christ, giving you a chance before the fire. Now you live his life and do his work. A brother asked how to balance his life: this truth is the balance, and there is no life after it. That is the business we are in, in the classroom, on the radio, on TV and in the street: warning people of the destruction to come, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus.

“Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world”: we walked according to what everybody else in this world was doing, “according to the prince of the power of the air”, Satan, “the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience”. The children of disobedience are those in the churches, in the mass, in Islam, in everything, disobeying God's commandments and thinking that is the way. It is not the way. The way is God's law, statutes and commandments, through his Son Jesus the Christ.

Satan is working in our people in the world, because they are not keeping any commandment. So do not listen to your parents talking about how holy they are. Satan is dealing with them, because they are the children of disobedience. How do you disobey God's commandments and call yourself holy?

Isaiah says the same: “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin”. They take counsel, but not of God. They cover with a covering, but not of his spirit.

So if you are not covered with God's spirit, whose spirit are you covered by? Satan's. The rebellious children and the children of disobedience are the same, covered by the prince of the power of the air. The only way out is to come under the covering of God's spirit by keeping his law, statutes and commandments through Christ.

“Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is. For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river”. The one who trusts in the Lord and makes the Lord his hope, the Lord nourishes. A little plant next to a river never lacks water. When the heat comes the sun may be hot, but you will not feel it, because the hand of God covers you up. “but her leaf shall be green”: you stay green, you stay with wisdom.

Solomon shows what staying green looks like in a sister: “She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.” That is a sister who stays in the green, the little plant by the water. When she opens her mouth, she opens it with wisdom, like someone who has understanding.

When that verse is not fulfilled in your house, that is why the house is not blessed. You wonder why you and your husband are going through things; that verse is not being fulfilled in that house.

The same goes for how we take correction. Asking to explain yourself after admitting to every charge is of the devil; Satan will make you look stupid, and it is better to just listen. The correction given is good for the one who gives it and the one who receives it. That knife cuts both ways: it cuts the one corrected, and the brother correcting says, I have to get my own thing together too. So do not be angry when a brother or sister checks you. Stay by the water and keep your leaf green.

The Lord told Jeremiah, “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” God sent Jeremiah with a purpose. But Jeremiah felt he was too young, that it was not the time: “Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.”

Some of us think the same way, that now is not the time. That is what Haggai answered: is it time for you to dwell in your ceiled houses, and the house of the Lord lie waste? Now is not the time to build your own house first. What about the house of the Lord?

The Lord did not accept Jeremiah's excuse: “Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.” That is a commandment. Jeremiah did not have a choice; it was his from birth. It is the same for you and me: we were ordained from birth to do this work. God knows who you are and did not make a mistake calling you in here. Whatever weakness is in you is no coincidence, and neither is the seat you sit in. Ask yourself why you are here and not dead in the world.

So do not doubt yourself, and do not let Satan take the prize from you. Maybe it feels like too much work; just do it. Put the Lord's house before your own, and speak what we are commanded: Christ is a black man, sent to the twelve tribes of the house of Israel.

“And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.” Christ gave himself as a sacrifice for us. His blood on the altar is the atonement Leviticus speaks of: “I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls”.

Likewise, we are going to have to do the same thing for our brothers and our sisters. We have to become their sacrifice. Many don't pay attention to this: when they put you to death out here, the Lord looks at it as a sacrifice. That is why it is said that in Babylon they see your altar. What did they do on the altar? Offer blood sacrifice. They are going to put us to death out here, and that is what the altar represents.

We are unto God “a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish”. The ones who walk the other way are the ones who “in time past” walked “according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience”. Those children of disobedience are in the churches, in the mosques, in everything, thinking that is the way. Satan works in them because they keep no commandment. The way is through God's law, statutes and commandments, to his son Jesus the Christ.

So walking in love is walking as Christ walked: keeping the commandments, and giving ourselves for our people as he gave himself, an offering the Lord receives as a sweetsmelling savour.

Leviticus says what the blood is for: “it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.” Paul shows whose blood: “For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.” When we were breaking God's law, we became his enemies. Being reconciled now, by Christ's life we are going to be saved.

“And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.” The blood of Christ is what gave us the atonement, so that we can build upon grace. The blood of Christ is more powerful than the animal sacrifice; it is the most powerful thing in this universe.

Read on in the chapter: “For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.” By one man's offence death came into the world because of sin, and it reigned from then until today; look at our condition. “For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.”

That is the platform we have now. The platform we had under the one man's sin, we got messed up on. But Christ did it right this time, so we can build upon him and do it right because he did it right. It is through mercy we make it to the door, because our righteousness is as filthy rags; so nobody should be boasting of how perfect he is. Christ did not come for the righteous; he came for the sick, so he could heal them. And “in bringing many sons unto glory”, his death brings many sons into glory: a new body and a new mindset. So keep on trying, keep on working, and don't give up.

When Rachel wanted a child and came demanding one from Jacob, “Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?” Jacob could not give what only God gives. Go ask God for that baby.

That is the same answer for the single sister who points at leadership because she has been here five, six, seven years and has no lord, while a sister who came after her already has one. Leadership is not in God’s stead. If you want a lord, go ask God, and ask him what he wants you to change first. Check yourself: maybe talk to the sister who came after you and ask how she did it, instead of calling it hatred from leadership. God put leadership in your life to watch over your soul. Be the Proverbs 31 woman, fix your mouth, do the work on the body, stop eating the ice cream at night, and know your size before you point at the fit brother. It is not something you deserve; it is something you earn, by sacrifice.

The same dumb spirit Christ cast out of the boy tells that sister to go into the world, get a lord, and bring him in, when in the world she caught nothing before. Go into the world and you are still the same negro, still the same woman; you never changed, because you would not go to the Lord. Some came here for the ride and not the work. One sister reached out to a man in the world, and he is gone; another left for a man online who said he did not believe in two or three wives, then found out he did. Some of you are not going to get a lord in this captivity, and if that is what you came for, Satan will move you out of the way.

That spirit is the one that “ofttimes” cast the child “into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”: the paycheck spent in the club that gets sprayed up, the drunk drive that costs your limbs, the mob on Eastern Parkway, in the mix of a bunch of no-good negroes up to no good. Leaving your house to go with the dumb negroes is a dumb spirit. We thought it was cool; it was a dumb and deaf spirit, not listening and not seeing our condition. “If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth”: your belief is your power. When Satan keeps attacking you, your faith is weak, so cry like the father, “Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.”

“This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” Some demons are higher than others, so fast and pray, and do not let it conquer you. And once made whole, hear Christ: “sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.” The world you left two years ago is not the world you would go back to; sin has multiplied, and worse demons are jumping on people.

“The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge.” Where is that knowledge going to come from? From the leadership. Jeremiah shows it: “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.”

Your pastors could have been the negroes in the world, leaders who just seek after covetousness. But the Lord led you to pastors according to his heart, brothers who are able to help you build and help you see yourself. They feed you with knowledge and understanding, so that is who you seek after.

So why do you keep running away from them? On the quests there are brothers who show up just to have fun. You see them once, turn around, and they are gone for days: they were not on the quest, they were on a cruise. They are not going for any wisdom, knowledge or understanding whatsoever.

That is the fool of Proverbs 15, whose mouth “feedeth on foolishness”: when leadership is in the room, he looks for who he can talk sports or his job with. The man who has understanding seeks the war room and seeks the water from the Bishop, the Deacons, the captains and the officers. That is what leadership is there for, and this whole Bible is about knowledge, wisdom and understanding that we have to seek out.

Christ said “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, and “be thou faithful unto death”. David shows who is working against us: “Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.”

The purpose of the wicked is to overthrow your goings. You think Satan is sleeping? There is the spiritual Satan and the physical Satan, and every time they are at work, they are working as a team. He will get in your head while you sleep or get in your head while you are awake. At your job, Satan comes jumping into people, and you see people react some type of way.

This is war. That is why you must prepare your soul for the pain that is coming with their children, Esau's children. Whatever state you find yourself in, jail, about to be put to death, afflicted, tortured, losing an eye or an arm, be faithful, because pain is part of the walk. The body is not you; your soul is you.

Mark 9 shows how that spirit works in us: “ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”. That is us destroying ourselves in the club, the partying and religion, because Satan is in us and we thought it was the way. So pray to be kept from the hands of the wicked, and ask the Lord to strengthen your faith, because when your faith is weak, Satan keeps attacking you.

Christ told the apostles, “behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days”, and he is telling us today these things are going to happen to us. How do we know? “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.”

You read the scripture say we are going to go to jail. You read that we are going to be afflicted, that tribulation is going to hit us. So wherever you find yourself, when these things happen you remember reading it, and you say, I cannot fight it, this is of the Lord. So you humble yourself to see what he is trying to show you.

That is why you cannot be a snake and think you are going to get away with it, selling your soul for nothing, for a little seventy dollars. The day you are sitting in the furnace of the fire, all of it comes back: the evil thoughts toward your brother, smiling in your brother's face while breaking bread, the things you did in secret against the congregation.

You have your own personal demonic sin you are fighting with. Get rid of that first before you think about lining a brother or a sister up for their failure. What was written aforetime was written so that when the trial comes, you have patience and hope, and you stand.

“For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.” By one man’s offence death came into the earth, from Abraham to Moses until today. The first platform we had, Adam messed up. But Christ did it right this time, so we can build righteousness upon him.

Hebrews shows where that obedience is leading: “For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.” Christ’s death is going to bring many sons unto glory.

Do you know what that glory is? A new body and a new mindset. So while you are here on this earth, keep on trying. Keep on working. Do not give up and do not give in, no matter what. Keep on fighting. The little things you are going through, you are going to be all right.

The captain of our salvation was made perfect through sufferings, so our sufferings are not the end of the story. It is through mercy that we make it to the door, because our own righteousness is as filthy rags. Christ did not come for the righteous but for the sick, to heal them; the ones who talk down leadership as though they are healed already can be left alone. The rest of us keep building on the one who did it right.
blog/2026/2026-02-07-2026-02-07-dark-pla:
“Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.” What is our profession? We are prophets, and a prophet’s profession is to teach. All of us are supposed to be teachers. Timothy gives the charge: “Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.”

You cannot get that eternal life if you do not hold on to your profession. How are you going to fight the good fight of faith if you are not holding on to it? Your profession is to go out there and wake up our people. Your profession is to put in work, because faith without works is dead. Your first work is supposed to be in this truth, not your job. The minute we say profession, some think we mean I’m a nurse, I’m a doctor. No.

What good is it for a prophet to do nothing with it? Some of you never travel, never leave the state of Georgia, yet you say I’m a prophet. All Israel is not in Georgia; Israel is scattered to the four corners of the earth. How many of you prophets have a valid passport? Brothers have had passports since they were three. If you don’t have one, you should be ashamed. Get a passport; Donald Trump is going to force you to get one too. We have much work to do.

And “all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.” God will bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good or evil. So hold fast the profession, fight the fight, and lay hold on eternal life with a high priest who was “in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.”

“The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?” The heart is the mind, and nothing is more deceitful than the mind. Christ showed what comes out of it: “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”

Yet Solomon says, “All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes”. Every one of us thinks we are righteous. Ask them: me? I ain't do nothing. Covetous spirit? Hatred? Oh, no. Judas would have said the same. All our ways are clean in our own eyes.

“but the Lord weigheth the spirits.” The Lord sees everything, and you cannot hide from the Most High. You can fool the deacon, you can fool the bishop and the leadership, but the Most High sees you, and you are not fooling yourself either. You know where you were last night, why you never called the brother back, and why you told her to hush before you answered the phone.

That is Jeremiah 17:10: “I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins”. Only God can search the mind, and he weighs what is really in it, not what we show each other. Read on: “Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.”

“I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.” Most of us only see each other on the Sabbath, and when we come around each other we are on our best behaviour. Six days a week, Sunday to Friday, we do not know where you are or what you are doing. So what are you doing when you are not here? The sister in Georgia bowed, said shalom and happy Sabbath for ten years while carrying on with the Uber Eats driver. She thought she was fooling us, and surely thought she was fooling the Most High. You cannot fool the Most High.

Paul says the same: “And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit”. The one who searches the heart is searching the mind. And that verse tells you there are two: the spiritual and the physical man. There is a war, the spirit against the flesh, wicked against righteous, darkness against light.

That war will never be over until Christ comes back or you die in this. Some want it to be over and ask why there is so much evil in their head. Maybe because you are not reading enough. Brothers who do not know the scriptures will be the ones to betray you, because when they come to him he will fall. Ask yourself when the brother you talk to during the week last talked scripture with you. The Lord searching the heart gives every man according to his ways: not the deacon's way or the bishop's way, but yours. You are your own biggest enemy.

Christ lists what comes out of the heart of men, and murders is among them: “evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders.” Some do not understand how murder can come out of the mind, so John makes it plain: “Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.”

The hatred you carry is equivalent to murder. Where does it all begin? In your mind, as Mark 7 says. Before you ever commit the act of physical murder, it has to begin with a thought, and the thought of it is the exact same thing. The hatred we have as a people one for another: God says you're already a murderer. You already broke the commandment thou shalt not kill.

It works the same with adultery. The minute you see that ex at the grocery store and take his phone number, before you have even said anything, that is adultery right there. It starts in the mind.

Nobody knows you more than Messiah. He created you, so he knows what is in your mind. We cannot read your mind, but he can, and “All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” So deal with the hatred while it is still a thought, because no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
blog/2026/2026-02-07-2026-02-07-there-is:
Paul beseeches the brethren “that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.” When did we all speak the same thing? In the time of King David and King Solomon, when we ruled the nations. At one time we were unified, and we put the heathen, the other nations, in subjection. Are we unified today?

Ezra shows what that looks like: “And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.” As one man. Think about it on the Sabbath day: we come to hear the word of the Lord, and they gathered themselves together as one man.

Imagine us being perfectly joined together as one man. Imagine how much we could get done if we thought as one man, with the same mind, the same spirit and the same judgment. That is called unity.

It is the same unity Paul calls for in Ephesians 4: “Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace”, “Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man”. That perfect man is the one man. Brothers are going to offend brothers and sisters are going to offend sisters; get over it. There are bigger things to worry about than your feelings. Keep the unity no matter what, for the perfecting of the saints.

“For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.” Who are the leaders in the Black community today? Your Black leaders have you fighting for Palestinians and fighting all kinds of stupid battles. And you Black Christians that are led of them are destroyed. Our people are so destroyed they don't even know it: destroyed with a warm fuzzy feeling every Sunday. The pastors are the new taskmasters. They get sent out by Esau, they learned the doctrines from Esau, and they bring it into your community, pulling up in the Benz while you walk to church in the cold and give him your last.

Hosea shows how it came to this. “Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.” What is good? The laws of God, this Bible. Israel cast them off, and because of that the enemy pursues him.

“They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not.” You set up leaders, brothers and sisters, but it isn't of the Lord. “Of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.” You make these men, these so-called leaders, your idols. You follow them wholeheartedly. Pastor says he needs an extra thousand dollars and you say, Pastor, I'mma work it out, I'mma get you your money. That's cold pimping.

And look at the fruit: a grandmother in Jamal Bryant's church sowing her twelve hundred dollars and being embarrassed because it was not enough; Eddie Long on the throne while the white man holds the mic and tells him he is no longer a commoner. These are your leaders that cause you to err.

“That they may be cut off.” And now we are cut off. That is what comes of casting off the law of God and setting up kings the Lord never chose.

Terence Crawford said there was not a number that could get him back in that ring, and then said for 100 million dollars you can have my soul. That nigger was dead serious; look at his eyes. That is a dangerous man: a man who would sell out his mama and his children and do anything for money. That is the result of 400 years with Esau, and he just said out loud what the majority of Black celebrities, rappers and singers think.

“For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” Esau gives you whatever you want: all the riches, all the connections, all the power, wealth you can't run from. But in order to get it, you lose your own soul.

“Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?” What do these celebrities give in exchange for their souls? Their booty. They give it up, and Amalek takes it. Your Jay-Zs and 50 Cents, your Mariah Careys and Whitneys: they have to give in order to receive.

What are you going to stand for if everything is about money? You have no dignity and no morals. These are the results of the leaders of this people causing them to err, and of Black Christians led by them being destroyed. There are no laws with them, because they were taught the laws are done away with.

“Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.” Put the oppressors on the screen: Pope Nicholas V and Pope Alexander VI. In 1452 Pope Nicholas V issued Dum Diversas, authorizing King Alfonso V of Portugal to fight, subjugate and conquer the Saracens and pagans in African territory. Those were good Christians.

Think about it. Without those two devils, those two Christians, there would be no such thing as an African-American, a Jamaican, a Haitian, a Puerto Rican. We are named after whatever landmass we were scattered to, and we are the result of those men. Christians did this to us. And now we revel in it, reverence them, and follow their laws and their ways of life.

The scripture says choose none of his ways. But tomorrow at 11 o'clock Sunday morning, where will all our people be? Not listening to the truth. They will be in church getting a good dose of the doctrine of the man that enslaved them, that turned them into African-Americans and Jamaicans and Haitians. They can't wait to go learn about a good Jesus.

That is the leaders of Isaiah 9:16 causing our people to err. Look at the results of being taught Christianity: a man on television saying he is a Christian first and that black is a construct, when the white man put us in chains and did not do that to his own people; a girl who let a boy call her the N-word and call him master; our people turning up on each other and showing teeth to everybody else. That is what comes of envying the oppressor and choosing his ways.

Ezra prayed, “O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it”. Another word for culture is heritage: the same heritage Israel discontinued from in Jeremiah 17, the law of life.

The Psalmist shows it: “If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” The right hand is your strength, what you work with. And Moses says, “from his right hand went a fiery law for them.” If you forget your identity, your way of life goes with it.

“If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.” Forget the law and you cannot speak it; your tongue is stuck. Try to talk with your tongue cleaving to the roof of your mouth and you sound crazy. That is how Christians sound to those who know the Bible, with their doctrines; to other Christians they sound fine. We cannot prefer Jerusalem as our chief joy if we do not know we are the Israelites, so we become ordained ministers from the white man's theology schools and seminaries, and we sound like idiots.

So culture to our understanding is what we need back: the identity and the laws that go with it, so that fruit may come of it.

“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. Even Jeremiah, who was not a wicked man, still went into captivity and had to deal with the same things as all the wicked Israelites. And look at how Jeremiah felt about his people, knowing how wicked we are.

“Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” Far away in the wilderness, just to get away from these people. They look just like him and he grew up with them, but he wants to get away from them. Why? “for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.”

“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Do black people do a lot of lying? Yes, we do. “but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.” They move from evil to evil and they do not know God.

That is the black Christian. Do not let them fool you. They can quote the popular scriptures all day, John 3:16, neither Jew nor Greek, no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and say God got me. No, Satan got you. You and Satan are like my buddy and me. That is why the Lord says Israel shall discontinue from its heritage and serve its enemies in a land it knew not: a people who know him not.

Jeremiah says Israel “shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not”. We have lost our heritage and we serve our enemies, one of the curses. Who are our enemies? All the other nations, the enemies of God. Christians do not want to hear that, but here we are unapologetically biblical. Take it up with God.

What is the heritage we lost? “Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” The law of life is the heritage we lost in Jeremiah 17. To take it, they had to break our bands asunder and separate us.

Rudolph R. Windsor, in From Babylon to Timbuktu, made mention that the Israelite culture is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you also discontinue from your heritage. We have a certain way of life as a certain people. When they strip you of your identity, what follows is your laws, statutes and commandments: you are not going to be performing the laws. Lose the identity and the heritage, the law of life, goes with it.

Jeremiah says “both prophet and priest are profane”. Ezekiel shows what that looks like: “There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls”. These pastors devour your souls. “they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof”, through adultery.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean”. They blurred the lines. There is no right or wrong now, just a grey area in the middle: do a little evil, a little good, everything is grey. “and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.”

“Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.” The black Christian congregants are the prey. It is money, money, money; covetousness is what they are. Juanita Bynum can charge over a thousand dollars for a prayer class and be that bold because the black community does not know the Bible.

That is the profaneness Jeremiah says has “gone forth into all the land” from the prophets. Teaching prosperity and that the laws of God are done away produces adulterers, gangbangers, murderers and debauchery, and the land is full of adulterers because of it.

The prophets of Jerusalem “strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness”. When Jamal Bryant was checked over his wife's dress, he did not say the Bible does say a woman should dress modestly, I was in error, I repent. He doubled down: I ain't wrong. So when we see his congregants on the street and say, sis, you can't wear pants, brother, you can't sell drugs, they double down just like him. That is the evil example. None return from their wickedness; they say the Lord did away with that, you twisted the scripture.

Christ cut the Pharisees the same way. His disciples said, “Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?” He answered, “Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.” These pastors, these so-called men of the cloth, have to go; they will be rooted up.

“Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.” The pastor and the congregation both fall. So leave these lying churches alone. If they will not repent, leave them alone. God says of them, “they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah”, and he “will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall”.

“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” “Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them”. The pastors keep the confusion and the sin in the black community going. They keep Ephraim separated from Judah; our bands are cast asunder, and they are not bringing it back. They are furthering the scattering of the children of Israel, not bringing us together.

So look what Christ had to come and say: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”. Why all nations? Because we are scattered in all nations, and the pastors are furthering the scattering. Christ sends his disciples out to the scattered sheep in every country, “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you”: the very commandments the pastors say are done away with.

That is the other half of Jeremiah 23: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds”, “And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them”. Where the pastors scatter and teach that the law is gone, the Lord sends shepherds to go into all nations and teach his people to observe everything he commanded.

“Terrors shall make him afraid on every side”: the missiles, the ICBMs. “His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side. It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.”

Who is the firstborn of death? Paul tells it: “That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead”. That is the firstborn of death right there: Christ. He was the first raised up.

So it is Christ who will devour Esau's strength. “His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.” Your slave master, the one who taught you how to fear God, will be brought to the king of terrors. “brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation. His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.” His branch is his children. The one who rose first from the dead is the one who cuts him off.

“The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down. For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.” His own counsel casts him down.

Job 5 says the same: “He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.”

Remember it: crafty counsel. All of the things they did against us are crafty counsel. The way your neighborhood is set up, redlining, benign neglect, all of it; slavery, exploitation, colonization: all of it is crafty counsel. And God takes the wise in their own craftiness. The net Esau laid is the net his own feet are caught in, and his counsel is carried headlong.

That is how “the light of the wicked shall be put out”. And when Esau's light is put out, the black Christian's head comes right out of the white man's behind. That is the only way the Lord can separate you from the white man, because you are too far gone.

“His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.” Your slave master, the one who taught you about this Bible, shall perish from the earth. David says it too: “Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” God said their memory will be cut off.

“He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.” There is going to come a time when knowing about Esau will be like a bad dream: man, I had a dream I was in slavery to the basest people on planet earth.

“He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.” Cut off totally; a time is coming when they will not be around any more. “Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.” This ain't talking about our people; it is talking about Esau, the wicked on the earth. Destruction is coming to him, and even his memory will be cut off.

We read the judgment: the sword coming for Esau and for the nations, for the Lord “will give them that are wicked to the sword”. “But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.” Israel is the poor, and you escape that judgment by keeping the commandments with faith in the Lord and Saviour Jesus the Christ. “So the poor hath hope”: hope that something better is coming than what we are in right now.

“He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.” David shows what that looks like: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” That fire is not coming near you.

All that is read here is judgment: famine, war, the sword. “In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.” He is going to deliver you and redeem you from the power of that sword, even while thousands fall around you.

But it comes with correction: “happy is the man whom God correcteth”. Brothers get soft and mealy and yellow about correction, and sisters get bitter at those who correct them. Get rid of that soft spirit; man up and woman up. “he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.” He wounds you with the word and makes you whole again, so that no evil touches you when the judgment falls.

Why would the rulers of the synagogues kill and crucify the prophets sent to them? John 11 shows what was in their hearts. “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.”

That is the problem. It is not that they could not see the truth; it is their place. The same holds for the pastors today: if they speak the truth, the white man is going to take away their place, their riches and their platforms and make them into commoners. They do not want that, so they have to follow Rome. They have to follow America's doctrines. They cannot speak the truth.

“And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all, Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.” The one man is Christ. Better to kill him than lose their position.

So when we come into the churches with the same Bible they have, and they put hands on us and pull guns on us with the love of Jesus, it is the same spirit: the prophets are scourged in the synagogues to protect the place of the rulers.

This shows how evil they are. Six days before the passover Christ came to Bethany, “where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.” At the supper Mary took “a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair”.

Judas Iscariot complained: “Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor? This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.” Christ answered, “Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this. For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.”

“Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.” In the chapter before, the Pharisees had already said, we have to kill this man because he does many miracles and Rome is going to take away our place.

Now: “But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death; Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.” Christ raised Lazarus out of the grave, and they said it is not just Christ we have to kill; we have to kill the one he raised from the dead too. That is next-level evil.

And that is what they will do to us. Because by reason of the truth many believe on Christ, they will seek to put us to death, the same as “some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues”.

Korah, Dathan, Abiram and On “took men”, “two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown”. They were not nobodies; they had a name, and what they had was influence over the congregation. They used it against Moses and Aaron: “Ye take too much upon you”. And the results of those leaders: the earth “swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods”, and fire from the Lord “consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.” Everyone who followed them went down with them.

These things were written aforetime for our learning, and Acts 5 shows the same lesson. The apostles were brought before the council, and Gamaliel stood up and warned them: “Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.” Then he gave examples.

“For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves”. Four hundred men joined themselves to a man who came across as a leader, and he “was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.” Then “rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.”

That is the pattern with false leaders: the leader perishes, and the ones that obeyed him perish and are scattered with him, just like the men that appertained unto Korah. “For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.” The leaders of the black community today, the Christian pastors, have our people living in hell, with drugs, gang violence, shootings on the block and adultery, and those that follow them are destroyed with them.

The Israelite way of life is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you are also cut off from your heritage. When they strip you of your identity, your laws, statutes and commandments follow it out the door; you stop performing the laws. Ezra prayed for “seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding”: culture is heritage.

So “If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” The right hand is your strength; you usually work with your right hand. Jerusalem is our homeland, the place where you keep the laws and keep the feasts. Forget Jerusalem, and it is like forgetting your ability to work, the thing you know how to do.

Deuteronomy 33:2 shows what is in that right hand: “The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.” The law came from God's right hand.

So if you forget your identity, guess what else goes with it? Your way of life, the fiery law. Forgetting Jerusalem and losing the cunning of the right hand is losing the law along with the nationality.

“If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth.” If we do not remember the Lord and his laws, statutes and commandments, the tongue sticks and you cannot talk; you cannot teach his laws to your people. The pastors in the churches have their tongues cleaving to the roof of their mouths, because they are not teaching the laws of God.

Ezekiel 3:26 says God does it: “And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb.” That thou shalt be a Christian. You are not Israel anymore, you are not keeping the commandments, you do not have faith in Christ; you have faith in white Jesus and in the white man. God made you into a Christian dummy.

Try to talk with your tongue cleaving to the roof of your mouth and hear how you sound. Everybody looks at you like, what's wrong with this dude? That is how Christians sound to those who know the Bible: level five retards, dumb ass Christians making up dumb doctrines, who think they are in the spirit of the Lord. To other Christians they sound totally fine and normal.

“and shalt not be to them a reprover”: you will be unable to reprove your people with this Bible. You are going to be like Michael Todd and Pastor Pam and all these foolish idiots, ordained ministers from the white man's theology schools and seminary classes.

And “if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy”: we cannot prefer Jerusalem as our chief joy if we do not even know we are the Israelites.

What is supposed to be in your mouth? “This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night.” The book of the law, the Bible, God's laws: that is what belongs in your mouth, the word of God and the laws of God.

But because we have been so wicked, God made our tongue to cleave to the roof of our mouth, and we sound like idiots trying to break this Bible down. When you are a Christian you do not know it, so you say strange things and strange doctrines, like the burning mountain is a meteorite. That is the stupidness that comes out when the law is not in the mouth.

Look at the black pastor today, preaching a sermon while getting a haircut: soft, sweet, moist, squishy, and a leader in the black church. That is the result when the law departs out of the mouth of those who are supposed to teach it.

So Psalms 137:6 is the curse on the tongue for forgetting Jerusalem, and Joshua 1:8 is what the tongue was made for: the law, spoken and meditated on day and night, so that we may observe to do all that is written therein.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Where does that comfort come from? Paul says, “Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort”. The God of all comfort, and we find that comfort in this Bible.

“Who comforteth us in all our tribulation”. Christ comforts us in all our tribulations. The things written aforetime show the Israelites going into captivity after captivity and committing sin after sin, but they also show the redemption: when the Israelites came out of captivity, they had to keep the commandments. That is our comfort, and our hope is that a saviour is coming to redeem the children of Israel.

And he comforts us for a reason: “that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.” Are our people in trouble today? Absolutely. So what are we supposed to comfort our people with? This Bible.

We have to let our people know there is a better way. Go this way, not that way. Do not go to the left and do not go to the right. Go to this Bible, the straight and narrow path. The comfort the scriptures gave us is the comfort we carry to our people.

Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that after the silver of Persia and Media shall come “another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.” What does it mean that this empire, the Greeks, would bear rule over all the earth? The first book of Maccabees shows it: “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. Out of Macedon came Philip, and his son Alexander was the one who united those Europeans, all the Edomite nations, together.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”. That is what Daniel meant by bearing rule over all the earth. “whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.” This is the beginning of white supremacy in the earth, the beginning of white power: they destroyed the dark nations, and the nations and kings “became tributaries unto him.” Everybody had to pay Alexander and the Greeks tribute.

“And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.” He got sick because of syphilis. He “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and after twelve years he died. There were other generals, but the four mightiest were Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Seleucus and Cassander, and they slaughtered the others, like Antigonus, and took his land. Ptolemy took Egypt, Seleucus had Syria, Cassander had Macedonia, and Lysimachus had Thrace and Asia Minor. That is how the empire was divided. “And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

Who was Alexander? The Chronology of Ancient Nations (1879) gives the pedigree of Philip, with Greek and Roman gods inserted to make them seem more important, running back through Eliphaz to Esau, Isaac and Abraham. The Rise of Christendom (1890) says King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac. The scholars in the know know that Alexander was an Edomite; it is just our people who don't have a clue.

So the brass kingdom of the image is Esau ruling over all the earth, and it runs on into the iron of Rome and the feet of iron and clay, America and NATO, the last empire, still a continuation of Rome. The party isn't over, until the stone strikes the feet.

Daniel saw “that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold”.
