“Lord, who hath believed our report?” The report is the Bible, the scriptures. The prophets preach the report, and the question is who has believed it.

“So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” That is how you increase faith. New brothers and sisters ask how to increase their faith: you must consistently addict yourself to the hearing of the gospel, over and over. However old you are, calculate it: that is how many years of brainwashing you must undo. Coming in once a week will not undo it. It must be daily listening to the word, and reading more than the four chapters a day.

And whose sound is going into all the earth? All praises to the Lord for favouring this teaching. The doctrine of having sex with as many women as you can and not taking care of the babies is not going throughout all the earth. The groups talking about raping women and having concubines, the garbage teaching that John the Baptist is a wicked Israelite, the teaching that we are under the old covenant of animal sacrifice: none of that is going throughout the earth. The line that has gone out is repentance for the twelve tribes of Israel in the name of our king whom the world calls Jesus the Christ, heard now in all languages.

“Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart”: to the twelve tribes, those who walk in righteousness and do the commandments. “But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped. For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.” Some of us in here get envious the same way when we see the prosperity of the wicked.

Who is the wicked? Job says: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”. If you don't know who the wicked is, it is telling you by a process of elimination. It ain't the black man and the Latin man; we are not ruling anything. We can't even rule our own homes. The white man rules supreme on this planet. You want anything done in your country, you have to go through that white man.

“he covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The judges are God, Christ, the angels and the Israelites, and it is the white man who covers their faces. Look at the paintings: black Mary with a black baby Christ, and somehow that baby grows up and, Shazam, becomes a white man, and nobody sees anything wrong with that.

So the wicked whose prosperity Asaph envied is the one the earth has been given to for a time: the man who whitewashed the faces of the judges.

Job 9:24 says the wicked has the earth. Malachi names him: “And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” That is the Dark Ages, when God made Esau poverty-stricken.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”. They returned in the time called the Renaissance, and that is when they conquered us and made us their slaves, Christian slaves. “thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. God said, I will give you a chance to build: they built up America, England, France, Germany, Australia, all those places they robbed and pillaged.

“and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Indignation means righteous anger, for ever. So it identifies who the wicked is: Esau, Edom.

That is why Asaph saw him prospering: wherever Esau goes, it seems whatever he touches turns to gold. But he is building only to be thrown down.

“Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.” Read the top ten billionaires: Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, Bernard Arnault, Bill Gates, Mark Zuckerberg, and the rest. Zuckerberg stole Facebook from the college kids who hired him to create it. Micah asks: “Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?” Wicked balances are unjust judgments.

“For the rich men thereof are full of violence”. These rich people come from old money, gotten through the rape, robbery and pillaging of our nations and our people.

“and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.” Their descendants will say anything to justify the evil of their ancestors: it wasn't me, it was my ancestors, but I enjoy what they did. Why? Because they benefit from it.

That is what Asaph envied before he went into the sanctuary of God. Many times we envy people without knowing how they got their money, but nine times out of ten, especially with white folks, it came through criminality. Only by reading and understanding the word of God will you understand their end: set in slippery places and cast down into destruction.

“Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.” They have so much wealth that pride covers them like a chain, and much of their old slave money is invested in war companies, weaponry and the military. David names him: “Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man”. This is about the white man. Preserve us from him.

“Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.” If there is no war, you can bet your last dollar the white man will start one. He can never let there be peace on earth; the way God made him, it is his nature. Trump pledged to end global conflict and bombed at least seven countries in 2025; under Obama in 2016, 26,171 bombs were dropped on seven countries. And they took Maduro with weapons that shut his military down in minutes.

“They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.” Selah means it is true. Whatever comes out of their mouth, religion or politics, is the worst kind of poison; for some of them politics is their religion. Take hold of it and you will die.

“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” Their purpose on earth is to overthrow the twelve tribes of Israel. They can't rest if they see one of us in a nice car or a nice home: he must be selling drugs. “The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me.” The cords and the net are their traps of religion and politics, and a gin is a trap too. He is the wicked of Job 9:24 and Malachi 1, and he wears violence like he wears clothes.

“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Moses says so: “The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.” God's word is his secrets, and what he has revealed of it belongs to Israel and our children forever, so that we may do his law.

So dwelling in the secret place means living in his word and keeping it. That is why “his truth shall be thy shield and buckler”: his law is thy shield and buckler. The one who dwells there can say “He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

That is who the psalm protects when destruction comes. And it is coming, though some do not believe it because of God bless the USA, nothing could ever happen here. Job says “neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh”, because the Lord is telling us it is going to come. The arrow that flieth by day is the missile, and the destruction that wasteth at noonday tells you the time.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” The only reason we will see that and not be touched is “Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation”: because we dwell in the secret place, his word and his law.

“For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.” What is that talking about? Matthew 24 shows it.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Those are the angels given charge over us.

There is going to be so much destruction that the angels will make sure we do not get hurt. We are going to be delivered while our enemies are being put to death. That is “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” The angels will protect the brothers and sisters alive at that time, so that, as Job says, “At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh.”

Then “Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet”: these are the nations, and we are going to trample them. Because the believer has set his love upon the Lord, he says “therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.” “I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him. With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.”
blog/2026/2026-02-14-2026-02-14-covetous:
“But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have.” The Lord does not like people who are crooked. If you are going to do business, make sure you have a just balance; do not play with the scale and tilt it in your favor.

Solomon shows whose scale it is: “A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.” The just weight belongs to the Lord. So if you are dealing with a just weight and balance, you are in the spirit, and the Most High loves that.

The Most High is not a joke. He gives commandments on what you should do to live, and says keep them so that you may have life. Dealing justly with your brother is love, and “Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.” Doing back-dealing with your brother shows no love; that is hatred. By being covetous you break many laws.

That is why the just weight comes with a promise: “that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.” The scale that is the Lord's is the scale that lengthens your days.

“Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.” The great and the small that Deuteronomy forbids in the bag and in the house are both alike. If you are not doing the right dealings in your business, the Lord is looking at you as an abomination.

Eventually he is going to put your lights out, because he already warned you. If you want long life, have a just weight; that is the thing he is pleased in. If you have divers weights and divers measures, the Lord is not pleased, and your days are going to be short.

That is the other side of Deuteronomy 25:15. If a just weight lengthens your days, an unjust balance shortens them. One day somebody is going to realize you have been robbing them, and they are going to kill you. Dudes will kill you for a dollar; you would be surprised what people do. The Bible knows that, and the Lord wrote about it from the very beginning.

Had you been doing your four chapters a day and applying yourself, you would remember scriptures like this, and when the devil tried to tempt you, you would say no: the Bible says the Lord counts it an abomination.

“Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.” You feel good when you make that extra money from tilting the scale, when you are stealing. It tastes sweet.

“But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.” What he does not know is where it leads: death and condemnation. The one who eats the stolen bread is sitting among the dead.

So do not be a thief. Deal righteously; deal according to the law, statutes and commandments. The divers weights of Deuteronomy 25 are stolen waters, and the days they seem to add are really shortened, just as the law warned: the just weight is “that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.”

And pride keeps a man from hearing it: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.” Once people have a little money in their pocket, they feel grown and will not seek counsel, and when everything falls apart, then they want counsel. The scriptures say blessed is he that readeth; if we apply what we read, we will be all right.

“It is the spirit that quickeneth”: only the spirit can change you as a man. “the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.” So when Galatians says walk in the Spirit, it means walk in the words of Christ, the laws, statutes and commandments, and you will not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

Those words have to live in you. The Bible should be like the receptionist at the front desk of an office building: nobody gets in unless she lets them. The door to your soul is your forehead, so the Bible should sit there. When the plan comes up, it says, I hear you, but that's two to five; that's ten to fifteen; that's life. Thou shalt not steal.

When you see a beautiful woman and are tempted to start rubbernecking, you remember Job: I made a covenant with my eyes, why then should I think upon a maid? If you walk in a place and there's a stack of money with nobody around, thou shalt not steal. Without the scriptures readily in your mind, it is impossible not to fall into temptation.

And hidden wickedness does not stay hidden. We are not small any more. A brother making a delivery from another state was recognized by someone not even in the truth. Imagine if he had been doing wickedness. The words of Christ are spirit and life; the flesh profits nothing.

“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” What is the Spirit you have to walk in so that you never do amiss? “For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.” The law is spiritual. We are carnal, sold under sin. So if we want to stop being carnal and stop sinning, we have to keep the law.

That is what walking in the Spirit means: walking in the ordinances, the laws, the statutes and the commandments of the Lord God. If you are doing these things, you are never going to do amiss.

“For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”. There is a war within you. The old man always wants to be around, in your business: reading the Bible? You don't need to read the Bible. Let's go rob a house, steal a car, boost cars like you used to, call your man for two birds, go fly some kites. The only way you win this war is by actually reading your Bible and applying what you read.

If you do not read, pray or fast, miss all the new moons and feast days, and show up on the Sabbath just to keep up appearances, you will not be able to fight the lust within your flesh, because you are not walking in the Spirit. The flesh will always be present; it is what you put in you now that fights it. So stay in this book, the spiritual law, and the carnal man is subdued.

“Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds.” It is forbidden for us to lie one to another. We must be men of character, men of honour, because the world must look at us and say, surely this is a wise and understanding people. If you are lying, how is the world going to say that? They will say this is an evil-ass negro, and the truth gets evil spoken of, because the whole time you were doing it you had fringes on your clothes.

At no time did you look down at your fringes and say, damn, I can’t behave this way, I can’t do this to my brother, not even to people in the world. Why? Because you are not in the Bible. There is no way you are in the Bible and doing evil at the same time; it is an oxymoron. You just finished reading thou shalt not steal, I love that scripture, let me get my gun? It doesn’t go that way. The word has to be nowhere near your head for you to go do evil. That is why you stay in this Bible and give attendance to reading, continuously, so the word is in you.

A bishop “must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.” People in the world will lie on us, but they should never be able to back it up. In business in the world you must be twice as honourable, and you will get more jobs, because nobody likes a thief. Penny wise, pound foolish: make an extra penny now and lose the whole pound. Lie and steal, and you end up ducking people, circling the block, getting beaten over twenty dollars, and still owing the money. The devil convinced you it was okay to lie, then removed himself. Put off the old man and his deeds, and lie not one to another.

“let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.” When you say yes, I am going to do it, do it. When you say no, you can’t, then don’t. But never say yes, get paid to do the job, and then not do it. Christ put it this way: “But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.”

You are evil when you lie to your brothers. Anything other than yea and nay is evil, and if you are evil you are going to be condemned: not by us, but by the Lord. Condemn means to declare reprehensible, wrong or evil, usually after weighing evidence. The Lord is going to review your case like a court docket: the state versus so-and-so, how do you plead, not guilty, bring the witness. He didn’t know they had the witnesses.

The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good, and he rewards every man according to his deeds. Curse not the king in your chamber, lest a bird carry the news. You do evil in a different state with somebody we never met, and another brother goes to that state for a job and meets the same person. After a joyful Sabbath together, two brothers got in the car, one pocket-dialed the captain, and he heard them talking trash about all the ranking men. When questioned, the first thing was a lie.

When people bring up your evil without anybody asking one question, the Lord is exposing you because he wants you to get right. He could have let you do it to the wrong person, and we find out at your funeral: he stole a hundred grand and a dude put two in his back. You can sit home and hate the messenger, or recognize the mistake, apologize, make amends and walk in the spirit so blessing comes your way. The choice is yours.

“Ye cannot serve God and mammon.” Mammon is money. That is why the elite do not want to hear anything about God: they feel like they are in their heaven already. And that is why a lot of people are scared of dying. Many times the fear of death is not death itself.

“O death, how bitter is the remembrance of thee to a man that liveth at rest in his possessions”. That man is living so good that the moment he thinks of death, he says, I have to leave all this behind? Because of his possessions his mind is on here. He is not thinking about the possession over there, what the Most High has in store for us that eyes have not seen and ears have not heard. He wants it now.

“Unto the man that hath nothing to vex him, and that hath prosperity in all things: yea, unto him that is yet able to receive meat!” Do you think a covetous man wants to die, after he just got that nice Porsche and bought that nice house? No. He needs to enjoy it a little more, because it is never enough to a covetous man.

That is why in this truth you cannot get attached to things. The saints love not their lives unto death. Nothing on this planet can hold us back from doing what we are supposed to be doing, and whatever is going to happen to us is what will happen; the apostles were appointed last, unto death. You cannot hold to money and serve God too.

“Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.” Why? Because of what you were supposed to do first: “Let reason go before every enterprize, and counsel before every action.” Everything you take on to do, you are supposed to seek counsel. And if you seek counsel and apply it, things are going to go well for you.

But instead of seeking counsel, pride kicks in. I am my own man, I do what I want. A lot of times when brothers have bad dealings with each other, both of them were out of the spirit, because neither one ever asked for counsel: Listen, I want to do this job with so-and-so; what do you think about it?

Once people have a little money in their pocket, they feel grown. I own my own house, I bought it with my own money, I am doing better than you; who are you to counsel me? Then months later, years later, when everything falls apart, now they want counsel. Counsel did not go before that enterprise; pride went before it, and destruction came with it.

You need counsel before, not after. That is why we have to remember the scriptures: blessed is he that readeth, and if we apply what we read, we are going to be all right. Reason and counsel before every action is the cure for the pride that goes before destruction.

“Blessed is he that readeth”. We all want blessings, and here is the formula. Read four chapters a day and you finish the Bible in a year; if you have more time, read more. Reading is how you hear the word, “and they that hear the words of this prophecy”, and hearing is how you apply it, “and keep those things which are written therein”. You read “thou shalt not steal”, you keep it, and nobody will ever call you a thief. That is how the blessing comes.

But what should you be reading? There are plenty of good books, but this is the book of life. Baruch says: “This is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endureth for ever”. If you want to know which commandments to follow, you read the whole Bible, and the law endures forever.

So the Christian churches are lost in the sauce. They say you don’t have to keep any laws, yet they keep the one law that actually is done away with, tithing. That proves they are greedy dogs and covetous men, and all their lights are going to be put out. Coming out of that church and seeing that covetousness is a bad thing, why would we come into the truth and still be covetous?

“All they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.” If you want life, if you don’t want your light put out, you keep the commandments: read the Bible, learn the laws, statutes and commandments, and apply them. You tell me, do you want life or death? Being here shows you want life; the question is whether you will do what it takes, or revert to the old man and give in to your lust.
blog/2026/2026-02-14-2026-02-14-fighting:
“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” If you love this place, the love of the Father is not in you. The state of mind of a saint is, I want to be up out of here; I hate this place. All that is in the world is “the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life”, and the lust of the eyes today is TikTok and social media, where the minds of a lot of young brothers and sisters are.

There is a challenge everybody is doing, a dance where they act like they are eating something. The song is called feeling on my body, and it is all about sex. Young brothers and sisters, even among us, watch it and mimic it, and some school sisters were doing that dumb, stupid dance on the new moon. When she says she loves an eater, you think she is talking about eating food? She ain't talking about eating food. She's talking about eating sausage.

The scripture shows what it is: “Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.” She eats and wipes her mouth, and then says she has done no wickedness. That is the characteristic of an adulterous, wicked woman, and that is what the dance is about: sucking rod.

So sisters, you should not be doing those dances. You don't even understand what's behind them. It is the lust of the eyes: you see it on social media and think it's cool. It isn't innocent; you are conjuring demons. We are supposed to be separate, not following the things we see in the world, because the world passeth away, and the lust thereof, “but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.”

“For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.” That fire, the furnace of adversity, is temptation. Adversity comes from our adversary, and our adversary is that spiritual demon and his children. So the furnace of adversity in Sirach is the work of the adversary the devil in Peter.

Acceptable men are that gold. When an acceptable man goes through that fire, it doesn't destroy him. It makes him better; it purifies him. When Satan attacks and kills and puts in prison, some men it will destroy, and some men it will make perfect in the sight of God. When the ADL and all these governmental organizations attack us, some of you sisters will be up out of here: I ain't messing with them, the government say they a hate group. Some of you brothers will be gone too. But some of you will be purified and become that pure gold.

You have to go through adversity. Your enemy has to attack you; that is how you become better and how you become a better fighter. Then Peter's words come to pass: “after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.” Nobody wants to suffer, but the Lord says if you want the kingdom you have to suffer, and if you are acceptable, after you suffer you will get the kingdom. Suffering makes you perfect, establishes you, strengthens you until you are battle hardened like somebody who has been warring for thirty or forty years, and settles you within your spirit: it is what it is.

“All things are double one against another”. God created good, and he created evil also. He “hath made nothing imperfect”: Satan was not created imperfect. He was created to do exactly what he is doing, walking about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

“One thing establisheth the good or another”. What establishes the good of us and makes us perfect? When we go through temptation, when Satan attacks us and we overcome and are not devoured by him. Satan does devour some; some brothers and sisters get devoured. But those that are not devoured become better and become perfect. That is why Peter says “after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect”. It is a hard saying, but without Satan, our adversary, we cannot become perfect, because it is his job and his children's job to try us, and as they try us they make us better. Even the real bad things: Job lost all his kids, and that was to make him perfect.

So learn how to fight him and how to see him when he is attacking. See him when he is coming, when he is trying to jump on you and put thoughts in your mind, and say, get out of my mind, Satan. Don't wait until he puts the thought there and you act on it, and afterward you are like Judas, what did I do? That is why the scripture says be vigilant: vigilant means you are watching.

And “who shall be filled with beholding his glory?” Those of us made perfect in trials and tribulation are the ones who will behold the Lord's glory.

“Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.” Satan does not run around doing his own thing. He goes before the Lord and answers to him.

“And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.” That walking up and down in the earth is the dust he eats. In Genesis 3 God said, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”. Here is that judgment being lived out: his job is to walk the earth to see whom he can tempt and destroy. Satan became the tempter, and that is his judgment; soon he will be destroyed.

It happened after Satan was judged, and it shows the order of things. The power of this world was delivered to him, but he still presents himself before the Lord and reports where he has been.

The word Satan comes from a Hebrew term meaning adversary: accuser, opponent. And the word devil means deceiver. He is the Lord’s adversary and our adversary. And not only the spiritual Satan: his seed, his children, are our adversary too, because God put enmity between his seed and her seed. The so-called white man is our adversary, and the spiritual demon Satan is our adversary. That is the war we are in.

Satan made his move on Adam through the weaker vessel, and God brought judgment on the serpent, the woman and the man. To the serpent: “Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field”. That is not about livestock. This is paradise; he is cursed above every creation God made there. And, “upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life”.

That one line says two things. Man was made from the earth, and Satan is a celestial being, so “all the days of thy life” means his days are numbered: he will be destroyed in the future for what he did. And eating dust means he is on the earth, and the Lord handed him power over it.

Luke shows it: “the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” When was the power of this earth delivered to Satan? In Genesis 3, what we just read.

And he gave it to whom he would: first to Cain, and then to Esau, the so-called white man in these last days. That is why Esau is able to create all this technology.

Then comes the declaration of war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Back then her seed was Abel, then Seth and the chosen lineage, and Satan’s seed was Cain and his descendants. Today her seed is the twelve tribes of Israel, and his seed is the so-called Caucasians, Edom. And “it shall bruise thy head”, because his seed, the Romans, crucified Christ. Then, “and thou shalt bruise his heel”: the Lord will take down Satan and his children. So when the Bible says to be soldiers of Jesus Christ, we fight Satan, his wicked thoughts and whispers, and we also fight his children, his physical counterpart.

When did the war start? Through the envy of the devil, when he made his move on Adam’s kingdom. And he made that move through Adam’s wife: “Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.”

The serpent is Satan, the devil. It says serpent, but it is not talking about a snake; he is called a serpent because he is slick, forked-tongued, tricky. And notice, “which the Lord God had made.” God created him to be exactly who he is. He was subtil because God made him subtil.

Job confirms it: “By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.” God formed that crooked serpent, Satan. He is not a rival power that rose up on his own to equal God; he is a creature God made, crooked by design.

So Satan tricked Eve, the weaker vessel, and caused her to sin, and Eve went and convinced her husband to sin. Then the Most High came to deal with Adam, Eve and Satan, and brought judgment on all three. From there God declared the war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”.

That is why we have to know our adversary. The serpent that deceived Eve is the same one we fight today, in his whispers and in his children, and the one who formed him is the one who will judge him.

Genesis 4 shows Satan’s children being born in the earth. Eve bare Cain and then Abel; Abel kept sheep and Cain tilled the ground. “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth”. The Lord told him, “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” Do good and you will be accepted; do evil and Satan will rule over you. Cain would become the child of Satan and serve him.

Then Cain talked with Abel, “and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him”. That is the fulfillment of Genesis 3:15, “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. The enmity started there. Cain, Satan’s seed, killed our forefather: the first murder on the earth and the first blood shed in the war.

John proves Cain was that seed: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” Cain was always evil. His descendants were the children of the devil, and they corrupted everyone on the earth, even the sons of God, until God destroyed the world. All the evil you see Esau doing on the earth today, Cain was doing back then.

Then the sons of God and the sons of the devil came back. Rebekah’s children “struggled together within her”, and the Lord said, “Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”. Jacob is the twelve tribes, the so-called Negroes and Hispanics; Esau is the so-called white man. This fight did not start with slavery, Jim Crow or civil rights; it started in the beginning with Cain and Abel, and was reborn as Jacob and Esau: good against evil. Many of our people followed Cain then, and many follow Esau now and have become children of the devil themselves.

Esau “came out red, all over like an hairy garment”, born without pigment, as Cain lost his when the earth cursed him. Jacob took hold on his heel, a prophetic sign of Genesis 3:15: our Lord coming to destroy Satan and his children. And when scripture says “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, it was Herod, an Edomite, who “killed James the brother of John with the sword” and took Peter. The devil means the deceiver, and it is interchangeable: the father and his children, who can do nothing without the father that dwells in them.

Job ends where chapter 32 began. There the three men ceased to answer him “because he was righteous in his own eyes”, and Elihu was angry “because he justified himself rather than God.” Here Job says, “I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee. Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

Job hated himself and repented. He repented for justifying himself and not God, for being righteous in his own eyes. He had said, I am righteous, this is not supposed to happen to me; I made a covenant with mine eyes, I don't look at other women, I am not weak like Adam, I don't hide sin in my bosom. That was his flaw. He was over-righteous, and the Lord did not like it.

In his own eyes Job did not look at it as though there was a reason God was doing this, that God was trying to make him better. In his mind it was, I am righteous, I am not like this person or that person. So the Bible says, “Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?” That person who tries to act over-righteous just ends up looking fake; nobody knows everything and nobody is perfect.

This is the war within, the war nobody sees. Everything Job suffered before was physical, but Satan was attacking his mind too. The Lord used what Job went through to show him what was inside himself, and that is what Satan's attacks do: they show you things inside yourself. Through all of it Job was made perfect, and he came out of it repenting in dust and ashes, justifying God instead of himself.

Christ said evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders and the rest come “from within, out of the heart of men”, and “defile the man.” So how do those evil things get into your mind? Remember who the war is against: Satan. Acts shows how he does it.

“But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet. But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost” What did Satan do? He filled his heart to lie. That lying spirit comes from Satan.

That is how he works. He is there in your head, whispering thoughts, tempting you, putting things there that are not there. The deacon says something to you and Satan says, why did he say that to you? The deacon don't like you. A husband gives his wife an order to clean the bathroom, and Satan whispers: you going to let him talk to you like that, after all you do in this house? He don't understand you; he don't love you. If she listens, she becomes bitter and it shows in her actions.

Satan puts things in everyone's head, the deacon included. The fight with Satan starts first and foremost in your mind, and many fall in this truth because they wait until the mind is already defiled. To win, you have to kill it right there: the thoughts Satan puts in your mind should never become action. Ask, why am I thinking like this? Fast and pray, Lord take these thoughts out of my mind, and answer him with the word of God, “the sword of the Spirit”, the weapon we fight with.

“Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison”. Did the literal devil come and cast people into prison? Did a spiritual demon snatch somebody and throw him in a cell? No. When the Bible says devil, it is interchangeable: it is talking about the father and his children. The same way we can do nothing without our Father and without the Lord in us, these people can do nothing without their father dwelling in them. He uses his children to do what he wants done.

Acts 12 shows who did it: “Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church. And he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also.” Herod was a white man, an Edomite. He killed James and put Peter in prison. So at that time the devil casting into prison was Herod, Satan’s children, Rome.

The seed of the devil came back as Esau, and the sons of God came back as Jacob: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Satan means adversary, accuser, opponent: he is the Lord’s adversary and ours, and so is his seed. Devil means deceiver: as he deceived Eve, his children deceive everyone on the earth. That is why we call the so-called white man the devil, because he deceives the whole earth, and Satan, because he is our adversary and God’s.

So know who we are fighting. This is war, and the devil still casts some of us into prison through his children.

“Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry”. That is in the New Testament, for you black Christians, you black apologists, you black pastors who say the law is done away with. Why would Paul write it if the law was done away? Because it goes right back to Exodus 20: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me”.

“Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”. That is where 1 Corinthians 10:14 comes from.

Valentine's Day is idolatry; its origin is Februus and Lupercalia, a fertility rite in which women presented themselves to be struck because it was believed to help with fertility. When you sit up there and celebrate Valentine's Day, you are putting Februus, whoever the hell that is, and Lupercalia before the Lord. What's wrong with Christmas? It's idolatry. Your birthday? Idolatry. Halloween? Idolatry. That's what's wrong with it.

The Lord gave us our own high holy days, in Leviticus 23. The Destruction of Nicanor began last night at sundown, the victory recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14 and 15, when Judas Maccabeus defeated and killed Nicanor, the Seleucid Syrian Greek commander who came to crush Israel and threaten the temple. Tonight at sundown begins Purim, when we were saved from being wiped out in the Persian Empire: the enemy was Haman, and the deliverance came through Esther and Mordecai. Our enemies' holidays, the Fourth of July and Christmas, are victories over us. Ours are victories over our enemies. Flee from their idolatry and keep what the Lord gave us.

“For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.” Your body is the temple, and you must be fit to serve; you cannot serve the Lord and be unfit.

Paul also says: “For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.” Prepare ye war physically, and keep your house in order, because God is not the author of confusion, and order protects in a crisis.

When this empire collapses and global trade is disrupted, the ones who are ready will be the ones whose bodies are strong and whose houses are in order. A body kept under control and a house kept in order is how we glorify God in the body he bought with a price.

“What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?” So you have to prepare ye war physically. This is war. Strengthen your body and keep it under control; you are not your own.

“A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.” A wise man is strong, and some of you brothers cannot do ten push-ups. Brothers get upset because the camp sets weight standards, and they can't run worth a damn thing; they cannot run three, four, five miles. Sisters, get in shape too. How the hell are you going to go out and teach when you are unfit?

A pastor once challenged the captain, fat as hell, saying he eats people like him up for dinner. Since he started with dinner, the answer was gluttony: about thirty scriptures of correction on his own church page. Not a debate about the color of Christ first; deal with your health right now.

Diets are not wrong, but you still have to exercise. You can fast seven days and be down ten or fifteen pounds, but the Lord put self-preservation in your DNA: the body goes into saving, starts storing more water and more fat, and it comes back. You have to get out here and work out. You are not getting any younger, and your body is the temple: you must be fit to serve.

“His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark.” We are supposed to watch and pray, to be alert to the times, to keep our spirit in order with the Most High and to repent. But the watchmen are blind. All these Christian apologists and Black pastors are ignorant. We are on the brink of civil war in America, and how many pastors are saying prepare ye war? None of them. They are celebrating Valentine's Day. They cannot bark: they will not prophesy and they will not warn you, like the dog that jumped out the window when its own owner pretended to break into the house.

They are “sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber”, silent and lazy, and “greedy dogs which can never have enough.” One pastor said nobody leaves until he gets his 40 G's, lock the doors. Another said sow a seed of ten thousand and you'll be a millionaire overnight. All they speak about is prosperity: nothing about prophecy, nothing about warning you, nothing about getting your spirit right. Many don't even think they have a reason to bark, because they are too comfortable to see the danger right in front of them.

Here is one of the watchmen in action. Jamal Bryant, senior pastor of New Birth Missionary Baptist Church, preached with conviction that 85% of Jesus's life he was wrong and out of order, doing what he was not called to do, and the people sat there and listened to it.

The Bible says sin is the transgression of the law, the breaking and violating of God's laws. So was Christ wrong? Peter answers: “Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth.” He did no wrong at all.

Yet a pastor will get up and speak against Christ, and you never hear him speak against Babylon, America, never against homosexuality, never against the idolatrous festivals out here. That is the blind watchman, the dumb dog that cannot bark. So the prophets have to go out and proclaim among the Gentiles, “Prepare war”, and our own people need to know war is coming too.

Christ said to watch and pray, “for ye know not when the time is.” Peter says the same: “But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.” Be sober, man. Keep a clear mind.

“And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.” Fervent charity is the brotherly love we are supposed to have for one another, the way we are supposed to treat one another.

We need it because these things are taking place, and we see them taking place on the earth. The end of all things is at hand, so watching and praying goes together with a clear mind and with love among ourselves.

Watching and praying is not only for the nation at large. “Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving”. Watch and pray for your household, your children, your brothers and sisters, because if the house fails, the nation gets weaker.

That is why marriage classes keep coming up. The scripture says it is not good for man to be alone. Some brothers think they are strong enough to do it without her, but it is not good that you should be alone; two are better than one.

And watch in the same with thanksgiving: be thankful for the things you have right now, because some people are in a way worse position than you. So continue in prayer, be thankful, and keep preparing, because you do not know when the time is.

“Take ye heed, watch and pray”, and Christ tells us what to watch and pray for: “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.”

Watch and pray for the destruction of their wicked devices: that the traps, the plots and the lies of the enemy be exposed and broken. Ask the Most High to show you.

Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled. And pray that you are worthy to stand before Christ when these things come. We see all this unfolding, the nations moving and the empire declining, so the prayer is not for these things to be stopped but for us to be found worthy to escape them and stand before the Son of man.

Christ said, “Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.” You don't know when the time is coming, so you need to stay prepared, stay ready. The prophecy is unfolding before our eyes: the ten horns giving their kingdoms to the beast, NATO sending weapons and troops here and there, and a time coming when those horns will hate the whore.

So what do we pray for? David shows us: “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.” Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, asking the Lord to fight against them that fight against us.

Watch and pray that none of us drift, get isolated, or get taken by sin and deception. You can pray for that. These Black Christians don't know what to pray for, but the scripture shows you: pray for the Lord to plead our cause against them that strive with us.

“I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters”. There is a judgment coming to this place, and nobody wants it judged. Their inward thought is that this kingdom lasts forever. The pride in Esau’s heart says we are in the perfect geographical location, nobody can attack us; meanwhile they go destroy a country and then bring the same people they destroyed over here.

Who sits upon many waters? Put up the map of the US military bases: 845 and more. Who has their navy in everybody’s water, their submarines everywhere? Babylon the great is a world-reaching power over many peoples, nations and tongues, with global influence. The US has launched 469 military interventions since 1798, 251 since 1991. You cannot tell me Babylon is not America.

Habakkuk describes him: “because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell”. He never stays at home. In Vietnam he did the My Lai massacre, murdering hundreds of women, children and old men, raping children as young as twelve, and his Agent Orange still kills people to this day. Look at Iraq; look at Libya, where they are selling Black people for five hundred dollars and no pastor says a word; look at Palestine; look at the proxy war in Ukraine, pumping in billions of weapons. Everywhere he goes he destabilizes the country and it becomes hell.

That is not Saudi Arabia, not the Chinese, not the East Indians. No other nation has that kind of global reach. And he “cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”. Now the world is shifting to many powers, China and Russia rising, and this place is prophesied to fall. So prepare yourselves, mentally, physically and spiritually: this is war.

Waking out of sleep means staying awake: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”.

You have to stay sober and vigilant, because the enemy looks for open doors and distracted people. As soon as one of y’all gets distracted from the mission, they are coming. That is why every time somebody leaves, we see who shows up: the damn Christian apologists.

They take you all the way back into the world and have you speaking all manner of evil, but they are not telling you to prepare yourself mentally for what is to come. They are just trying to destroy what we are doing. They are not trying to save your soul. They say they are already saved; they are not saved from the nuclear missiles that are about to drop.

So the one who is asleep is the one the roaring lion devours. It is high time to wake up, stay sober, stay vigilant and stay on the mission, because the adversary is walking about looking for whoever drifts.

“Now it is high time to awake out of sleep”. We see all these things going on and some of y’all still stay asleep, not even paying attention to what is going on in the earth. Y’all crazy as hell. You need to prepare ye war, and the first place to prepare is the mind: guard your mind from fear.

“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” God gave you power, love and a sound mind. Some of y’all are scared. Christ told them to sell their garment and buy a sword, and some are still scared to buy one. Christ said do it.

There is a time and place for everything under the sun, and that time is going to come. So prepare mentally. We are a nonviolent people; all we want to do is serve the Lord. But we will protect and defend ourselves.

Waking out of sleep means not letting fear keep you from doing what Christ commanded. “Now is our salvation nearer than when we believed”, and a mind given power, love and soundness by God is ready for what is coming.

“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Prepare ye war: you have to prepare yourself mentally, and part of that is not letting any man deceive you. Do not let deception take you.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” He is telling you that many false prophets and many false Christs are going to rise. And it is happening: there are men online right now literally saying that they are Jesus. Freaking Jesus. Freak ass dude.

Christ said more in the same chapter: “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is going to happen, and those who are spiritually asleep will be the ones deceived.

So awaking out of sleep is guarding your mind from deception. The time is late, our salvation is nearer than when we believed, and the deceivers are already here. Take heed.

“And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.” What way is this? Christ answers it: “I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.” The way that Ephesus was stirred up about, the thing that caused a huge commotion in that city, was Christ himself.

They had a problem with Christ because a whole city was given to witchcraft. Ephesus owed its fame to the temple of Diana, and the “curious arts” practised there were the magical arts of the Ephesian conjurers. When Paul came preaching Christ, “many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds”, and those who used curious arts brought their books of witchcraft together and burned them before all men, fifty thousand pieces of silver worth. “So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.”

That is what stirred the city. Demetrius the silversmith, “which made silver shrines for Diana”, called the craftsmen together and told them “by this craft we have our wealth”, and that Paul had “persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands.” People were repenting and turning away from their witchcraft, and that put both the craftsmen’s living and the temple of “the great goddess Diana” in danger. Diana, with all the breasts on her, goes into fertility: satanic worship at the end of the day.

So the stir “about that way” was a city given over to idolatry and sorcery fighting against Christ, the only way to the Father. There is no salvation without him, and the same call goes out to our people now: repent from the idolatry, the fornication and the lasciviousness, and come to the way.

The Iranians burned large statues of a horned, bull-headed figure bearing the so-called Star of David, and they knew what they were doing: they were burning statues of Baal. That is not the Star of David. You cannot find it anywhere in the Bible; it is a sign in the occult.

Stephen said, “Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.” If you didn't know, Moloch is Baal: the same thing, both the devil. The star is the star of their god, the devil, Baal or Moloch.

Stephen was quoting Amos: “But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.” Which ye made to yourselves: it is idolatry. God did not give us that star. When King Solomon was dabbling in witchcraft, that is how he got that star; God never gave it to us.

So the star so-called Israel and America carry is the star of Baal, and Baal worship shows up in plain sight: the bull's head statue at the 1933 Chicago World's Fair on Jewish Day, the giant mechanical bull at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, the bull on Wall Street. Even bullheaded, stupidly stubborn, comes from Baal worship, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. That idolatry is why Israel was carried away, and why we are in captivity today.

The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

“Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children; And walk in love”. “But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints”. Why did Paul write to the Ephesians that way? Because that is what they used to be caught up in. Ephesus was a tough pagan environment. The worship of Diana, Artemis, involved all manner of lewd behaviour: they filled the great theatre, they had orgies, they got drunk, witchcraft, idolatry. Diana is the queen of heaven, the same as Ashtaroth, and the same as the Yoruba goddess, and our people were caught up in it in ancient times and today.

Chapter 4 shows it: “This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind, Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart”.

“Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness. But ye have not so learned Christ”. Paul wrote in that form because he knew the lifestyle they came from, living as the Gentiles.

They were once “Gentiles in the flesh” and “aliens from the commonwealth of Israel”, but now made nigh by the blood of Christ, “fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God”: the northern kingdom, the so-called Argentinians, Colombians, Brazilians, Venezuelans, Puerto Ricans and Mexicans, the Israelites according to the Bible. So our people need to wake up and repent from the idolatry, the fornication and the lasciviousness, and flee from idolatry, or receive the same judgment coming on America.

Ezra foretold that “the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The Carmanians are the Iranians: Carmania was a region of southeastern Iran, the modern province of Kerman, part of the Persian Empire, and Persia only formally became Iran in 1935. Why the Assyrians? In antiquity Assyria conquered Israel, took the northern kingdom, and moved into our land. That is exactly what Esau-Edom has done with our land today. They are not the rightful inhabitants; they are thieves, and the Lord is against them.

Ezekiel says so: “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. Who is Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So the prophecy is against Esau-Edom, and the Lord says, “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

Why? “Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. The two nations are the northern kingdom, Ephraim, and the southern kingdom, Judah: they took those two nations by identity theft, robbing us of who we are. The two countries are the United States of America and Israel. The children of Israel were in both first, and the whole world was made for our sake, but Edom stole both lands.

They said, “and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there”. They possess it as if the Lord were with them, by calling themselves Jews and Christians. So “I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” The same way they hate the Israelites, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, the Lord will use that same anger against them, and they will know that God did it.

Christ names them too: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” He knows our poverty, “but thou art rich”, because the promises and the covenant belong to us.

Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Empire, the old Persian kingdom, in 550 BC, and it was an ancient Iranian empire. That makes this very significant for what is going on today. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem”.

The Lord was working through King Cyrus. The Lord did speak to him, and he listened. Isaiah had already named him: “That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.”

So the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah was fulfilled through a Persian, an Iranian king, called by God his shepherd, who performed all his pleasure: Jerusalem built again and the foundation of the temple laid.

Isaiah goes on: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut”.

That is why Cyrus could say, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth”. The Lord held his right hand and subdued nations before him. The Lord used King Cyrus, who was a Persian, to allow us to go back and build the temple.

Cyrus is also the one who gave that decree. And the kingdom he ruled, Persia and Media, is Iran today, which is why his story is very significant for what is going on now.

Hosea says the Lord “shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

Isaiah says the same: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The Lord gathers his children from where they are, and the west is where most of them are, here in America and this side of the world.

So when the Lord roars, the children who tremble and walk after him come from the west, and he gathers them. That is the hope for the tribes over here, but it comes with a warning. Before this the class read that Babylon's “sins have reached unto heaven”, and that we must come out of the ways of America and out of her idolatry. If we don't repent of our stubbornness, our bullheadedness and our idolatry, we will get the same judgment as her. The seed that is gathered from the west is the seed that answers the roar and walks after the Lord.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”. The children who tremble from the west in Hosea are the ones the Lord saves from the west country. “And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember what the Jewish Encyclopedia said earlier in the class about Arzareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and Columbus identified America with that land. It was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. This is that restoration: the Lord bringing us from the west country to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem.

And it is “in truth and in righteousness”. That is why the class closed on idolatry: “the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”, and our stubbornness and disdain for God's commandments are idolatry. Flee from idolatry, so that you are among the people he brings back.

“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown.
